segs.ar: وَقَدَّمْتَ لَهُمُ الذِّكْرَ الْعَلِىَّ وَالثَّنَآءَ الْجَلِىَّ
segs.tr: WA QADDAMTA LAHOMUZ ZIKRAL A’LIYYA WAS SANAAA-AL JALIYYA
segs.en: and accorded for them the exalted remembrance and a glowing praise
segs.ur: اور ان کے لیے بلند ترین ذکر اور واضح تعریف کو پیش کردی

segs.tr: WA AHBATTA A’LAYHIM MALAAA-EKATAKA WA KARRAMTAHUM BE-WAH-YEKA
segs.en: And You sent down Your angels on them; and honoured them by Your inspirations.
segs.ur: اور ان کے یہاں اپنے ملائکہ کو اتار دیا اور انہیں اپنی وحی کے ذریعہ محترم بنا دیا۔

segs.tr: WA RAFADTAHUM BE-I’LMEKA
segs.en: And helped them with Your knowledge
segs.ur: اور اپنے علم سے نواز دیا

segs.ar: وَجَعَلْتَهُمُ الذَّرِيْعَةَ اِلَيْكَ وَالْوَسِيْلَةَ اِلٰى رِضْوَانِكَ
segs.tr: WA JA-A’LTAHOMUZ ZAREE-A’TA ELAYKA WAL WASEELATA ELAA RIZWAANEKA
segs.en: And appointed them as the means of approach to You, and the means towards Your satisfaction.
segs.ur: اور انہیں اپنی بارگاہ کے لیے ذریعہ اور اپنی رضا کے لیے وسیلہ قرار دے دیا۔

segs.ar: فَبَعْضٌ اَسْكَنْتَهٗ جَنَّتَكَ اِلٰى اَنْ اَخْرَجْتَهٗ مِنْهَا
segs.tr: FA-BA’-ZUN ASKANTAHU JANNATAKA ELAA AN AKHRAJTAHU MINHAA
segs.en: Then You made some  of them dwell in Your Garden, until You sent them out there from.
segs.ur: ان میں سے بعض کو اپنی جنت میں ساکن بنایا یہاں تک کہ انہیں وہاں سے رخصت کردیا۔

segs.tr: WA BA’-ZUN HAMALTAHU FEE FULKEKA WA NAJJAYTAHU
segs.en: And You carried one of them in Your Ark  and rescued him
segs.ur: اور بعض کو اپنی کشتی میں سوار کرکے انہیں نجات دے دی

segs.ar: وَمَنْ اٰمَنَ مَعَهٗ مِنَ الْهَلَكَتِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ
segs.tr: WA MAN AAMANA MA-A’HU MENAL HALAKATE BERAHMATEKA
segs.en: and one who believed with him, by Your Mercy, from destruction.
segs.ur: اور ان کے ساتھیوں کو ہلاکت سے اپنی رحمت کے ذریعہ نجات دے دی

segs.tr: WA BA’-ZUN ITTAKHAZTAHU LENAFSEKA KHALEELAN
segs.en: And you selected for yourself one of them as Your friend.
segs.ur: اور بعض کو اپنے لیے خلیل بنالیا۔

segs.ar: وَسَئَلَكَ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى الْاٰخِرِيْنَ فَاَجَبْتَهٗ
segs.tr: WA SA-ALAKA LESAANA SIDQIN FIL AAKHEREENA FA-AJABTAHU
segs.en: And he requested you to grant him a tongue of truth in the last epoch of the time.
segs.ur: اور انہوں نے آخری دور میں صداقت کی زبان کا سوال کیا تو تو نے ان کی دعا قبول کرلی

segs.tr: WA JA-A’LTA ZAALEKA A’LIYYAN
segs.en: Then You granted his wish and You appointed that elevated one.
segs.ur: اور اسے بلند بالا قرار دے دیا

segs.tr: WA BA’-ZUN KALLAMTAHU MIN SHAJARATIN TAKLEEMAN
segs.en: And to one of them,  You spoke from a tree a speaking
segs.ur: اور بعض سے درخت کے ذریعہ کلام کیا

segs.ar: وَجَعَلْتَ لَهٗ مِنْ اَخِيْهِ رِدْئًا وَّوَزِيْرًا
segs.tr: WA JA-A’LTA LAHU MIN AKHEEHE RID-AN WA WAZEERAN
segs.en: and appointed his brother  his supporter and Vizier
segs.ur: اور ان کے لیے ان کے بھائی کو پشت پناہ اور بوجھ بٹانے والے قرار دے دیا

segs.tr: WA BA’-ZUN AWLADTAHU MIN GHAYRE ABIN
segs.en: And You did cause one  of them to be born without a father
segs.ur: اور بعض کو بغیر باپ کے پیدا کردیا

segs.tr: WA AATAYTAHUL BAYYENAATE
segs.en: and You gave him the clear signs
segs.ur: اور انہیں واضح نشانیاں عطا کردیں

segs.tr: WA AYYADTAHU BE-ROOHIL QODOSE
segs.en: and supported him with the Holy Spirit.
segs.ur: اور روح القدس کے ذریعہ ان کی تائید کردی

segs.ar: وَكُلٌّ شَرَعْتَ لَهٗ شَرِيْعَةً وَنَهَجْتَ لَهٗ مِنْهَاجًا
segs.tr: WA KULLUN SHARA’-TA LAHU SHAREE-A’TAN WA NAHAJTA LAHU MINHAAJAN
segs.en: And for each one You did enact a religious law and You assigned a path for him
segs.ur: اور ہر ایک کے لیے ایک شریعت اور ایک طریقہٴ حیات مقرر کردیا

segs.ar: وَتَخَيَّرْتَ لَهٗ اَوْصِيَآءَ مُسْتَحْفِظًا بَعْدَ مُسْتَحْفِظٍ
segs.tr: WA TAKHAYYARTA LAHU AWSEYAAA-A MUSTAHFEZAN BA’-DA MUSTAHFEZIN
segs.en: And You selected successors  for him A protector after a protector
segs.ur: اور ان کے لیے اوصیاء منتخب کیے جو ایک کے بعد ایک دین کے محافظ بنے

segs.ar: مِنْ مُدَّةِ اِلٰى مُدَّةٍ اِقَامَةً لِدِيْنِكَ
segs.tr: MIN MUDDATIN ELAA MUDDATIN EQAAMATAN LE-DEENEKA
segs.en: for a definite period. For establishing You religion
segs.ur: ایک مدت سے دوسری مدت تک، اپنے دین کو قائم کرنے کے لیے

segs.tr: WA HUJJATAN A’LAA E’BAADEKA
segs.en: And a proof upon Your servants,
segs.ur: اور اپنے بندوں پر اپنی حجت تمام کرنے کے لیے

segs.tr: WA LE-ALLAA YAZOOLAL HAQQO A’N MAQARREHI
segs.en: lest the truth wanes from its place
segs.ur: اور اس لیے کہ حق اپنے مرکز سے ہٹنے نہ پائے

segs.tr: WA YAGHLEBAL BAATELO A’LAA AHLEHI
segs.en: and falsehood overpowers its people
segs.ur: اور باطل اہل حق پر غالب نہ آنے پائے

segs.ar: وَلَا يَقُوْلُ اَحَدٌ لَوْلَا اَرْسَلْتَ اِلَيْنَا رَسُوْلًا مُّنْذِرًا
segs.tr: WA LAA YAQOOLA AHADUN LAWLAA ARSALTA ELAYNAA RASOOLAN MUNZERAN
segs.en: And none can say: Why had You not sent unto us a warning messenger
segs.ur: اور کوئی شخص یہ نہ کہنے پائے کہ تو نے ہماری طرف ڈرانے والا رسول کیوں نہ بھیج دیا

segs.tr: WA AQAMTA LANAA A’LAMAN HAADEYAN
segs.en: and appointed for us a flag of guidance.
segs.ur: اور ہمارے لیے نشان ہدایت کیوں نہ قائم کردیا۔

segs.ar: فَنَتَّبِعَ اٰيَاتِكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ نَذِلَّ وَنَخْزٰى
segs.tr: FANATTABE-A’ AAYAATEKA MIN QABLE AN NAZILLA WA NAKHZAA
segs.en: Then we would have followed Your signs before suffering failure and disgrace
segs.ur: کہ ہم ذلیل و رسوا ہونے سے پہلے تیری آیتوں کا اتباع کرلیتے

segs.ar: اِلٰى اَنِ انْتَهَيْتَ بِالْاَمْرِ اِلٰى حَبِيْبِكَ وَنَجِيْبِكَ
segs.tr: ELAA ANIN TAHAYTA BIL-AMRE ELAA HABEEBEKA WA NAJEEBEKA
segs.en: Till You ended the affair  towards Your beloved and Your noble
segs.ur: یہاں تک کہ تیرے امر کا سلسلہ تیرے حبیب، تیرے شریف بندے

segs.tr: MOHAMMADIN SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI
segs.en: Mohammad, May the peace of Allah be upon him and his progeny
segs.ur: حضرت محمد مصطفی تک پہنچ گیا، خدا ان پر اور ان کی آل پر رحمت نازل کرے

segs.ar: فَكَانَ كَمَا انْتَجَبْتَهٗ سَيِّدَ مَنْ خَلَقْتَهٗ
segs.tr: FA-KAANA KAMAN TAJABTAHU SAYYEDA MAN KHALAQTAHU
segs.en: Then, he was as You had selected him, the leader of whom You have created him
segs.ur: وہ ویسے ہی شریف تھے جیسے تو نے انہیں بنایا تھا، تمام مخلوقات کے سردار

segs.tr: WA SAFWATA MANIS- TAFAYTAHU
segs.en: and the excellent one of Your selected one;
segs.ur: اور تمام منتخب بندوں میں منتخب

segs.tr: WA AFZALA MANIJ TABAYTAHU
segs.en: and the best one whom You have selected him
segs.ur: اور تمام چنے ہوئے بندوں سے افضل

segs.tr: WA AKRAMA MANEA’ TAMADTAHU
segs.en: and the most honoured whom You have relied on him
segs.ur: اور تمام معتبر افراد سے مکرم و محترم

segs.tr: QADDAMTAHU A’LAA AMBEYAAA-EKA
segs.en: You gave him precedence upon Your prophets
segs.ur: تو نے انہیں تمام انبیاء پر مقدم قرار دیا

segs.tr: WA BA-A’STAHU ELAS-SAQALAYNE MIN E’BAADEKA
segs.en: and have sent him to the thaqalain  (Jinns and Men) from (among) Your servants.
segs.ur: اور انہیں تمام انس و جن کی طرف مبعوث کیا

segs.tr: WA AW-TAATAHU MASHAAREQAKA WA MAGHAAREBAKA
segs.en: And made Your Easts and Wests  come under his feet;
segs.ur: اور ان کے لیے تمام مشرق و مغرب کو ہموار کردیا

segs.tr: WA SAKHKHARTA LAHUL BORAAQA
segs.en: and harnessed for him the Buraq.
segs.ur: اور براق کو مسخر کردیا

segs.tr: WA A’RAJTA BE ROOHE-HI ELAA SAMAAA-EKA
segs.en: And did make him ascend (with his soul) towards Your heavens
segs.ur: اور انہیں اپنے آسمان کی بلندیوں تک لے گیا

segs.ar: وَاَوْدَعْتَهٗ عِلْمَ مَا كَانَ وَمَا يَكُوْنُ اِلَى انْقِضَآءِ خَلْقِكَ
segs.tr: WA AWDA’-TAHU I’LMA MAA KAANA WA MAA YAKOONO ELAN QEZAAA-E KHALQEKA
segs.en: And You entrusted in him the knowledge of the past and future till the end of Your creation
segs.ur: اور انہیں تمام ماضی اور دنیا کے خاتمہ تک کے مستقبل کے علوم کا خزانہ دار بنادیا

segs.tr: SUMMA NASARTAHU BIR ROA’-BE
segs.en: Then You helped him with awe
segs.ur: اس کے بعد رعب کے ذریعے ان کی مدد کی

segs.tr: WA HAFAFTAHU BE-JABRA-EELA WA MEEKAA-EELA
segs.en: and You surrounded him with Jibraeel and Michaeel
segs.ur: اور جبرئیل اور میکائیل کے ذریعے انہیں محفوظ بنادیا

segs.tr: WAL MOSAWWEMEENA MIN MALAAA-EKATEKA
segs.en: and the distinguished angels.
segs.ur: اور ان تمام فرشتوں کے ذریعے جو تیری نمائندگی کی نشانیاں تھیں

segs.ar: وَوَعَدْتَهٗ اَنْ تُظْهِرَ دِيْنَهٗ عَلَى الدِّيْنِ كُلِّهٖ
segs.tr: WA WA-AZTAHU AN TUZHERA DEENAHU A’LAD DEENE KULLEHI
segs.en: And You promised him that You would make his religion triumphant over all the religions
segs.ur: اور تو نے ان سے وعدہ کیا کہ ان کے دین کو تمام ادیان پر غالب بنائے گا

segs.tr: WA LAW-KAREHAL MUSHREKOONA
segs.en: though the polytheists may be averse  (to it)
segs.ur: چاہے مشرکین کو کتنا ہی ناگوار گزرے

segs.ar: وَذٰلِكَ بَعْدَ اَنْ بَوَّئْتَهٗ مُبَوَّ ءَصِدْقٍ مِنْ اَهْلِهٖ
segs.tr: WA ZAALEKA BA’-DA AN BAWWA-TAHU MOBAWWA-A SIDQIN MIN AHLEHI
segs.en: And this is after You appointed some of his kindered as his Successor
segs.ur: اور یہ اس وقت ہوا جب تو نے انہیں ان کے اہل میں صداقت کے مرکز پر مستقر کردیا

segs.ar: وَجَعَلْتَ لَهٗ وَلَهُمْ اَوَّلَ بَيْتٍ وُّضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ
segs.tr: WA JA-A’LTA LAHU WA LAHUM AWWALA BAYTIN WOZE-A’ LIN-NAASE
segs.en: And You appointed for him and them a First house which has been established for the mankind.
segs.ur: اور ان کے لیے اور ان کے اہل کے لیے اس پہلے گھر کو قرار دیا جسے تمام انسانوں کے لیے بنایا گیا ہے

segs.tr: LAL-LAZEE BE-BAKKATA MOBAARAKAN WA HODAL LIL A’ALAMEENA
segs.en: The one which is at Makkah, a blessing and a guidance for the worlds
segs.ur: جو مکہ میں ہے اور بابرکت اور عالمین کے لیے ہدایت ہے

segs.tr: FEEHE AAYAATUN BAYYENAATUN MAQAAMO IBRAAHEEMA
segs.en: In it (are) clear sings; place of Ibrahim
segs.ur: اس میں کھلی ہوئی نشانیاں اور مقام ابراہیم ہے

segs.tr: WA MAN DAKHALAHU KAANA AAMENAN
segs.en: and whoever entered it in was safe.
segs.ur: اور جو اس میں داخل ہوجائے وہ محفوظ ہوجاتا ہے

segs.ar: وَقُلْتَ اِنَّمَا يُرِيْدُ اللهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ اَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيْرًا
segs.tr: WA QULTA INNAMAA YOREEDUL LAAHO LE-YUZHEBA A’NKOMUR RIJSA AHLAL BAYTE WA YOTAHHERAKUM TATHEERAA
segs.en: And You said: Verily Allah intends to keep off from you every kind of uncleanliness. And to purify you people of the House with a thorough purification.
segs.ur: اور تو نے اعلان کردیا ہے کہ اے اہل بیت! اللہ کا ارادہ بس یہ ہے کہ تم کو ہر برائی سے دور رکھے اور تمہیں اس طرح پاک و پاکیزہ قرار دے جو پاکیزگی کا حق ہے

segs.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلْتَ اَجْرَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ
segs.tr: SUMMA JA-A’LTA AJRA MOHAMMADIN SALAWAATOKA A’LAYHE WA AALEHI
segs.en: Then You assigned rewards of Mohammad, Your peace be upon him and his progeny (with)
segs.ur: اس کے بعد تو نے مرکز رحمت محمد اور آل محمد کا اجر

segs.tr: MAWADDATAHUM FEE KETAABEKA FA-QULTA
segs.en: their love (the love of progeny) in Your Book. Then You said:
segs.ur: اپنی کتاب میں ان کی مودت کو قرار دے کر اعلان کردیا

segs.ar: قُلْ لَّا اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ اَجْرًا اِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِى الْقُرْبٰى
segs.tr: QUL LAA AS-ALOKUM A’LAYHE AJRAN ILLAL MAWADDATA FIL QURBAA
segs.en: “Say I demand not, of you any reward for it” (the toils of preaching except the love of my relations.
segs.ur: اے پیغمبر کہہ دو کہ میں تم سے کوئی اجر نہیں مانگتا ہوں علاوہ اس کے کہ میرے قرابت داروں سے محبت کرو

segs.ar: وَقُلْتَ مَا سَئَلْتُكُمْ مِنْ اَجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ
segs.tr: WA QULTA MAA SA-ALTOKUM MIN AJRIN FAHOWA LAKUM
segs.en: And you said: “Whatever reward I have asked you  it is for yourself.”
segs.ur: اور تو نے کہہ دیا کہ میں نے جو اجر مانگا ہے وہ تمہارے ہی فائدے کے لیے ہے

segs.ar: وَقُلْتَ مَا اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ اِلَّا مَنْ شَآءَ
segs.tr: WA QULTA MAA AS-ALOKUM A’LAYHE MIN AJRIN ILLAA MAN SHAAA-A
segs.en: And you said: “I ask you not any reward for it except that one who wishes,
segs.ur: اور کہہ دیا کہ میں تم سے کوئی اجر نہیں چاہتا مگر وہ شخص کہ جو چاہتا ہے

segs.tr: ANY YATTAKHEZA ELAA RABBEHI SABEELAN
segs.en: may adopt the path of His Lord.
segs.ur: کہ اپنے رب کی طرف راستہ اختیار کرے۔

segs.ar: فَكَانُوْا هُمُ السَّبِيْلَ اِلَيْكَ وَالْمَسْلَكَ اِلٰى رِضْوَانِكَ
segs.tr: FA-KAANOO HOMUS SABEELA ELAYKA WAL MASLAKA ELAA RIZWAANEKA
segs.en: Then, they [Ahlul Bait (a.s.)] are the path towards You and the way towards Your satisfaction.
segs.ur: تو یہ سب تیری بارگاہ کے لیے راہ ہدایت اور تیری رضا کے لیے بہترین مسلک بن گئے

segs.tr: FALAMMAN QAZAT AYYAAMOHU
segs.en: When his (Holy Prophet) days passed.
segs.ur: پھر جب ان کے دن تمام ہوگئے

segs.ar: اَقَامَ وَلِيَّهٖ عَلِىَّ بْنَ اَبِىْ طَالِبٍ صَلَوٰتُكَ عَلَيْهِمَا وَاٰلِهِمَا هَادِيًا
segs.tr: AQAAMA WALIYYAHU A’LIYYABNA ABEE TAALEBIN SALAWAATOKA A’LAYHEMAA WA AALEHEMAA HAADEYAN
segs.en: Be appointed his successor Ali, son of Abu Talib as a Guide. Your peace be upon them and their progeny.
segs.ur: تو انہوں نے اپنے ولی علی ابن ابی طالب کو، ان دونوں پر اور ان کی آل پر تیری رحمت ہو، ہادی مقرر کردیا

segs.ar: اِذْ كَانَ هُوَ الْمُنْذِرَ وَلِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ هَادٍ
segs.tr: IZ KAANA HOWAL MUNZERA WA LE-KULLE QAWMIN HAADIN
segs.en: As he was a warner – and a Guide for every nation.
segs.ur: اس لیے کہ وہ خود عذاب الٰہی سے ڈرانے والے تھے اور ہر قوم کے لیے ایک ہادی ہے۔

segs.tr: FA-QAALA WAL MALA-O AMAAMAHU
segs.en: Then he (Holy Prophet) said before a huge gathering
segs.ur: انہوں نے مجمع عام کے سامنے اعلان کردیا

segs.tr: MAN KUNTO MAWLAAHO FA-A’LIYYUN MAWLAAHO
segs.en: “Whomsoever I am his Master, then Ali, is his Master
segs.ur: جس کا میں مولا ہوں اس کا یہ علی بھی مولا ہے۔

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَآلِ مَنْ وَالَاهُ وَعَادِ مَنْ عَادَاهُ
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WAALE MAN WAALAAHO WA A’ADE MAN A’ADAAHO
segs.en: O Allah Be a friend of one who is his friend and be the enemy of one who is his enemy;
segs.ur: خدایا جو اسے دوست رکھے اسے دوست رکھ اور جو اسے دشمن رکھے اسے دشمن رکھ

segs.ar: وَانْصُرْ مَنْ نَصَرَهٗ وَاخْذُلْ مَنْ خَذَلَهٗ
segs.tr: WAN-SUR MAN NASARAHU WAKH-ZUL MAN KHAZALAHU
segs.en: and help one who helps him and disgrace one who disgraces him”
segs.ur: اور جو اس کی مدد کرے اس کی مدد کر اور جو اس کو چھوڑ دے اسے نظر انداز کر

segs.ar: وَقَالَ مَنْ كُنْتُ اَنَا نَبِيَّهٗ فَعَلِىٌّ اَمِيْرُهٗ
segs.tr: WA QAALA MAN KUNTO ANAA NABIYYAHU FA-A’LIYYUN AMEEROHU
segs.en: And he said: “Of whomsoever I am his Prophet, then Ali is his Chief”
segs.ur: اور اس رسول نے اعلان کیا کہ جس کا میں نبی ہوں اس کے علی امیر ہیں

segs.ar: وَقَالَ اَنَا وَعَلِىٌّ مِّنْ شَجَرَةٍ وَاْحِدَةٍ
segs.tr: WA QAALA ANAA WA A’LYYUN MIN SHAJARATIN WAAHEDATIN
segs.en: And he said: “Ali and I are from one tree,
segs.ur: اور فرمایا کہ میں اور علی ایک ہی شجر سے ہیں

segs.tr: WA SAA-IRUN NAASO MIN SHAJARIN SHATTAA
segs.en: and the other people are from different trees.”
segs.ur: اور تمام لوگ مختلف شجروں سے ہیں

segs.ar: وَاَحَلَّهٗ مَحَلَّ هَارُوْنَ مِنْ مُوْسٰى فَقَالَ لَهٗ
segs.tr: WA AHALLAHU MAHALLA HAAROONA MIN MOOSAA FA QAALA LAHU
segs.en: And he placed him [Ali (a.s.)] in a position, as Haroon had with Moosa. Then he said to him,
segs.ur: اور علی کو موسیٰ کے لیے ہارون کی منزل پر قرار دیا اور ان سے کہا

segs.ar: اَنْتَ مِنِّىْ بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُوْنَ مِنْ مُوْسٰى اِلَّا اَنَّهٗ لَا نَبِىَّ بَعْدِىْ
segs.tr: ANTA MINNEE BE-MANZELATE HAAROONA MIN MOOSAA ILLAA ANNAHU LAA NABIYYA BA’-DEE
segs.en: “your position to me is as Haroon had with Moosa, except that there will be no Prophet after me.”
segs.ur: تم میرے لیے ویسے ہی ہو جیسے موسیٰ کے لئے ہارون تھے، صرف میرے بعد نبی نہ ہوگا

segs.tr: WA ZAWWAJAHUB-NATAHU SAYYEDATA NESAAA-IL A’ALAMEENA
segs.en: And he got him married with his daughter, chief of the ladies of the Worlds.
segs.ur: اور پھر اپنی بیٹی سردار نساء عالمین کا ان سے عقد کردیا

segs.ar: وَاَحَلَّ لَهٗ مِنْ مَسْجِدِهٖ مَا حَلَّ لَهٗ
segs.tr: WA AHALLA LAHU MIN MASJEDEHI MAA HALLA LAHU
segs.en: And he made for him lawful [Ali (a.s.)] whatever was lawful for himself in his mosque.
segs.ur: اور ان کے لیے مسجد میں وہ سب حلال کردیا جو خود ان کے لیے حلال تھا

segs.tr: WA SADDAL ABWAABA ILLAA BAABAHU
segs.en: And he closed all the doors (leading to the mosque) except the door of his house.
segs.ur: اور ان کے دروازے کے علاوہ سب کے دروازے بند کردیئے

segs.tr: SUMMA AWDA-A’HU I’LMAHU WA HIKMATAHU FA-QAALA:
segs.en: Then he (Holy Prophet) entrusted to him his knowledge and his wisdom. Then he said,
segs.ur: پھر انہیں علم و حکمت کا خزانہ دار بنادیا اور اعلان کیا

segs.tr: ANAA MADEENATUL I’LME WA A’LIYYUN BAABOHAA
segs.en: “I am the city of knowledge and Ali is its gate.
segs.ur: میں شہر علم ہوں اور علی اس کا دروازہ ہے

segs.ar: فَمَنْ اَرَادَ الْمَدِيْنَةَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ فَلْيَاْتِهَا مِنْ بَابِهَا
segs.tr: FAMAN ARAADAL MADEENATA WAL HIKMATA FALYAATEHAA MIN BAABEHAA
segs.en: Then, one who wishes (to enter) the city (of knowledge) and wisdom, then he should enter from its gate.”
segs.ur: تو جو شہر اور حکمت میں داخل ہونا چاہے اسے دروازہ پر آنا چاہیے

segs.ar: ثُمَّ قَالَ اَنْتَ اَخِىْ وَوَصِيِّىْ وَوَارِثِىْ
segs.tr: SUMMA QAALA ANTA AKHEE WA WASIYYEE WA WAARESEE
segs.en: Then, he said, “you are my brother and successor and inheritor.”
segs.ur: پھر فرمایا: یا علی تم میرے بھائی، وصی اور وارث ہو۔

segs.ar: لَحْمُكَ مِنْ لَحْمِىْ وَدَمُكَ مِنْ دَمِىْ
segs.tr: LAHMOKA MIN LAHMEE WA DAMOKA MIN DAMEE
segs.en: Your flesh is from my flesh And your blood from my blood
segs.ur: تمہارا گوشت میرے گوشت سے اور تمہارا خون میرے خون سے ہے

segs.tr: WA SILMOKA SILMEE WA HARBOKA HARBEE
segs.en: And peace with you is peace with me and fight with you is fight with me.
segs.ur: تمہاری صلح میری صلح ہے اور تمہاری جنگ میری جنگ ہے۔

segs.tr: WAL EEMAANO MOKHAALETUN LAHMAKA WA DAMAKA
segs.en: And the faith is mixed with your flesh and your blood
segs.ur: اور ایمان تمہاری رگوں میں شامل ہے

segs.tr: KAMAA KHAALATA LAHMEE WA DAMEE
segs.en: as it is mixed with my flesh and my blood
segs.ur: جیسے وہ میری رگوں میں شامل ہے

segs.tr: WA ANTA GHADAN A’LAL HAWZE KHALEEFATEE
segs.en: And tomorrow, you will be my successor at the Cistern Kausar Pond (Hawz of Kausar)
segs.ur: قیامت میں تم حوض کوثر پر میرے خلیفہ ہوگے

segs.tr: WA ANTA TAQZEE DAYNEE WA TUNJEZO E’DAATEE
segs.en: And you will repay my debt and you will fulfill my promises
segs.ur: تمہی میرے قرضے چکاؤ گے اور میرے وعدے نبھاؤ گے

segs.tr: WA SHEE-A’TOKA A’LAA MANAABERA MIN NOORIN
segs.en: And your shias (followers) will be (sitting) on the pulpits of light;
segs.ur: تمہارے شیعہ نورانی تختوں پر ہوں گے

segs.ar: مُبْيَضَّةً وُجُوْهُهُمْ حَوْلِىْ فِى الْجَنَّةِ وَهُمْ جِيْرَانِىْ
segs.tr: MUBYAZZATAN WOJOOHOHUM HAWLEE FIL JANNATE WA HUM JEERAANEE
segs.en: with bright faces surrounding me in the Heaven and they will be my neighbours.
segs.ur: جنت میں چمکتے چہروں کے ساتھ میرے آس پاس، اور وہ میرے قرب میں ہوں گے

segs.ar: وَلَوْلَا اَنْتَ يَا عَلِىُّ لَمْ يُعْرَفِ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ بَعْدِىْ
segs.tr: WA LAW-LAA ANTA YAA A’LIYYO LAM YOA’-RAFIL MO-MINOONA BA’-DEE
segs.en: And (he said), “O Ali, had you not been there, the believer would not have been recognized after me”
segs.ur: اور اے علی اگر تم نہ ہوتے تو میرے بعد مومنوں کی پہچان نہ ہو پاتی

segs.ar: وَكَانَ بَعْدَهٗ هُدًى مِّنَ الضَّلَالِ وَنُوْرًا مِّنَ الْعَمٰى
segs.tr: WA KAANA BA’-DAHU HODAN MENAZ ZALAALE WA NOORAN MENAL A’MAA
segs.en: And he was a guidance (to prevent people) from deviation after him (the Holy Prophet) and a light from the blindness
segs.ur: چنانچہ وہ آپ کے بعد گمراہی سے ہدایت میں لانے والے اور تاریکی سے روشنی میں لانے والے ہیں

segs.tr: WA HABLALLAAHIL MATEENA WA SERAATAHUL MUSTAQEEMA
segs.en: And the strong rope of Allah and His Right Path.
segs.ur: اور خدا کا مضبوط سلسلہ اور اس کا سیدھا راستہ ہیں

segs.tr: LAA YUSBAQO BEQARAABATIN FEE RAHEMIN
segs.en: Neither his Proximity in the ties of relationship (with the Holy Prophet) can be preceded (by anyone)
segs.ur: نہ قرابت پیغمبر میں کوئی ان سے بڑھا ہوا تھا

segs.tr: WA LAA BE-SAABEQATIN FEE DEENIN
segs.en: Nor his preceding in religion
segs.ur: نہ دین میں کوئی ان سے آگے تھا

segs.ar: وَلَا يُلْحَقُ فِىْ مَنْقَبَةٍ مِنْ مَنَاقِبِهٖ
segs.tr: WA LAA YULHAQO FEE MANQABATIN MIN MANAAQEBEHI
segs.en: And (no one) can overtake any virtues from amongst his (prophet) virtues.
segs.ur: اور ان کے اوصاف میں سے کسی وصف میں کوئی ان تک نہیں پہنچ سکتا

segs.tr: YAHZOO HAZWAR RASOOLE
segs.en: He (Ali) follows the path of the Messenger
segs.ur: وہ رسول کے مانند تھے

segs.tr: SALLALLAAHU A’LAYHEMAA WA AALEHEMAA
segs.en: May the blessings of Allah be upon both of them and their progeny.
segs.ur: علی و نبی اور ان کی آل پر خدا کی رحمت ہو

segs.tr: WA YOQAATELO A’LAT TAAWEELE
segs.en: And he fights on (the basis of) interpretation
segs.ur: علی نے تاویل قرآن پر جنگ کی

segs.ar: وَلَا تَاخُذُهٗ فِى اللهِ لَوْمَتُ لَآئِمٍ
segs.tr: WA LAA TAA-KHOZOHU FILLAAHE LAWMATO LAAA-EMIN
segs.en: And he cares not for any blame of any rebuker in the way of Allah
segs.ur: اور خدا کے معاملے میں کسی ملامت کرنے والے کی ملامت کی پرواہ نہ کی

segs.tr: QAD WATARA FEEHE SANAADEEDAL A’RABE
segs.en: For (the sake of) Him, he spilled the blood of the champions of the Arabs,
segs.ur: عرب سرداروں کو ہلاک کیا

segs.tr: WA QATALA ABTAALAHUM WA NAAWASHA ZOA-BAANAHUM
segs.en: killed their heroes and grappled with their wolves.
segs.ur: ان کے بہادروں کو قتل کیا اور ان کے پہلوانوں کو پچھاڑا

segs.ar: فَاَوْدَعَ قُلُوْبَهُمْ اَحْقَادًا بَدْرِيَّةً وَّخَيْبَرِيَّةً وَّحُنَيْنِيَّةً وَغَيْرَ هُنَّ
segs.tr: FA-AWDA-A’ QOLOOBAHUM AHQAADAN BADRIYYATAN WA KHAYBARIYYATAN WA HONAYNIYYATAN WA GHAYRA HUNNA
segs.en: Then he filled the hearts of them (fighters) of Badr, Khaibar, Hunain and of others  with a hatred and malice.
segs.ur: پس عربوں کے دلوں میں کینہ بھر گیا کہ بدر، خیبر، حنین وغیرہ میں ان کے لوگ قتل ہو گئے

segs.ar: فَاَضَبَّتْ عَلٰى عَدَاوَتِهٖ وَاَكَبَّتْ عَلٰى مُنَابَذَتِهٖ
segs.tr: FA-AZABBAT A’LAA A’DAAWATEHI WA AKABBAT A’LAA MONAABAZATEHI
segs.en: Then, (they) rose in enmity, against him, and (they) attacked to fight against him.
segs.ur: پس وہ علی کی دشمنی میں اکٹھے ہوئے اور ان کی مخالفت پر آمادہ ہو گئے

segs.tr: HATTAA QATALAN NAAKESEENA WAL QAASETEENA WAL MAAREQEENA
segs.en: Till (such time) that he killed the oath breakers of allegiance,  the unjust,  and the (Maareqeen) Renegades.
segs.ur: چنانچہ آپ نے بیعت توڑنے والوں، تفرقہ ڈالنے والوں اور ہٹ دھرمی کرنے والوں کو قتل کیا

segs.ar: وَلَمَّا قَضٰى نَحْبَهٗ وَقَتَلَهٗ اَشْقَى الْاٰخِرِيْنَ يَتْبَعُ اَشْقَى الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
segs.tr: WA LAMMAA QAZAA NAHBAHU WA QATALAHU ASHQAL AAKHEREENA YATBA-O’ ASHQAL AWWALEENA
segs.en: And when his term of life expired, a wretched person among those of the last epoch, following the path of those of the earlier period killed him.
segs.ur: جب آپ کا وقت پورا ہوا تو بعد والوں میں سے بدبخت ترین نے آپ کو قتل کیا اس نے پہلے والے شقی ترین کی پیروی کی

segs.ar: لَمْ يُمْتَثَلْ اَمْرُ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ
segs.tr: LAM YUMTASAL AMRO RASOOLILLAAHE SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI
segs.en: (the) order of the Messenger of Allah, peace of Allah be upon him and his Progeny,
segs.ur: رسول اللہ ﷺ کا فرمان پورا نہ ہوا

segs.tr: FIL HAADEENA BA’DAL HAADEENA
segs.en: was not obeyed about the leaders (Imams) one after the other.
segs.ur: جبکہ ایک رہبر کے بعد دوسرا رہبر آتا رہا

segs.ar: وَالْاُمَّةُ مُصِرَّةٌ عَلٰى مَقْتِهٖ مُجْتَمِعَةٌ عَلٰى قَطِيْعَةِ رَحِمِهٖ
segs.tr: WAL UMMATO MOSIRRATUN A’LAA MAQTEHI MUJTAME-A’TUN A’LAA QATEE-A’TE RAHEMEHI
segs.en: And the Ummah was insistent on bearing enmity against him. They joined together to cut off his ties of relations (Holy Prophet)
segs.ur: اور امت اس کی دشمنی پر شدت سے کمر بستہ ہو کر اس پر ظلم ڈھاتی رہی

segs.tr: WA IQSAA-E WULDEHI
segs.en: and throwing away his children (from successorship).
segs.ur: اور اس کی اولاد کو پریشان کرتی رہی

segs.ar: اِلَّا الْقَلِيْلَ مِمَّنْ وَفٰى لِرِعَايَةِ الْحَقِّ فِيْهِمْ
segs.tr: ILLAL QALEELA MIMMAN WAFAA LE-RE-A’A-YATIL HAQQE FEEHIM
segs.en: Except a few from then (believers) who remained faithful in observing their (Ahl-e-Bait’s) rights
segs.ur: مگر تھوڑے سے لوگ وفادار تھے اور ان کا حق پہچانتے تھے

segs.tr: FA-QOTELA MAN QOTELA
segs.en: Then some of them were killed
segs.ur: پس ان میں سے کچھ قتل ہوگئے

segs.tr: WA SOBEYA MAN SOBEYA
segs.en: And some were taken into captivity
segs.ur: کچھ قید میں ڈالے گئے

segs.tr: WA UQSEYA MAN UQSEYA
segs.en: And some were exiled.
segs.ur: اور کچھ بے وطن ہوئے

segs.ar: وَجَرَى الْقَضَآءُ لَهُمْ بِمَا يُرْجٰى لَهٗ حُسْنُ الْمَثُوْبَةِ
segs.tr: WA JARAL QAZAAA-O LAHUM BEMAA YURJAA LAHU HUSNUL MASOOBATE
segs.en: And the decree was to pass from them, with this hope that the best reward is in it.
segs.ur: ان پر قضا وارد ہو گئی جس پر وہ بہترین اجر کے امیدوار ہوئے

segs.tr: IZ KAANATIL ARZO LILLAAHE
segs.en: Since the Earth belongs to Allah.
segs.ur: کیونکہ زمین خدا کی ملکیت ہے

segs.tr: YOORESOHAA MAN YASHAAA-O MIN E’BAADEHI
segs.en: He gives to whomsoever He wishes from amongst His servants.
segs.ur: وہ اپنے بندوں میں سے جسے چاہے اس کا وارث بناتا ہے

segs.tr: WAL A’AQEBATO LIL-MUTTAQEENA
segs.en: And the end is (only) for those who guard against evil.
segs.ur: اور انجام کار پرہیزگاروں کیلئے ہے

segs.ar: وَسُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا اِنْ كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُوْلًا
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANA RABBENAA IN KAANA WA’DO RABBENAA LA MAFOOLAN
segs.en: And glorious in our Lord, Verily the promise of our Lord is certainly to be fulfilled.
segs.ur: اور پاک ہے ہمارا رب کہ ہمارے رب کا وعدہ پورا ہو کر رہتا ہے

segs.ar: وَلَنْ يُّخْلِفَ اللهُ وَعْدَهٗ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ
segs.tr: WA LANY YUKHLEFAL LAAHO WA’-DAHU WA HOWAL A’ZEEZUL HAKEEMO
segs.en: And Allah never goes against His promise; and He is the All-Mighty, All-Wise.
segs.ur: ہاں خدا اپنے وعدے کے خلاف نہیں کرتا وہ زبردست ہے حکمت والا

segs.ar: فَعَلَى الْاَطَائِبِ مِنْ اَهْلِ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلِىٍّ
segs.tr: FA-A’LAL ATAA-EBE MIN AHLE BAYTE MOHAMMADIN WA A’LIYYIN
segs.en: So upon the pure ones of the Household of Muhammad and Ali,
segs.ur: پس حضرت محمد و حضرت علی کے اہل بیت کے پاکیزہ افراد پر

segs.ar: صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِمَا وَاٰلِهِمَا فَلْيَبْكِ الْبَاكُوْنَ
segs.tr: SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHEMAA WA AALEHEMAA FAL-YABKIL BAAKOONA
segs.en: May Allah bless them both and their progeny; so let the weepers weep
segs.ur: کہ ان دونوں پر خدا کی رحمت ہو ان کے خاندان پر، رونے والوں کو رونا چاہیے

segs.tr: WA IYYAAHUM FAL-YANDOBIN NAADEBOONA
segs.en: And the wailers should wail upon them.
segs.ur: اور ان پر نوحہ کرنے والوں کو نوحہ کرنا چاہیے

segs.tr: WA LE-MISLEHIM FAL-TUZ-RAFID DOMOO-O’
segs.en: And for such people like them, then the tears should flow
segs.ur: اور ان جیسوں کیلئے آنسو بہائے جائیں

segs.tr: WAL YASROKHIS SAAREKHOONA
segs.en: And the clamourers should clamour
segs.ur: اور چیخنے والے دھاڑیں مار کر روئیں

segs.tr: WA YAZIJJAZ ZAAAJJOONA WA YA-I’JJAL A’AAJJOONA
segs.en: and the mourners should mourn in a heart rending manner:
segs.ur: رونے والے چیخ چیخ کر روئیں اور نالہ و فریاد بلند کریں

segs.ar: اَيْنَ الْحَسَنُ اَيْنَ الْحُسَيْنُ اَيْنَ اَبْنَآءُ الْحُسَيْنِ؟
segs.tr: AYNAL HASANO AYNAL HUSAYNO AYNA ABNAAA-UL HUSAYNE
segs.en: Where is Hasan? Where is Husain? Where are the children of Husain?
segs.ur: کہاں ہیں حسن، کہاں ہیں حسین، کہاں گئے فرزندان حسین

segs.ar: صَالِحٌ بَعْدَ صَالِحٍ وَصَادِقٌ بَعْدَ صَادِقٍ
segs.tr: SAALEHUN BA’-DA SAALEHIN WA SAADEQUN BA’-DA SAADEQIN
segs.en: The Righteous after righteous and truthful after truthful.
segs.ur: ایک نیک کردار کے بعد دوسرا نیک کردار، ایک سچے کے بعد دوسرا سچا

segs.tr: AYNAS SABEELO BA’-DAS SABEELE
segs.en: Where is the path after the path (of righteousness)?
segs.ur: کہاں گئے جو ایک کے بعد ایک راہ حق کے رہبر تھے

segs.tr: AYNAL KHEYARATO BA’-DAL KHEYARATE
segs.en: Where are the virtuous people after the virtuous ones?
segs.ur: کہاں گئے جو اپنے وقت میں خدا کے برگزیدہ تھے

segs.tr: AYNASH SHOMOOSUT TAALE-A’TO
segs.en: Where are the rising suns?
segs.ur: کدھر گئے وہ چمکتے سورج

segs.tr: AYNAL AQMAARUL MONEERATO
segs.en: Where are the luminous Moons?
segs.ur: کیا ہوئے وہ دمکتے چاند

segs.tr: AYNAL ANJOMUZ ZAAHERATO
segs.en: Where are the brilliant stars?
segs.ur: کہاں گئے وہ جھلملاتے ستارے

segs.tr: AYNA AA’-LAAMUD DEENE WA QAWAA-E’DUL I’LME
segs.en: Where are the Emblems of the Faith and the Basis of knowledge?
segs.ur: کدھر گئے وہ دین کے نشان اور علم کے ستون

segs.ar: اَيْنَ بَقِيَّةُ اللهِ الَّتِىْ لَا تَخْلُوْ مِنَ الْعِتْرَةِ الْهَادِيَةِ ؟
segs.tr: AYNA BAQIYYATULLAAHIL LATEE LAA TAKHLOO MENAL I’TRATIL HAADEYATE
segs.en: Where is the Baqi-at-Allah?  Which (the world) cannot be devoid from (the presence of) guided progeny?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے خدا کا آخری نمائندہ جو رہبروں کے اس خاندان سے باہر نہیں

segs.tr: AYNAL MO-A’DDO LE-QAT-E’ DAABERIZ ZALAMATE
segs.en: Where is the one ready to annihilate the oppressors?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو ظالموں کی جڑیں کاٹنے کیلئے آمادہ ہے

segs.tr: AYNAL MUNTAZARO LE-EQAAMATIL AMTE WAL E’WAJE
segs.en: Where is the Awaited one for straightening the crookedness and dishonesty?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو انتظار میں ہے کہ کج کو سیدھا اور نا درست کو درست کرے

segs.tr: AYNAL MURTAJAA LE-EZAALATIL JAWRE WAL U’DWAANE
segs.en: Where is the Expected (Imam Mahdi) for abolishing the oppression and transgression?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ امیدگاہ جو ظلم وستم کو مٹانے والا ہے

segs.tr: AYNAL MUDDAKHARO LE-TAJDEEDIL FARAA-EZE WAS SONANE
segs.en: Where is the one stored for reviving the obligatory command and the Sunnah (of the Holy Prophet)?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو فرائض اور سنن کو زندہ کرنے والا امام

segs.tr: AYNAL MOTAKHAYYARO LE-E-A’ADATIL MILLATE WASH SHAREE-A’T
segs.en: Where is the selected one for resuscitating (the reality) of the nation and the religion?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو ملت اور شریعت کو راست کرنے والا

segs.tr: AYNAL MO-AMMALO LE-EHYAAA-IL KETAABE WA HODOODEHI
segs.en: Where is the expected one for enlivening the Book and its limits?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جس کے ذریعے قرآن اور اس کے احکام کے زندہ ہونے کی توقع ہے

segs.tr: AYNA MOHYEE MA-A’ALEMID DEENE WA AHLEHI
segs.en: Where is the Enlivener of the precepts of religion and its adherents?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو دین اور اہل دین کے طریقے روشن کرنے والا

segs.tr: AYNA QAASEMO SHAWKATIL MOA’-TADEENA
segs.en: Where is the breaker of the might of the transgressors?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو ظالموں کا زور توڑنے والا

segs.tr: AYNA HAADEMO ABNIYYATISH SHIRKE WAN NEFAAQE
segs.en: Where is the demolisher of the edifices of polytheism and hypocrisy?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو شرک و نفاق کی بنیادیں ڈھانے والا

segs.ar: اَيْنَ مُبِيْدُ اَهْلِ الْفُسُوْقِ وَالْعِصْيَانِ وَالطُّغْيَانِ؟
segs.tr: AYNA MOBEDO AHLIL FOSOOQE WAL I’SYAANE WAT TUGH-YAANE
segs.en: Where is the destroyer of the followers of transgression, disobedience and rebellion?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو بدکاروں نافرمانوں اور سرکشوں کو تباہ کرنے والا

segs.tr: AYNA HAASEDO FUROO-I’L GHAYYE WASH SHEQAAQE
segs.en: Where is the Eradicator of branches of errors and disputes?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو گمراہی اور تفرقے کی شاخیں کاٹنے والا

segs.tr: AYNA TAAMESO AASAARIZ ZAYGHE WAL AHWAAA-E
segs.en: Where is the effacer of the traces of deviation and caprice?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو کج دلی و نفس پرستی کے داغ مٹانے والا

segs.tr: AYNA QAATE-O’ HABAAA ELIL KIZBE WAL IFTERAAA-E
segs.en: Where is the severer of the cords of falsehood and calumniation?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو جھوٹ اور بہتان کی رگیں کاٹنے والا

segs.tr: AYNA MOBEEDUL O’TAATE WAL MARADATE
segs.en: Where is the Destroyer of the vicious and disobedient people?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو سرکشوں اور مغروروں کو تباہ کرنے والا

segs.ar: اَيْنَ مُسْتَاْصِلُ اَهْلِ الْعِنَادِ وَالتَّضْلِيْلِ وَالْاِلْحَادِ؟
segs.tr: AYNA MUSTAA-SELU AHLIL E’NAADE WAT TAZLEELE WAL ILHAADE
segs.en: Where is the Eradicator of the followers of obstinacy and misguidance and the renegade?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو دشمنوں گمراہ کرنے والوں اور بے دینوں کی جڑیں اکھاڑنے والا

segs.tr: AYNA MO-I’ZZUL AWLEYAAA-E WA MOZILLUL AA’-DAA-E
segs.en: Where is the one who honours the friends and Debases the enemy?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو دوستوں کو باعزت اور دشمنوں کو ذلیل کرنے والا

segs.tr: AYNA JAAME-U’L KALEMATE A’LAT TAQWAA
segs.en: Where is the Accumulator of the words of piety?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو سب کو تقویٰ پر جمع کرنے والا

segs.ar: اَيْنَ بَابُ اللهِ الَّذِىْ مِنْهُ يُؤْتٰى؟
segs.tr: AYNA BAABUL LAAHIL LAZEE MINHO YOATAA
segs.en: Where is the Gate of Allah through which all should enter?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو خدا کا دروازہ جس سے وارد ہوں

segs.ar: اَيْنَ وَجْهُ اللهِ الَّذِىْ اِلَيْهِ يَتَوَجَّهُ الْاَوْلِيَآءُ؟
segs.tr: AYNA WAJHUL LAAHIL LAZEE ELAYHE YATAWAJJAHUL AWLEYAAA-O
segs.en: Where is the Countenance of Allah through which the friends attend towards him?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو مظہر خدا کہ جس کی طرف حبدار متوجہ ہوں

segs.ar: اَيْنَ السَّبَبُ الْمُتَّصِلُ بَيْنَ الْاَرْضِ وَالسَّمَآءِ؟
segs.tr: AYNAS SABABUL MUTASSELO BAYNAL ARZE WAS SAMAAA-E
segs.en: Where is the Means which is stretching from the Earth to the sky?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو زمین و آسمان کے پیوست رہنے کا وسیلہ

segs.ar: اَيْنَ صَاحِبُ يَوْمِ الْفَتْحِ وَنَاشِرُ رَايَةِ الْهُدٰى؟
segs.tr: AYNA SAAHEBO YAWMIL FATHE WA NAASHERO RAAYATIL HODAA
segs.en: Where is the Master of the Day of Victory and the one who will spread the flag of Guidance?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو یوم فتح کا حکمران اور ہدایت کا پرچم لہرانے والا

segs.tr: AYNA MO-ALLEFO SHAMLIS SALAAHE WAR REZAA
segs.en: Where is the uniter of the companions of virtue and divine pleasure?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو نیکی اور خوشنودی کے بکھرے شیرازے کو جوڑنے والا

segs.ar: اَيْنَ الطَّالِبُ بِذُحُوْلِ الْاَنْبِيَآءِ وَاَبْنَآءِ الْاَنْبِيَآءِ؟
segs.tr: AYNAT TAALEBO BE-ZOHOOLIL AMBEYAAA-E WA ABNAAA-IL AMBEYAAA-E
segs.en: Where is the Avenger of the blood of prophets and the children of the prophets?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو نبیوں کے خون اور نبیوں کی اولاد کے خون کا دعویدار

segs.tr: AYNAT TAALEBO BE-DAMIL MAQTOOLE BE-KARBALAA-A
segs.en: Where is the seeker of revenge for the blood of the Martyred ones of Karbala?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو کربلا کے مقتول حسین کے خون کا مدعی

segs.ar: اَيْنَ الْمَنْصُوْرُ عَلٰى مَنِ اعْتَدٰى عَلَيْهِ وَافْتَرٰى؟
segs.tr: AYNAL MANSOORO A’LAA MANEA’-TADAA A’LAYHE WAF-TARAA
segs.en: Where is the Truimphant one (who will overcome) over one who transgressed against him and maligned him?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو اس پر غالب ہے جس نے زیادتی کی اور جھوٹ باندھا

segs.ar: اَيْنَ الْمُضْطَرُّ الَّذِىْ يُجَابُ اِذَا دَعَا؟
segs.tr: AYNAL MUZTARRUL LAZEE YOJAABO EZAA DA-A’A
segs.en: Where is the distressed one who will be answered when he supplicates?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ پریشان کہ جب دعا مانگے قبول ہوتی ہے

segs.tr: AYNA SADRUL KHALAAA-EQE ZUL BIRRE WAT TAQWAA
segs.en: Where is the President of all creatures, who is both the beneficent and God fearing?
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو مخلوق کا حاکم جو نیک و پرہیز گار ہے

segs.tr: AYNABNUN NABIYYENIL MUSTAFAA
segs.en: Where is the son of the chosen (Al-Mustafa) prophet
segs.ur: کہاں ہے وہ جو نبی مصطفی کا فرزند

segs.tr: WABNO A’LIYYENIL MURTA-ZAA
segs.en: And the son of Ali al-Murtaza?
segs.ur: علی مرتضی کا فرزند

segs.tr: WABNO KHADEEJATAL GHARRAAA-E
segs.en: And the son of Khadijat-ul-Gharra (The Luminous)
segs.ur: خدیجہ پاک کا فرزند

segs.tr: WABNO FAATEMATAL KUBRAA
segs.en: And the son of Fatematul-Kubra (the Great)?
segs.ur: اور فاطمہ کبری کا فرزند

segs.ar: بِاَبِىْ اَنْتَ وَاُمِّىْ وَنَفْسِىْ لَكَ الْوِقَآءُ وَالْحِمٰى
segs.tr: BE-ABEE ANTA WA UMMEE WA NAFSEE LAKAL WEQAAA-O WAL HEMAA
segs.en: May my father and my mother and my self be sacrificed for your safety and protection
segs.ur: قربان آپ پر میرے ماں باپ اور میری جان آپ کیلئے فدا ہے

segs.tr: YABNAS SAADATIL MOQARRABEENA
segs.en: O son of the masters, the favourite ones.
segs.ur: اے خدا کے مقرب سرداروں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAN NOJABAAA-IL AKRAMEENA
segs.en: O son of the noble ones, the honoured ones.
segs.ur: اے پاک نسل بزرگواروں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAL HODAATIL MAHDIYYEENA
segs.en: O son of the guides and the divinely guided ones
segs.ur: اے ہدایت یافتہ رہبروں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAL KHIYARATIL MOHAZZABEENA
segs.en: O son of the preferred refined ones.
segs.ur: اے برگزیدہ اور خوش اطوار بزرگوں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAL GHATAAREFATIL ANJABEENA
segs.en: O son of the Magnanimous ones of the purest descent.
segs.ur: اے پاک نہاد سرداروں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAL ATAA-EBIL MOTAHHAREENA
segs.en: O son of the most righteous.
segs.ur: اے پاکبازوں پاک شدگان کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAL KHAZAAREMATIL MUNTAJABEENA
segs.en: O son of the benevolent selected ones.
segs.ur: اے پاک نژاد و سادات کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAL QAMAAQEMATIL AKRAMEENA
segs.en: O son of the generous honoured ones.
segs.ur: اے وسیع القلب عزت داروں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAL BODOORIL MONEERATE
segs.en: O son of the luminous moons.
segs.ur: اے روشن چاندوں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAS SOROJIL MOZEEE-ATE
segs.en: O son of the shinning lights.
segs.ur: اے روشن چراغوں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNASH SHOHOBIS SAAQEBATE
segs.en: O son of the piercing meteors.
segs.ur: اے روشن سیاروں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAL ANJOMIZ ZAAHERATE
segs.en: O son of the bright starts.
segs.ur: اے چمکتے ستاروں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAS SOBOLIL WAAZIHATE
segs.en: O son of the clear paths.
segs.ur: اے روشن راہوں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAL AA’-LAAMIL LAA-EHATE
segs.en: O son of the clear sings.
segs.ur: اے بلند مرتبے والوں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAL O’LOOMIL KAAMELATE
segs.en: O son of the perfect knowledge.
segs.ur: اے حاملین علوم کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAS SONANIL MASH-HOORATE
segs.en: O son of the well-known examples of conduct.
segs.ur: اے واضح روشوں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAL MA-A’ALEMIL MAASOORATE
segs.en: O son of the recorded knowledges.
segs.ur: اے مذکورہ علامتوں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAL MOA’-JEZAATIL MAWJOODATE
segs.en: O son of the living miracles.
segs.ur: اے معجز نماؤں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAL DALAAA-ELIL MASH-HOODATE
segs.en: O son of the obvious proofs.
segs.ur: اے ظاہر دلائل کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAS SERAATIL MUSTAQEEME
segs.en: O son of the straight path.
segs.ur: اے سیدھے راستے کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAN NABA-IL A’ZEEME
segs.en: O son of the mighty tidings.
segs.ur: اے عظیم خبر کے فرزند

segs.ar: يَابْنَ مَنْ هُوَ فِىْ اُمِّ الْكِتَابِ لَدَى اللهِ عَلِىٌّ حَكِيْمٌ
segs.tr: YABNA MAN HOWA FEE UMMIL KETAABE LADALLAAHE A’LIYYUN HAKEEMUN
segs.en: O son of the one who is pronounced the most exalted. The most wise in Ummul-kitab by Allah.
segs.ur: اے اس ہستی کے فرزند جو خدا کے ہاں ام الکتاب میں علی اور حکیم ہے

segs.tr: YABNAL AAYAATE WAL BAYYENAATE
segs.en: O son of the signs and the clear proofs.
segs.ur: اے واضح روشن آیات کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAD DALAAA-ELIZ ZAAHERAATE
segs.en: O son of the apparent proofs.
segs.ur: اے ظاہر دلائل کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAL BARAAHEENIL WAAZEHAATIL BAAHERAATE
segs.en: O son of the brilliant and clear proofs.
segs.ur: اے واضح و روشن تر دلائل کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAL HOJAJIL BAALEGHAATE
segs.en: O son of the conclusive evidences.
segs.ur: اے کامل حجتوں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAN NE-A’MIS SAABEGHAATE
segs.en: O son of the abundant bounties.
segs.ur: اے بہترین نعمتوں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNA TAA-HAA WAL MOHKAMAATE
segs.en: O son of Ta-ha and the clear verses.
segs.ur: اے طٰہٰ اور محکم آیتوں کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNA YAA-SEEN WAZ ZAAREYAATE
segs.en: O son of Ya-Sin  (Holy Prophet and his infallible progeny) and Zariyat  (the Scatterers)
segs.ur: اے یاسین و ذاریات کے فرزند

segs.tr: YABNAT TOORE WAL A’ADEYAATE
segs.en: O son of the Tur (mount) and Aadiyat (the charger).
segs.ur: اے طور اور عادیات کے فرزند

segs.ar: يَابْنَ مَنْ دَنٰى فَتَدَلّٰى فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ اَوْ اَدْنٰى
segs.tr: YABNA MAN DANAA FATADALLAA FAKAANA QAABA QAWSAYNE AW ADNAA
segs.en: O son of the one who drew near, then came closer, so he was at the measure of two bows or closer still,
segs.ur: اے اس ہستی کے فرزند جو نزدیک ہوئے تو اس سے مل گئے پس کمان کے دونوں سروں جتنے یا اس سے بھی نزدیک ہوئے

segs.tr: DONUWWAN WAQTERAABAN MENAL A’LIYYIL AA’-LAA
segs.en: This is the nearest position to the All-High.
segs.ur: علی اعلیٰ کے قریب ہو گئے

segs.ar: لَيْتَ شِعْرِىْ اَيْنَ اسْتَقَرَّتْ بِكَ النَّوٰى
segs.tr: LAYTA SHEA’REE AYNAS TAQARRAT BEKAN NAWAA
segs.en: Would that I know where your state of being far is settled.
segs.ur: اے کاش میں جانتا کہ اس دوری نے آپ کو کہاں جا ٹھہرایا

segs.ar: بَلْ اَىُّ اَرْضٍ تُقِلُّكَ اَوْ ثَرٰى
segs.tr: BAL AYYO ARZIN TOQILLOKA AW SARAA
segs.en: Or which, earth of soil has embraced you;
segs.ur: اور کس زمین میں اور کس خاک نے آپ کو اٹھا رکھا ہے

segs.ar: اَبِرَضْوٰى اَوْ غَيْرِهَا اَمْ ذِىْ طُوٰى؟
segs.tr: A-BE RAZWAA AW GHAYREHAA AM ZEE TOWAA
segs.en: Is it in the mountain of Razwa or the other (mountain) or in Zee-Towaa?
segs.ur: آپ مقام رضویٰ میں ہیں یا کسی اور پہاڑ پر ہیں یا وادی طویٰ میں

segs.ar: عَزِيْزٌ عَلَىَّ اَنْ اَرَى الْخَلْقَ وَلَا تُرٰي
segs.tr: A’ZEEZUN A’LAYYA AN ARAL KHALQA WA LAA TORAA
segs.en: It is intolerable for me that I see the people but do not see you.
segs.ur: یہ مجھ پر گراں ہے کہ مخلوق کو دیکھوں اور آپ کو نہ دیکھ پاؤں

segs.ar: وَلَا اَسْمَعُ لَكَ حَسِيْسًا وَّلَا نَجْوٰى
segs.tr: WA LAA ASMA-O’ LAKA HASEESAN WA LAA NAJWAA
segs.en: And, neither do I hear a sigh of breath nor (any) whispering from you.
segs.ur: نہ آپ کی آہٹ سنوں اور نہ سرگوشی

segs.ar: عَزِيْزٌ عَلَىَّ اَنْ تُحِيْطَ بِكَ دُوْنَىِ الْبَلْوٰى
segs.tr: A’ZEEZUN A’LAYYA AN TOHEETA BEKA DOONAYIL BALWAA
segs.en: It is intolerable for me that you are surrounded by calamities
segs.ur: مجھے رنج ہے کہ آپ تنہا سختی میں پڑے ہیں اور میں آپ کے ساتھ نہیں ہوں

segs.ar: وَلَا يَنَالُكَ مِنِّىْ ضَجِيْجٌ وَلَا شَكْوٰى
segs.tr: WA LAA YANAALOKA MINNEE ZAJEEJUN WA LAA SHAKWAA
segs.en: and that neither my plaintive cry nor my complaint reaches you.
segs.ur: اور میری آہ و زاری آپ تک نہیں پہنچ پاتی

segs.ar: بِنَفْسِىْ اَنْتَ مِنْ مُّغَيَّبٍ لَمْ يَخْلُ مِنَّا
segs.tr: BE-NAFSEE ANTA MIN MOGHAYYABIN LAM YAKH-LO MINNAA
segs.en: May (I) myself by sacrificed for you who seems to be concealed (physically), but not away from us.
segs.ur: میری جان آپ پر قربان کہ آپ غائب ہیں مگر ہم سے دور نہیں

segs.ar: بِنَفْسِىْ اَنْتَ مِنْ نَازِحٍ مَا نَزَحَ عَنَّا
segs.tr: BE-NAFSEE ANTA MIN NAAZEHIN MAA NAZAHA A’NNAA
segs.en: May (I) myself be sacrificed for you who seems to be emigrant (but) not far from us.
segs.ur: میں آپ پر قربان آپ وطن سے دور ہیں لیکن ہم سے دور نہیں

segs.ar: بِنَفْسِىْ اَنْتَ اُمْنِيَّةُ شَآئِقٍ يَتَمَنّٰى مِنْ مُؤْمِنٍ وَمُؤْمِنَةٍ ذَكَرٰى فَحَنَّا
segs.tr: BE-NAFSEE ANTA UMNIYYATO SHAA-EQIN YATAMANNAA MIN MOMININ WA MOMINATIN ZIKARAA FA-HANNAA
segs.en: May (I) myself be sacrificed for you who is the goal or aspirations of every faithful man and woman who desires you, remembers you and moans for you.
segs.ur: میں آپ پر قربان آپ ہر محب کی آرزو، ہر مومن و مومنہ کی تمنا ہیں جس کیلئے وہ نالہ کرتے ہیں

segs.ar: بِنَفْسِىْ اَنْتَ مِنْ عَقِيْدِ عِزٍّ لَا يُسَامٰى
segs.tr: BE-NAFSEE ANTA MIN A’QEEDE IZZIN LAA YOSAAMAA
segs.en: May (I) myself be sacrificed for you who is bound to lofty honour which can never be reached (by anyone).
segs.ur: میں قربان آپ وہ عزت دار ہیں جن کا کوئی ثانی نہیں

segs.ar: بِنَفْسِىْ اَنْتَ مِنْ اَثِيْلِ مَجْدٍ لَا يُجَارٰى
segs.tr: BE-NAFSEE ANTA MIN ASEELE MAJDIN LAA YOJAARAA
segs.en: May (I) myself be sacrificed for you whose original eminence cannot be equalled.
segs.ur: میں قربان آپ وہ بلند مرتبہ ہیں جن کے برابر کوئی نہیں

segs.ar: بِنَفْسِىْ اَنْتَ مِنْ تِلَادِ نِعَمٍ لَا تُضَاهٰى
segs.tr: BE-NAFSEE ANTA MIN TELAADE NE-A’MIN LAA TOZAAHAA
segs.en: May (I) myself by sacrificed for you who is the ancestral bounty which cannot be resembled.
segs.ur: میں قربان آپ وہ قدیمی نعمت ہیں جس کی مثل نہیں

segs.ar: بِنَفْسِىْ اَنْتَ مِنْ نَصِيْفِ شَرَفٍ لَا يُسَاوٰى
segs.tr: BE-NAFSEE ANTA MIN NASEEFE SHARAFIN LAA YOSAAWAA
segs.en: May (I) myself be sacrificed for you, the partaker of nobility, the like of which is not possible.
segs.ur: میں قربان آپ جو شرف رکھتے ہیں وہ کسی اور کو نہیں مل سکتا

segs.ar: اِلٰى مَتٰى اَحَارُ فِيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ؟
segs.tr: ELAA MATAA A-HAARO FEEKA YAA MAWLAAYA
segs.en: How long shall I remain bewildered about you, O my Master!
segs.ur: کب تک میں آپ کے لیے بے چین رہوں گا اے میرے آقا

segs.ar: وَاِلٰى مَتٰى وَاَىُّ خِطَآبٍ اَصِفُ فِيْكَ وَاَىُّ نَجْوٰى؟
segs.tr: WA ELAA MATAA WA AYYA KHETAABIN ASEFO FEEKA WA AYYA NAJWAA
segs.en: And how long, and with what words shall I describe you, and with what secret talk?
segs.ur: اور کب تک، اور کس طرح آپ سے خطاب کروں اور سرگوشی کروں

segs.ar: عَزِيْزٌ عَلَىَّ اَنْ اُجَابَ دُوْنَكَ وَاُنَاغٰى
segs.tr: A’ZEEZUN A’LAYYA AN OJAABA DOONAKA WA ONAAGHAA
segs.en: It is intolerable for me to talk and receive a reply from persons than you.
segs.ur: یہ مجھ پر گراں ہے کہ سوائے آپ کے کسی سے جواب پاؤں یا باتیں سنوں

segs.ar: عَزِيْزٌ عَلَىَّ اَنْ اَبْكِيَكَ وَيَخْذُلَكَ الْوَرٰى
segs.tr: AZEEZUN A’LAYYA AN ABKEYAKA WA YAKHZOLAKAL WARAA
segs.en: It is intolerable for me that I cry for you while all others forsake you.
segs.ur: مجھ پر گراں ہے کہ میں آپ کیلئے روؤں اور لوگ آپ کو چھوڑے رہیں

segs.ar: عَزِيْزٌ عَلَىَّ اَنْ يَجْرِىَ عَلَيْكَ دُوْنَهُمْ مَا جَرٰى
segs.tr: AZEEZUN A’LAYYA AN YAJREYA A’LAYKA DOONAHUM MAA JARAA
segs.en: It is intolerable for me that this (isolation) befalls you instead of befalling others.
segs.ur: مجھ پر گراں ہے کہ لوگوں کی طرف سے آپ پر گزرے جو گزرے

segs.ar: هَلْ مِنْ مُعِيْنٍ فَاُطِيْلَ مَعَهُ الْعَوَيْلَ وَالْبُكَاءَ؟
segs.tr: HAL MIN MO-E’ENIN FA-OTEELA MA-A’HUL A’WEELA WAL BOKAAA-A
segs.en: Is there any helper with whom I may prolong my lamentation and weeping.
segs.ur: تو کیا کوئی ساتھی ہے جس کے ساتھ مل کر آپ کے لیے گریہ و زاری کروں

segs.ar: هَلْ مِنْ جَزُوْعٍ فَاُسَاعِدَ جَزَعَهٗ اِذَا خَلَا؟
segs.tr: HAL MIN JAZOO-I’N A-OSAA-E’DA JAZA-A’HU EZAA KHALAA
segs.en: Is there any mourner with whom I may join when he mourns alone.
segs.ur: کیا کوئی بے تاب ہے کہ جب وہ تنہا ہو تو اس کے ہمراہ نالہ کروں

segs.ar: هَلْ قَذِيَتْ عَيْنٌ فَسَاعَدَتْهَا عَيْنِىْ عَلَى الْقَذٰى؟
segs.tr: HAL QAZEYAT A’YNUN FASAA-A’DAT-HAA A’YNEE A’LAL QAZAA
segs.en: Is there any eye that has shed tears, so that my eye may join it in weeping?
segs.ur: آیا کوئی آنکھ ہے جس کے ساتھ مل کر میری آنکھ غم کے آنسو بہائے

segs.ar: هَلْ اِلَيْكَ يَابْنَ اَحْمَدَ سَبِيْلٌ فَتُلْقٰى؟
segs.tr: HAL ELAYKA YABNA AHMADA SABEELUN FATULQAA
segs.en: O the son of Ahmad! Is there a way through which you may be met.
segs.ur: اے احمد مجتبی کے فرزند کیا آپ کے پاس آنے کا کوئی راستہ ہے

segs.ar: هَلْ يَتَّصِلُ يَوْمُنَا مِنْكَ بِعِدَةِ فَنَحْظٰى؟
segs.tr: HAL YATTASELO YAWMONAA MINKA BE-E’DATIN FA-NAHZAA
segs.en: May our day (of separation) join the day of reappearance by which we enjoy?
segs.ur: کیا ہمارا آج کا دن آپ کے کل سے مل جائے گا کہ ہم خوش ہوں

segs.tr: MATAA NAREDO MANAAHELAKAR RAWIYYATA FA-NARWAA
segs.en: When shall we arrive at your streams for drink, with which to quench our thirst for you?
segs.ur: کب وہ وقت آئے گا کہ ہم آپ کے چشمے سے سیراب ہوں گے

segs.ar: مَتٰى نَنْتَقِعُ مِنْ عَذْبِ مَآئِكَ فَقَدْ طَالَ الصَّدٰى؟
segs.tr: MATAA NANTAQE-O’ MIN A’ZBE MAAA-EKA FAQAD TAALAS SADAA
segs.en: When shall we get benefit of your sweet water, for already the thirst has lasted too long?
segs.ur: کب ہم آپ کے چشمہٴ شیریں سے پیاس بجھائیں گے، اب تو پیاس طولانی ہو گئی

segs.tr: MATAA NOGHAADEEKA WA NORAA-WEHOKA FA-NOQIRRO A’YNAN
segs.en: When shall we spend morning and evening with you to delight our eyes with a glance (at you)?
segs.ur: کب ہماری صبح و شام آپ کے ساتھ گزرے گی کہ ہماری آنکھیں ٹھنڈی ہوں گی

segs.ar: مَتٰى تَرَانَا وَنَرَاكَ وَقَدْ نَشَرْتَ لِوَآءَ النَّصْرِ تُرٰى؟
segs.tr: MATAA TARAANAA WA NARAAKA WA QAD NASHARTA LEWAAA-AN NASRE TORAA
segs.en: When shall you see us and we shall see you; then you shall be seen unfurling the flag of victor.
segs.ur: کب آپ ہمیں اور ہم آپ کو دیکھیں گے جبکہ آپ کی فتح کا پرچم لہراتا ہو گا

segs.ar: اَتَرَانَا نَحُفُّ بِكَ وَاَنْتَ تَاُمُّ الْمَلَاَ وَقَدْ مَلَاْتَ الْاَرْضَ عَدْلًا
segs.tr: A-TARAANAA NAHUFFO BEKA WA ANTA TA-UMMUL MALA-AWA QAD MALAA-TAL ARZA A’DLAN
segs.en: Will you see us gathered around you and you are leading all the people. Then already you have filled the earth with justice
segs.ur: کب ہم آپ کے ارد گرد جمع ہوں گے اور آپ سبھی لوگوں کے امام ہوں گے، تب زمین آپ کے ذریعے عدل و انصاف سے پر ہو گی

segs.tr: WA AZAQTA AA’-DAAA-EKA HAWAANAN WA E’QAABAN
segs.en: and have made your enemies taste the disgrace (of defeat) and retribution.
segs.ur: آپ اپنے دشمنوں کو سختی و ذلت سے ہمکنار کریں گے

segs.tr: WA ABARTAL O’TAATA WA JAHADATAL HAQQE
segs.en: And you have destroyed rebels and deniers of the truth.
segs.ur: آپ سرکشوں اور حق کے منکروں کو نابود کریں گے

segs.tr: WA QATA’-TA DAABERAL MOTAKABBEREENA
segs.en: And you have annihilated the last remains of the arrogant
segs.ur: اور مغروروں کا زور توڑ دیں گے

segs.tr: WAJ TASASTA OSOOLAZ ZAALEMEENA
segs.en: and uprooted the foundation of the unjust people.
segs.ur: اور ظلم کرنے والوں کی جڑیں کاٹ دیں گے

segs.tr: WA NAHNO NAQOOLO ‘AL-HAMDO LILLAAHE RABBIL A’ALAMEENA;
segs.en: Then we say: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.
segs.ur: اس وقت ہم کہیں گے حمد ہے خدا کیلئے جو جہانوں کا رب ہے

segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA ANTA KASHSHAAFUL KURBI WAL BALWAA
segs.en: O Allah You are the Remover of agonies and calamities.
segs.ur: اے معبود تو دکھوں اور مصیبتوں کو دور کرنے والا ہے

segs.tr: WA ELAYKA ASTA’-DEE FA-I’NDAKAL A’DWAA
segs.en: And You are the one from whom I seek help; then with you is the sanctuary.
segs.ur: میں تیرے حضور شکایت لایا ہوں کہ تو مداوا کرتا ہے

segs.tr: WA ANTA RABBUL AAKHERATE WAD DUNYAA
segs.en: And You are Lord of the Hereafter and this World;
segs.ur: اور تو ہی دنیا و آخرت کا پروردگار ہے

segs.ar: فَاَغِثْ يَا غِيَاثَ الْمُسْتَغِيْثِيْنَ عُبَيْدَكَ الْمُبْتَلٰى
segs.tr: FA-AGHIS YAA GHEYAASAL MUSTAGHEESEENA O’BAYDAKAL MUBTALAA
segs.en: So help O helper of those who seek help, your poor afflicted servant.
segs.ur: پس اے فریادیوں کی فریاد سننے والے، اپنے اس حقیر اور دکھی بندے کی فریاد سن

segs.tr: WA AREHI SAYYEDAHU YAA SHADEEDAL QOWAA
segs.en: And show him his Master, O Mighty in power,
segs.ur: اور اسے اس آقا کا دیدار کرا دے، اے زبردست قوت والے

segs.tr: WA AZIL A’NHO BEHIL ASAA WAL JAWAA
segs.en: And through him (Imam a.s.) remove his (Your servant’s) grief and sorrow.
segs.ur: اور ان کے واسطے سے اس کے رنج و غم کو دور فرما

segs.ar: وَبَرِّدْ غَلِيْلَهٗ يَا مَنْ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوٰى
segs.tr: WA BARRID GHALEELAHU YAA MAN A’LAL A’RSHIS-TAWAA
segs.en: And cool the burning of his hurt, O You who is firm in the Heavenly throne of power
segs.ur: اور اس کی پیاس بجھا دے اے وہ ذات جو عرش پر حاوی ہے

segs.tr: WA MAN ELAYHIR RUJ-A’A WAL MUNTAHAA
segs.en: and towards Whom is the return and ultimate end.
segs.ur: کہ جس کی طرف واپسی اور آخری ٹھکانا ہے

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَنَحْنُ عَبِيْدُكَ التَّائِقُوْنَ اِلٰى وَلِيِّكَ الْمُذَكِّرِ بِكَ وَبِنَبِيِّكَ
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WA NAHNO A’BEEDOKAT TAAA-EQOONA ELAA WALIYYEKAL MOZAKKERE BEKA WA BE-NABIYYEKA
segs.en: O Allah! We are Your enamoured servants of Your appointed regent who reminds us of You and Your Prophet (s.a.w.a.).
segs.ur: اور اے معبود ہم ہیں تیرے حقیر بندے جو تیرے ولی عصر کے مشتاق ہیں جو تیری اور تیرے نبی کی یاد دلانے والے ہیں

segs.tr: KHALAQTAHU LANAA I’SMATAN WA MALAAZAA
segs.en: He whom You created for us as our saviour and defender,
segs.ur: تو نے انہیں ہماری جائے پناہ بنایا ہمارا سہارا قرار دیا

segs.tr: WA AQAMTAHOO LANAA QEWAAMAN WA MA-A’AZAN
segs.en: and set him for us as a protector and refuge.
segs.ur: اور ان کو ہماری زندگی کا ذریعہ اور پناہ گاہ بنایا

segs.tr: WA JA-A’LTAHU LIL MOMINEENA MINNAA EMAAMAN
segs.en: And appoint him a leader (Imam) for the true believers amongst us.
segs.ur: اور ان کو ہم میں سے مومنوں کا امام قرار دیا

segs.tr: FA-BALLIGHHO MINNAA TAHIYYATAN WA SALAAMAN
segs.en: So convey to him our greetings and salutations.
segs.ur: پس ان کو ہمارا درود و سلام پہنچا

segs.tr: WA ZIDNAA BE ZAALEKA YAA RABBE IKRAAMAN
segs.en: And increase honour because of this (greeting) O Lord.
segs.ur: اور اے پروردگار ان کے ذریعے ہماری عزت میں اضافہ فرما

segs.tr: WAJ-A’L MUSTAQARRAHU LANAA MUSTAQARRAN WA MOQAAMAN
segs.en: And make his abode (in paradise) also a home and lasting place for us.
segs.ur: ان کی قرار گاہ کو ہماری قرار گاہ اور ٹھکانہ بنا دے

segs.tr: WA ATMIM NEA’-MATAKA BE-TAQDEEMEKA IYYAAHO AMAAMANAA
segs.en: And complete Your favours by appointing him as our guide.
segs.ur: ہم پر ان کی امامت کے ذریعے ہمارے لیے اپنی نعمت پوری فرما

segs.ar: حَتّٰى تُوْرِدَنَا جِنَانَكَ وَمُرَافَقَةِ الشُّهَدَآءِ مِنْ خُلَصَآئِكَ
segs.tr: HATTAA TOOREDANAA JENAANAKA WA MORAAFAQATASH SHO-HADAAA-E MIN KHOLASAAA-EKA
segs.en: Till You make us enter Your Paradise and the companionship of the martyrs from among Your sincere ones.
segs.ur: یہاں تک کہ تو ہمیں اپنی جنت میں ان شہیدوں کے پاس لے جائے جو مقرب خاص ہیں

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN
segs.en: O Allah! Bestow your blessings upon Mohammad and the progeny of Mohammad.
segs.ur: اے معبود! محمد و آل محمد پر رحمت نازل فرما

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ جَدِّهٖ وَرَسُوْلِكَ السَّيِّدِ الْاَكْبَرِ
segs.tr: WA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN JADDEHI WA RASOOLEKAS SAYYEDIL AKBARE
segs.en: And bless his grandfather Mohammad and Your Messenger the elder Master.
segs.ur: اور امام مہدی کے نانا محمد پر رحمت فرما جو تیرے رسول اور عظیم سردار ہیں

segs.tr: WA A’LAA ABEEHIS SAYYEDIL ASGHARE
segs.en: And upon his father (Ali) the younger Master.
segs.ur: اور مہدی کے والد پر رحمت کر جو چھوٹے سردار ہیں

segs.ar: وَجَدَّتِهِ الصِّدِّيْقَةِ الْكُبْرٰى فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.tr: WA JADDATEHIS SIDDEEQATIL KUBRAA FAATEMATA BINTE MOHAMMADIN
segs.en: And his grandmother, the great truthful daughter of Mohammad (s.a.w.a.)
segs.ur: اور ان کی دادی صدیقہٴ کبری فاطمہ بنت محمد پر رحمت فرما

segs.ar: وَعَلٰى مَنِ اصْطَفَيْتَ مِنْ اٰبَآئِهِ الْبَرَرَةِ
segs.tr: WA A’LAA MANIS TAFAYTA MIN AABAAA-EHIL BARARATE
segs.en: And upon whom you have selected from among his virtuous ancestors.
segs.ur: اور ان سب پر رحمت فرما جن کو تو نے ان کے نیک بزرگوں میں سے چنا

segs.ar: وَعَلَيْهِ اَفْضَلَ وَاَكْمَلَ وَاَتَمَّ وَاَدْوَمَ وَاَكْثَرَ وَاَوْفَرَ
segs.tr: WA A’LAYHE AFZALA WA AKMALA WA ATAMMA WA ADWAMA WA AKSARA WA AWFARA
segs.en: And on him (Imam a.s.) (bestow) the best, the plentiful, the most perfect, the everlasting, the most and the numerous (blessings)
segs.ur: اور القائم پر رحمت فرما بہترین، کامل، پوری، ہمیشہ ہمیشہ، بہت سی، بہت زیادہ

segs.ar: مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى اَحَدٍ مِّنْ اَصْفِيَآئِكَ وَخِيَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.tr: MAA SALLAYTA A’LAA AHADIN MIN ASFEYAAA-EKA WA KHEYARATEKA MIN KHALQEKA
segs.en: (as) whatever You bestowed on any of Your chosen and elect ones from among Your creatures.
segs.ur: جو رحمت کی ہو تو نے اپنے برگزیدوں میں سے کسی پر اور مخلوق میں سے اپنے پسند کردہ پر

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلوٰةً لَا غَايَةَ لِعَدَدِهَا
segs.tr: WA SALLE A’LAYHE SALAATAN LAA GHAAYATA LE-A’DADEHAA
segs.en: And favour him with endless count of blessings
segs.ur: اور اس پر درود بھیج وہ درود جس کا شمار نہ ہوسکے

segs.ar: وَلَا نِهَايَةَ لِمَدَدِهَا وَلَا نَفَادَ لِاَمَدِهَا
segs.tr: WA LAA NEHAAYATA LE-MADADEHAA WA LAA NAFAADA LE-AMADEHAA
segs.en: which never gets end nor limitation.
segs.ur: جس کی مدت ختم نہ ہو اور جو کبھی منقطع نہ ہو

segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WA AQIM BEHIL HAQQA
segs.en: O Allah! And through him set up the truth
segs.ur: اے معبود! ان کے ذریعے حق کو قائم فرما

segs.ar: وَاَدْحِضْ بِهِ الْبَاطِلَ وَاَدِلْ بِهٖ اَوْلِيَآئَكَ
segs.tr: WA ADHIZ BEHIL BAATELA WA ADIL BEHI AWLEYAAA-AKA
segs.en: And make the falsehood vanished through him. And prepare the victory of Your friends,
segs.ur: ان کے ہاتھوں باطل کو مٹا دے، ان کے وجود سے اپنے دوستوں کو عزت دے

segs.tr: WA AZLIL BEHI AA’-DAAA-AKA
segs.en: And disgrace Your enemies through him.
segs.ur: ان کے ذریعے اپنے دشمنوں کو ذلت دے

segs.ar: وَصِلِ اللّٰهُمَّ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهٗ وُصْلَةً تُؤَدِّىْ اِلٰى مُرَافَقَتِ سَلَفِهٖ
segs.tr: WA SELIL LAAHUMMA BAYNANAA WA BAYNAHU WUSLATAN TO-ADDEE ELAA MORAAFAQATE SALAFEHI
segs.en: O Allah, set a relationship between us and him that grants us the honour of the company of his ancestors.
segs.ur: اور اے معبود ہمیں اور ان کو اکٹھے کر دے، ایسا اکٹھا کہ جو ہم کو ان کے پہلے بزرگوں تک پہنچائے

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يَاْخُذُ بِحُجْزَتِهِمْ وَيَمْكُثُ فِىْ ظِلِّهِمْ
segs.tr: WAJ-A’LNAA MIMMAN YAA-KHOZO BE-HUJZATEHIM WA YAMKOSO FEE ZILLEHIM
segs.en: And let us be of those who seek their company and reside in their shelter.
segs.ur: اور ہمیں ان میں قرار دے جنہوں نے ان کا دامن پکڑا ہے اور ہمیں ان کے زیر سایہ رکھ

segs.ar: وَاَعِنَّا عَلٰى تَاْدِيَةِ حُقُوْقِهٖ اِلَيْهِ وَالْاِجْتِهَادِ فِىْ طَاعَتِهٖ
segs.tr: WA A-I’NNAA A’LAA TAA-DEYATE HOQOOQEHI ELAYHE WAL IJTEHAADE FEE TAA-A’TEHI
segs.en: And help us in fulfilling our dues to him and in striving hard to his obedience
segs.ur: ان کے حقوق ادا کرنے میں ہماری مدد فرما اور ان کی فرمانبرداری میں کوشاں بنا دے

segs.tr: WAJ TENAABE MA’-SEYATEHI
segs.en: and to avoid disobeying him.
segs.ur: اور ان کی نافرمانی سے بچائے رکھ

segs.tr: WAM-NUN A’LAYNAA BE-REZAAHO
segs.en: And grant us his pleasure
segs.ur: ان کی خوشنودی سے ہم پر احسان کر

segs.ar: وَهَبْ لَنَا رَاْفَتَهٗ وَرَحْمَتَهٗ وَدُعَآئَهٗ وَخَيْرَهٗ
segs.tr: WA HAB LANAA RAA-FATAHU WA RAHMATAHU WA DO-A’AA-AHU WA KHAYRAHU
segs.en: and bestow on us his affection and his compassion and his supplication and his goodness
segs.ur: اور ہمیں ان کی محبت، ان کی رحمت، ان کی دعا اور ان کی برکت عطا فرما

segs.ar: مَا نَنَالُ بِهٖ سَعَةً مِّنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَفَوْزًا عِنْدَكَ
segs.tr: MAA NANAALO BEHI SA-A’TAN MIN RAHMATEKA WA FAWZAN I’NDAKA
segs.en: Whereby through him we may receive the vastness of Your Mercy and Success with You
segs.ur: جس کے ذریعے ہم تیری وسیع رحمت اور تیرے ہاں کامیابی حاصل کریں

segs.tr: WAJ-A’L SALAATANAA BEHI MAQBOOLATAN
segs.en: And for his sake let our prayers be accepted
segs.ur: ان کے ذریعے ہماری نماز قبول فرما

segs.tr: WA ZONOOBANAA BEHI MAGHFOORATAN
segs.en: And for his sake let our sins be forgiven
segs.ur: ان کے وسیلے ہمارے گناہ بخش دے

segs.tr: WA DO-A’AA-ANAA BEHI MUSTAJAABAN
segs.en: And for his sake let our requests be granted
segs.ur: ان کے واسطے سے ہماری دعا منظور فرما

segs.tr: WAJ-A’L ARZAAQANAA BEHI MABSOOTATAN
segs.en: And for his sake let our sustenance be abundant
segs.ur: اور ان کے ذریعے سے ہماری روزیاں فراخ کر دے

segs.tr: WA HOMOOMANAA BEHI MAKFIYYATAN
segs.en: And for his sake let our sadness be relieved
segs.ur: ہماری پریشانیاں دور فرما

segs.tr: WA HAWAAA-EJANAA BEHI MAQZIYYATAN
segs.en: And for his sake let our wants be granted
segs.ur: اور ان کے وسیلے سے ہماری حاجات کو پورا فرما

segs.tr: WA AQBIL ELAYNAA BE-WAJHEKAL KAREEME
segs.en: And Your turn to us through Your Honoured face
segs.ur: اور توجہ کر ہماری طرف اپنی ذات کریم کے واسطے سے

segs.tr: WAQ-BAL TAQARROBANAA ELAYKA
segs.en: And accept our proximity with you.
segs.ur: اور قبول فرما اپنی بارگاہ میں ہماری حاضری

segs.tr: WAN-ZUR ELAYNAA NAZRATAN RAHEEMATAN
segs.en: And cast upon us Your merciful look,
segs.ur: ہماری طرف نظر کر، مہربانی کی نظر

segs.tr: NASTAKMELO BEHAL KARAAMATA I’NDAKA
segs.en: through which our achievement of honour from you may be perfected;
segs.ur: کہ جس سے تیری درگاہ میں ہماری عزت بڑھ جائے

segs.tr: SUMMA LAA TASRIF-HAA A’NNAA BE-JOODEKA
segs.en: Then never deprive us of it by Your generosity.
segs.ur: پھر اپنے کرم کی وجہ سے وہ نظر ہم سے نہ ہٹا

segs.ar: وَاسْقِنَا مِنْ حَوْضِ جَدِّهٖ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهٖ
segs.tr: WAS-QENAA MIN HAWZE JADDEHI SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI
segs.en: And quench our thirst from the cistern of his (Imam a.s.) grandfather, may Allah bless him and his progeny,
segs.ur: ہمیں القائم کے نانا کے حوض سے سیراب فرما، ان پر اور ان کی آل پر خدا کی رحمت ہو

segs.ar: بِكَاْسِهٖ وَبِيَدِهٖ رَيًّا رَوِيًّا هَنِيْٓئًا سَآئِغًا
segs.tr: BEKAA-SEHI WA BE-YADEHI RAYYAN RAWIYYAN HANEE-AN SAAA-EGHAN
segs.en: in his own cup and from his own hand. A sweet, cool, clear, agreeable drink
segs.ur: ان کے جام سے اور ان کے ہاتھ سے سیر و سیراب کر جس میں مزہ آئے

segs.ar: لَا ظَمَاَ بَعْدَهٗ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
segs.tr: LAA ZAMA-A BA’-DAHU YAA ARHAMAR RAAHEMEENA
segs.en: after which no thirst is felt. O Most Merciful of All.
segs.ur: اور پھر پیاس نہ لگے، اے سب سے زیادہ رحم والے۔

E34.merits:
“Say: My lord would not care for you were it not your prayer.”

One of the true and authentic feelings of mankind which has an innate root in the nature of man is paying attention to Dua and spiritual relation with the unseen world and the origin of creation.

This is a matter which even the famous psychologists have not neglected it. Although the necessity of Dua is present in the nature of man hut it manifests itself more during calamities and misfortunes from materialistic forces. Human being, without any will and option turns himself towards the All-Powerful Allah with all his might and energy; And he asks His help and protection. Dua is the weapon of a Mo’min. It lightens the pressures of misfortunes and difficulties and above all, it showers upon the human being the boundless mercy of the All-Truth (Allah).

Like other matters, even in the method of Dua, human being is in need of reasonable and rational guidance so that this natural feeling which is necessary for the soul does not mislead him. And it does not become a means and pretext for the cheaters and imposters. With the correct method of its usage, the thirst of the conscience of man gets quenched and finds his intended destination.

When the radiating sun of Islam glittered the Earth and the curtains of superstition were ripped off, its rich resources altered all aspects of individual, social, spiritual, material, and moral affairs of human life. Dua was also amongst the things which were covered by this transformation. Its program is so laid that can be understood as worthy of the affairs of every progressive human being and the true worshipper of Allah.

Islamic Duas and Ziaraat other than their sacred, holy and divine aspects are the big and comprehensive treasures full of humanistic concepts. Invocating them like attending a training course leaves a very deep and good impression on our personality, the reason being that their interesting meaningful texts are narrated directly from our prophet (s.a.w.a.) and his infallible progeny in which they have taught various lessons about the sublime learning of Monotheism, Resurrection, Prophethood, Wilayat, moral sense, laws and ethics. Indeed, the school of Dua is one of the high schools which is having a great effect in the development of human thinking, spiritual and social growth, of course if it is correctly used. Till the Muslims do not pass this school, their Islamic personality will not become perfect. The school is day and night open for everybody and the repetition of its lessons will always make the person ascend from one stage to another.

One of these treasures which, always the believers and those anxious for the reappearance of the righteous and universal Government of Hazrat Baqi-at-Allah (May Allah hasten his Reappearance), have set it as their slogan is the glorious Dua Nudba. They renew their allegiance with their Master during fixed occasions and establish emotional gatherings for reading it.

Nudba (lamentation) and wailing for visiting his Holiness, the coming to an end of his Occultation, pray for hastening his reappearance and expressing regret upon the prevalent turbulent and oppressive condition of today’s world (the Period of Occultation) is a lesson which the Shias have learnt from their Imams (a.s.) and their behaviour is a pattern for their partisans.

Sudair-e-Sairafi, a distinguished companion of Imam Jafar-e-Sadiq (a.s.) says that along with three other companions, they visited Imam (a.s.). They saw Imam (a.s.) in a very sad and sorrowful condition sitting on the ground. Like a mother who has lost her dear son and with a painful heart, Imam (a.s.) was crying, wailing, Moaning and saying:

“My master, your occultation has snatched away sleep from my eyes, has taken my concentration and has deprived tranquillity from my heart.

My master, your occultation has surrounded with a tragic suffering due to which I can never find sympathy and consolation. Due to the loss of friends one after the other, our gathering is breaking.

Calamities, hardships, difficulties and disasters have so much pained my heart that I do not feel the tears of my eyes and the yelling’s and crying’s of my heart. Yet other severe and unbearable sufferings are imagined that one more difficult and fragile than the one before it.” Sudair says:

Calamity struck us and our hearts became full of sadness and sorrow for Imam (a.s.). We presumed that an unpleasant event has made Imam (a.s.) – this mountain of patience and forbearance in such a lamenting and mournful condition. We said:

“O Son of the best mankind, May Allah not make you cry. For what circumstances are you weeping in such a manner His holiness heaved a sad sigh from his afflicted heart and said:

“This morning, when I was looking at “the book of Jafr”, the book of knowledge of various predicts, until Qiyamat, which has been assigned and made exclusive to Hazrat Mohammad (s.a.w.a.) and his successors (a.s.). It contains the birth, occultation, delay in reappearance, longevity of Hazrat Mahdi (a.t.f.s.), sufferings of believers during occultation, doubts and uncertainties which arise in their hearts due to the prolongation of Occultation , a majority of them leave aside Islam and our wilayat and do not mind about religion. Due to thinking on these things grief and sadness has overpowered me.

Therefore, with considering the behaviour of Imam (a.s.) regarding the Occultation of Hazrat Mahdi (a.s.), we should also become sad and depressed; and express our wish and interest in his reappearance by seeking shelter .towards Allah and reciting Dua, bearing in mind that if He (Allah) wishes, He can rectify the Occultation of Imam (a.s.) in one night itself.

Dua Nudba is one of the most important and famous authentic Duas of Shia. It’s stability in text, vocabulary and meaningful subjects increase the credibility of its document. This Dua has been narrated by the great Sayyed, the late Razi-ud-Din Ali Ibn-e-Taoos who was from amongst the great Shia scholars of the seventh century. He has narrated in his great books of “Iqbal” pp. 295-299 and the seventh chapter of ‘Misbaah-uz-Zaaer’. Before him, the great sheikh, Mohammad Ibn-e-Jafar-e- Mashadi Haeri who was amongst the great Shia scholars of the sixth century. He has narrated it in his book of ‘Mazaar’ Dua number 107. Prior to these two, Qutb-e- Rawandi who was also amongst the great Shia scholars of the fifth century has written this Dua in his book of ‘Mazaar’. And before all these three persons, the great Shaikh, Mohammad ibn-e-Ali-Ibn-e-Abi Qirra who also was amongst the great Shia scholars of the fifth century has brought it in his book. This book was used by the later scholars. He narrates it from the great and honourable Shaikh, Mohammad Ibn-e-Husain-e-Bazoofari, one of the former learned teacher from whom Shaikh Mufeed was narrating. Bazoofari in his own chain of narrations does not quote its narrators due to its fame and great reputation, he has narrated the Dua from Imam Zaman (a.t.f.s.). He has declared its recitation as a ‘Mustahab Dua’ on four Idds; Jumah, Fitr, Qurban and Ghadeer. Allama Majilisi (May Allah he satisfied with him) also has narrated this Dua in his book of ‘Behaar-ul-Anwaar’ and ‘Zaad-ul-Maad’ from Sayyed Ibn-e-Taoos from the book of Mazaar-e-Mashadi, from Ibn-e-Abu Qirra, from Mohammad Ibn-e-Husain Bazoofari. He testifies to the credibility of its document.

Therefore, it is necessary that on Friday mornings which is considered as one of the four Idds and the time for the recitation of this great Dua, and during the other mentioned days, in a mass and bewail, with concentrating our mind, asking forgiveness and reciting Salawat, We wash away our sins and remove the obstacles which has stopped the granting of our Duas. Then with a full attention, weeping and moaning state, we call Imam (a.s.) in the same way as Sudair has narrated it from our Sixth Imam, Hazrat Sadiq (a.s.). We cry and recite Nudbah upon the occultation and being far away from Imam (a.s.). We request Allah to hasten his reappearance and thus ends the corruption, persecution and injustice which is reigning in this world due to the absence of Imam (a.s.). May the Almighty Allah has mercy upon our Nudba and moaning. He may have mercy upon a weeping from amongst the weeping’s and will remove the chastisement of Occultation from amongst us. Thus, He may give us the grace and favour of the presence of Imam (a.s.) once more.

With His Grace and Benevolence May Allah desire so.

after.10: In the name of Allah, The Beneficent, The Merciful Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds. And blessings of Allah and peace be on our Chief Muhammad, His Prophet, and on his children. O my Allah! (All) praise is for Thee for that which Thou decided upon and resolved in the matter of Thy friends, whom Thou purified for Thyself and Thy religion. When wisdom and high rank from Thee, prostrated themselves in adoration before them (from the Bountiful Preserving Lord), for whom neither there was any decreased, nor dispersion thereafter, then Thou stipulated for them piety and righteousness. While they were in this mean and crooked world, free from its pomp, vanity and false enjoyments, Thy overreaching authority made known their identity; and equipped them with sincerity and perfection stood surety for them and communicated intimately with them, sent the news of their auspicious arrival in advance, and praised them in clear terms for the benefit of one and all.
after.14: Fell down on the ground in prostration Thy Angels before them, Thou chose them to reveal Thy Words, gave them Thy wisdom as a gift, set them up as the (only) medium to reach Thee, the only means to the eternal land of peace and happiness. One dwelled in Paradise until Thou sent him on (as the first Prophet).
after.16: One was made to cruise the "Ark", and had been rescued, and kept safe from destruction through Thy mercy.
after.19: One was chosen and prepared for Thy Mission, as (Thy) Friend, (who) made a request to Thee for a good report in (his) later generations, so Thou approved and complied with, exalted them and gave them authority.
after.24: One was spoken directly through the Tree, his brother was appointed his successor and helper. One was brought in without a father, was given clear proofs, and was supported with the Holy Spirit.
after.33: For each Thou prescribed a Divine law, and set up a traced out path, each was appointed a guardian- executor, (and each) fulfilled the duty after being kept safe and protected, in the term of establishing Thy religion, a witness and argument over Thy servants (mankind), Lest the truth staggered from its firm stand and foundation, and the falsehood conquered the hearts of the people, and might not say a single man: "If only Thou had sent a Messenger unto us as a Warner, to show us the path of wisdom and guidance, so that we might have followed Thy revelations before we were (thus) humbled and disgraced!" Then Thou made plans to bring out the wonderful advent of Muhammad, (Send blessing on him and on his children).
after.45: So Thou just as chose him master of Whosoever Thou created, made him (whom Thou Selected), pure, clean and the best, exalted and praised him (whom Thou elected), surpassed in generosity and liberality while bestowing high- mindedness and beneficence upon him (whom Thou took in confidence and relied upon); made him leader- in-chief of (all) thy Prophets, and sent him to the troubled world of men and jinn, among Thy servants, lowered and humbled before him the Easts and the Wests, under his total control was brought all affairs, exalted his soul in Thy heavens gave over to him the knowledge of what took place and what will happen, concerning facts and operation of creation.
after.50: Then invested him with awe and majesty, Jibraeel, Meekaaeel, and distinguished Angels stood around; him at his beck and call, gave Thy word to him that Thou would make his religion prevail over all religions, however much the idolaters may be averse.
after.55: Thereafter acknowledged his atonement and provided good and perfection for his children, allotted for him and his children the first sanctuary appointed for mankind, at Becca (Mecca), a blessed place, a guidance to the people, wherein are plain and clear signs; the place where Ibraahim stood up to pray, and whosoever enters it is safe.
after.58: Thou said: "Allah’s wish is but to remove uncleanness far from you, O "People of the House", and purify you with a thorough purification." Thereupon Thou settled conclusively fee (recompense) of Muhammad (Thy blessings be on him and on his children) love for them, in Thy Holy Book.
after.60: So Thou said: "Say (O Muhammad): I ask of you no fee (recompense) therefore, save love of (my) Kinsfolk." And Thou said: "Whatever recompense (return) I have asked for you, (it) is only for yourselves."
after.63: And Thou said: "I ask of you no reward for this, save that, whoso will, chooses a way unto his Lord." Therefore they are the (only) means to (approach) Thee, the (only) medium to get Thy favours.
after.71: So Thou certainly did not let his hard work go waste, and gave authority to his successor, Ali ibne Abi Taalib, (Thy blessings be on them both, and on this children), a guide. At the time when he was made a warner and a guide for every people, said he (the Holy Prophet), their Guide, in a public meeting overflowing with people; "Of Whomsoever I am the Mawlaa (Lord, Master) Ali is his Mawlaa. O Allah! be a friend of him who is a friend of him, be an enemy of him who is an enemy of him, help that man who helps him, forsake that man who forsakes him" and said: "Of whosoever I am the Prophet Ali is his Chief."
after.75: And said: "I and Ali are (one basic root of) a tree, and the rest of mankind are like diverse plants, he proclaims the position (relationship) of Haaroon to Moosaa." Therefore he told him: "I am to you as Moosaa was to Haaroon, but certainly there is no Prophet after me."
after.78: His (Ali’s) life partner was his (Muhammad’s) daughter the chief of the women of the worlds. Lawful was for him (Ali), in "the mosque", that which was permitted to him (Muhammad), all doors were closed, except his door.
after.80: He (Muhammad) gave his knowledge and wisdom into his (Ali’s) keeping. He said: "I am the city (center) of knowledge and Ali is its gate.
after.90: Whoso desires to approach and dwell in the city of knowledge and wisdom should come through its door." Thereafter he said: "You are my brother, successor and inheritor, your flesh is my flesh, your blood is my blood, your truce is my truce, your fight is my fight, faith is blended, mixed and mingled (part and parcel) in your flesh and blood, just as it is compounded in my flesh and blood, you shall take charge of the reservoir of my inheritance, you are the fulfilment of my religion, you shall execute and keep alive my "way of life", your friends and followers shall speak with authority, command respect and hold the torch of good manners and refinements, their faces will be all around me in the eternal land of peace and bliss (Paradise), in my close company.
after.91: Were it not you O Ali, the faithfuls would not know the truth after me."
after.100: After him (Muhammad) be (Ali) was the guide for the wanderers, a bright light in the blind darkness, the strong rope of Allah, and the right path, did not ever hold back kindness and compassion from the common people, nor ever made excuses or delay to give priority to the matters of religion, nor blew his own trumpet nor felt proud of his glory, did the same thing the Messenger used to do, (Blessing of Allah be on them both and on their children) put an end to misinterpretation, did not lose temper, for the sake of Allah, if any one turned to mud-slinging and name-calling.
after.105: He had thrown the proud tribal chiefs of Arabia into a fright, destroyed their heroes, attacked and dispersed their cavalries, because of which hatred and deep grudge took root in their hearts. Badr, Khaybar, and Hunain created jealousy and envy in them, therefore, united they joined hands to oppose him, and came out in great number to fight against him, till he destroyed all deserters, who had swerved from what was right, the shameless who deviated from true religion, while he was carrying out the important mission.
after.108: Killed him a malicious criminal, a contemporary, serving the interest and following the doctrine of earlier impudent villians. An unparalleled and outlandish approach was applied to the directions of the Messenger of Allah, (Blessings of Allah be on him and on his children), concerning the "Guides" (Imaams), one after the other. The narrow-minded obstinate "ummah" did not care for and had ill-feelings towards him.
after.114: Flocked together to pass up and deny his connection with his family, and pushed his children out of their way, but a handful of sincere faithfuls kept their promise and dutifully upheld the rights of his children; Some were slain, some were held prisoners, some were sent to distant foreign lands, and they met face to face (when came upon) their destiny (martyrdom).
after.120: That which is given to each (of them) as reward of good deeds is the best recompense, since the earth belongs to Allah, and He gives it for an inheritance to whom He wants from among His servants, and the (good) end is for the God- fearing wise; glory to our Lord! Verily the promise of our Lord must be fulfilled; Allah does not break His word, He is Almighty, Wise.
after.122: So be purified and refined by making known and remembering the choicest children of Muhammad and Ali, blessings of Allah be on them both, and on their children.
after.135: The heartbroken, in tears, make their hearts bleed, together with them, the deeply moved perceptive men of letters describe their wisdom and liberality, as they themselves used to do, eyes of sensitive and thoughtful people are full of overflowing tears, their voices choked up with emotion; they cry out to protest against the injustice done, they call up dumb and insensate souls to stir and take notice. Where is Hasan? Where is Husayn? Where are the children of Husayn? The whole good, one and all! The truth altogether! Where is the regular unbroken vital connection? Where is the on going sequence of desirable goodness? Where are the clear source and spring of Light (vision and insight)? Where are the lively vivid handsome faces? Where are the distinctly visible pioneers? Where are the "know all the answers" scholars who communicated and made clear the religion of Allah? The fundamentals of knowledge and wisdom! Where is the ‘Everlasting legacy of God"? (never ever is the "family of Guides" without One).
after.167: Where is the impenetrable defense who broke the back of the oppressive tyrants? Where is the "awaited saviour" who will set the have-nots and the depressed on their feet? Where is the "The Hope" who will put and end to tyranny and oppression? Where is the "preserved guaranty" who shall give new life to rule of law and refined way of life? Where is the "Chosen in preference good" who shall raise the spirits of the people and give currency to justice and fairplay? Where is the "hope-giving confidante" who shall make full use of the "Book" and define the sphere of action? Where is he who shall blot out dogma in the matter of religion and his (Muhammad’s) children? Where is he who shall break up meddlesome trouble and tampering? Where is he who shall pull down the foundations of confusion (polytheists) and hypocrisy? Where is he who shall stamp out corruption, vice, reaction and injustice? Where is he who shall trim the outgrowth of despair, longing and hardships? Where is he who shall erase the traces of unfairness and self-seeking conceit? Where is he who shall untie the twisted knotes of falsehood and disruption? Where is he who shall separate senselessness and insolence from the people? Where is he who shall tear up by the roots obstinacy, corruption and apostasy? Where is he who shall love dearly the favourites of Allah and take pains to tame and train the trangressors? Where is he who shall make people familiar with "words of wisdom"? Where is the ultimate (Divine) source of plenty and prosperity? Where is the "Divine aspect" the God-fearing may look up to? Where is the link that connects the cosmic complex? Where is the authority who shall communicate and make known the true point of view? Where is the author of the conception of peace, fairplay and welfare? Where is the defender of the traditions of the Prophets and their children?
