Where is the investigator of the blood of the Martyrs of Karbalaa? Where is he who shall get the upper hand over the perpetrators of crime and greed? Where is he who shall not rest until he answers the cries of help when called upon? Where is the foremost leader of the people – the just, the truthful and the wise? Where is the son of the chosen Prophet? The son of Ali Al-Murtaza! The son of Khadeejah, the resplendent! The son of Faatimah, the great! My father, my mother, and I turn to you for protection and sanctuary.
after.189: O son of the favourite Leaders! O Son of the distinguished nobles! O son of the rightly guided Guides! O Son of the most refined high- minded liberals! O Son of the select generous Guardians! O son of the polite and pure purifiers! O Son of the impartial judges! O Son of the openhanded hosts! O Son of the mature teachers! O Son of the brilliant fulfillers! O Son of the clear and precise arguments who penetrated deep (into the domain of mind)! O inheritor of the made known prophesy! O inheritor of the clear preaching! O inheritor of the evident signs! O inheritor of the exact science! O inheritor of the widely sought after culture and customs! O inheritor of the milestones of glory and greatness! O inheritor of the extraordinary events! O inheritor of the reason that had been put to experiment! O inheritor of the Right Path! O inheritor of the Message that made deep impression on mankind! O Son of him who is in the "Mother of the Book" kept with Allah, the Highest High, the All-wise.
after.198: O inheritor of the convincing proofs! O inheritor of the genuine evidence! O inheritor of the distinctly visible demonstration! O inheritor of the decisive information! O inheritor of the absolute joy and happiness! O inheritor of "T’aa-haa" and clear wisdom! O inheritor of "Yaa seen" and "Zaariyaat" O inheritor of "T’oor" and "A’adiyaat" O Son of him who "drew near and came down till he was two bows’ length or nearer."
after.206: (The Highest High came near and received him gladly). If I but knew the destination of your purposeful journey! To which isolated land did you go? Good, pleasant and satisfying? Or otherwise? Or in well guarded concealment? It breaks my heart (when) I look at all that has been created, but cannot see you, nor hear a whisper about your whereabouts, nor any secret communication! It is disheartening to know that you are attending to and watching over the disorder and confusion, and I, in the thick of violent turmoil, am far away, unable to give report of injustice.
after.208: I eagerly long for you who is out of sight, but has not forsaken us. I eagerly long for you who has departed and is invisible, but is not far from us.
after.209: I eagerly long for you who inspires love and deep affection, and the faithful men and women take delight in your memorable glory. So we are excited with a longing desire.
after.211: I eagerly long for you who is worthy of acceptance and lawful driving force of belief and conviction, never weary or annoyed. I eagerly long for you who is the root of praise and distinction, never can be uprooted.
after.214: I eagerly long for you who is always tender, gentle and comforting, never makes one’s affairs worse instead of better. I eagerly long for you who is just and equitable beyond a trace of doubt, does not take severe action until misbehaviour trespasses the limit.
after.217: O Master! How long and unto what is to be directed (my) request for friendly attention concerning you? And what is the message? It makes me sad to get favourable reply from anyone other than you, but to be duped and cheated in the end.
after.220: It casts a gloom upon me that you suffered hardships and the chicken hearted deserters left you alone. It is painful for me what took place for you from them and that which had happened.
after.233: Is there a helper with whom I may cooperate and take pains? Is there a restless with whom I may share when action is taken? Is there a faint twinkle of evidence to make me willingly take up the trouble? Do you O Son of Ahmed have means and ways to arrange our meeting? Can you once cleverly guide the course of time, so that we may obtain our wish? When shall we abridge the gap that separate us from the vision so that we may refer to the authority? How long shall we keep waiting for your pleasing satisfying essence and quality? Already the period of expectation has lasted too long! When shall we receive our share from you and have our minds set at rest? For we have fixed our eyes upon you and strive with perseverance. When shall we be happy, and see your beautiful form and fine aspect? Groups of cheerful willing disciplined helpers, in great numbers, gathering around you to carry out one work after the other! You fulfilling (every promise) and giving joy, heart and confidence (to the faithfuls); filling the earth with justice; making your enemies follow the law and accept the revolution; taking the wind out of the haughty and the boastful, and those who knew but denied the truth; breaking the back of the proud and the arrogant; uprooting the roots of the unjust; and we-singing the praise of Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
after.237: O my Allah! Thou disperses the clouds of sorrows and hardships. Unto Thee we turn to ask for help against the enemy; for Thou (alone) helps and guides. Thou (alone) puts into good order affairs of this world and shall make better the Hereafter. So come to help! O He Who is called to help the helpless, Thy servants, surrounded by calamities.
after.241: Show them the face of their Leader. O the Mightiest Almighty. Allow him to put an end to evil and corruption, and satisfy his Love (for the faithfuls) and dislike (for the sinners). O He Who, from the "Arsh directs and controls all creation, and unto Him is the return, final and ultimate.
after.246: O my Allah! We are Thy servants, longing for Thy friend (appointed authority), who reminds us of Thee, and Thy Prophet, who was created as a refuge and asylum for us, established as a foundation and spring of truthfulness for us, and was made the Leader-Guide of the faithfuls. Convey to him our heartfelt congratulations and welcome.
after.251: Make us feel more deeply for him. O Lord! Very Kindly, make his headquarters our place of domicile and dwelling abode, and fulfill Thy promise by returning him to us as our Leader Guide, so that he takes us to the eternal land of peace and bliss, where we shall rub elbows with Thy sincere servants who shed blood to pronounce the Faith.
after.257: O Allah send Thy blessings on Muhammad and on the children of Muhammad. Bless his ancestor Muhammad, the Messenger, the foremost Leader, and bless his progenitor, the succeeding Leader, and his great grandmother, the ever truthful, Faatimah daughter of Muhammad, and his chosen virtuous forefathers, and send blessings on him, superior, whole, conclusive, staying, numerous, and full, not ever bestowed (even) on any of Thy sincerely attached and pious friends from among Thy creation.
after.259: Bless him with blessings, (that) cannot be counted in numbers, cannot be "proximated" in space of time, cannot be consumed in terms of having nothing remaining.
after.261: O my Allah! Set up truth, destroy falsehood, show the right path to Thy friends, humiliate Thy enemies, and do it without interruption, (through him). O my Allah! Unite us with him.
after.264: Let us be friends with his ancestors. Give us courage to disperse those who oppose and try to prevent him, and make them stay in their shame and disgrace for ever.
after.268: Help us to discharge the duties made incumbent upon us by him, and make every effort to obey him, keep from that which is declared unlawful by him, rely upon him to get his approval.
after.274: Let us be with him when he makes peace, and frees mankind from fear, gives currency to love are kindness, brings bliss and happiness, spreads good and virtue, so that we may do our best to promote his cause through Thy mercy, and win victory for Thee. Accept our prayers, forgive our sins, fulfil our desires, give us means of livelihood, unrestricted, make less our hardships, meet our demands in full (through him).
after.283: Turn towards us Thy kindness and loving aspects, and bring us close to Thee. Turn the eyes of Thy mercy upon us, to bring to fullness Thy kind favours, and after that do not ever let them disappear in the name of Thy generosity, and give us the opportunity to quench our thirst from the spring of his great grandfather (Kawsar), (blessing of Allah be on him and on his children), using his cup, filled by him, fresh and pure, sufficient, wholesome, clear and cool, not leaving any desire thereafter, O the Most Merciful.

segs.note: Qunoot is recommended in the second rak‘ah of every prayer, before ruku. Any of these duas from the Holy Quran may be recited, or one's own dua.
segs.ur: ہر نماز کی دوسری رکعت میں رکوع سے پہلے قنوت پڑھنا مستحب ہے۔ قرآن مجید کی ان دعاؤں میں سے کوئی بھی، یا اپنی دعا پڑھی جا سکتی ہے۔

segs.note: 1. Guidance to the straight path (Al-Faatiha 1:6–7)
segs.ur: 1۔ صراط مستقیم کی ہدایت

segs.tr: Ihdinas-siraatal-mustaqeem
segs.en: Guide us on the straight path,
segs.ur: ہمیں سیدھے راستہ کی ہدایت فرماتا رہ

segs.ar: صِرَاطَ الَّذِيْنَ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ࣢ۙ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوْبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّا࢜لِّيْنَࣖ
segs.tr: Siraatal-ladheena an`amta `alayhim ghayril-maghdoobi `alayhim walad-daalleen
segs.en: the path of those whom You have blessed — such as have not incurred Your wrath, nor are astray.
segs.ur: جو اُن لوگوں کا راستہ ہے جن پر تو نے نعمتیں نازل کی ہیں ان کا راستہ نہیں جن پر غضب نازل ہوا ہے یا جو بہکے ہوئے ہیں

segs.note: 2. Acceptance of good deeds (Al-Baqara 2:127)
segs.ur: 2۔ اعمال کی قبولیت

segs.ar: وَاِذْ يَرْفَعُ اِبْرٰهٖمُ الْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ وَاِسْمٰعِيْلُؕ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّاؕ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ
segs.tr: Wa'idh yarfa`u ibraaheemul-qawaa`ida minal-bayti wa'ismaa`eel, rabbanaa taqabbal minnaa, innaka antas-samee`ul-`aleem
segs.en: As Abraham raised the foundations of the House with Ishmael, [they prayed]: ‘Our Lord, accept it from us! Indeed You are the All-hearing, the All-knowing.
segs.ur: اور اس وقت کو یاد کرو جب ابراہیم علیھ السّلامو اسماعیل علیھ السّلامخانہ کعبہ کی دیواروں کو بلند کر رہے تھے اوردل میں یہ دعا تھی کہ پروردگار ہماری محنت کو قبول فرمالے کہ تو بہترین سننے والا اورجاننے والا ہے

segs.note: 3. Allah is near and answers (Al-Baqara 2:186)
segs.ur: 3۔ اللہ قریب ہے اور دعا قبول کرتا ہے

segs.ar: وَاِذَا سَاَلَكَ عِبَادِيْ عَنِّيْ فَاِنِّيْ قَرِيْبٌؕ اُجِيْبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ اِذَا دَعَانِۙ فَلْيَسْتَجِيْبُوْا لِيْ وَلْيُؤْمِنُوْا بِيْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُوْنَ
segs.tr: Wa'idhaa sa'alaka `ibaadee `annee fa'innee qareeb, ujeebu da`watad-daa`i idhaa da`aani falyastajeeboo lee walyu'minoo bee la`allahum yarshudoon
segs.en: When My servants ask you about Me, [tell them that] I am indeed nearmost. I answer the supplicant’s call when he calls Me. So let them respond to Me, and let them have faith in Me, so that they may fare rightly.
segs.ur: اور اے پیغمبر! اگر میرے بندے تم سے میرے بارے میں سوال کریں تو میں ان سے قریب ہوں. پکارنے والے کی آواز سنتا ہوں جب بھی پکارتا ہے لہٰذا مجھ سے طلب قبولیت کریں اور مجھ ہی پرایمان و اعتماد رکھیں کہ شاید اس طرح راسِ راست پر آجائیں

segs.note: 4. Good in this world and the Hereafter (Al-Baqara 2:201)
segs.ur: 4۔ دنیا و آخرت کی بھلائی

segs.ar: وَمِنْهُمْ مَّنْ يَّقُوْلُ رَبَّنَآ اٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَّقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
segs.tr: Waminhum may yaqoolu rabbanaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanataw wafil-aakhirati hasanataw waqinaa `adhaaban-naar
segs.en: And among them there are those who say, ‘Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.’
segs.ur: اور بعض کہتے ہیں کہ پروردگار ہمیں دنیا میں بھی نیکی عطا فرما اورآخرت میں بھی اور ہم کو عذاب جہّنم سے محفوظ فرما

segs.note: 5. Steadfastness of the heart (Aal-i-Imraan 3:8)
segs.ur: 5۔ دل کی ثابت قدمی

segs.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوْبَنَا بَعْدَ اِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ رَحْمَةًۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
segs.tr: Rabbanaa laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba`da idh hadaytanaa wahab lanaa mil ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-wahhaab
segs.en: [They say,] ‘Our Lord! Do not make our hearts swerve after You have guided us, and bestow Your mercy on us. Indeed, You are the All-munificent.
segs.ur: ان کا کہنا ہے کہ پروردگار جب تونے ہمیں ہدایت دے دی ہے تو اب ہمارے دلوں میں کجی نہ پیدا ہونے پائے اور ہمیں اپنے پاس سے رحمت عطا فرما کہ تو بہترین عطا کرنے والا ہے

segs.note: 6. For righteous children (Aal-i-Imraan 3:38)
segs.ur: 6۔ نیک اولاد کے لیے

segs.ar: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهٗۚ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِيْ مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةًۚ اِنَّكَ سَمِيْعُ الدُّعَا࢜ءِ
segs.tr: Hunaalika da`aa zakariyyaa rabbah, qaala rabbi hab lee mil ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka samee`ud-du`aa'
segs.en: Thereat Zechariah supplicated his Lord. He said, ‘My Lord! Grant me a good offspring from You! Indeed You hear all supplications.’
segs.ur: اس وقت زکریا علیھ السّلامنے اپنے پرودگار سے دعا کی کہ مجھے اپنی طرف سے ایک پاکیزہ اولاد عطا فرما کہ تو ہر ایک کی دعا کا سننے والا ہے

segs.note: 7. Forgiveness and firmness (Aal-i-Imraan 3:147)
segs.ur: 7۔ مغفرت اور ثابت قدمی

segs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ قَوْلَهُمْ اِلَّآ اَنْ قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا وَاِسْرَافَنَا فِيْٓ اَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ اَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَي الْقَوْمِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
segs.tr: Wamaa kaana qawlahum illaa an qaaloo rabbanaghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wa'israafanaa fee amrinaa wathabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa `alal-qawmil-kaafireen
segs.en: All that they said was, ‘Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excesses in our affairs, make our feet steady, and help us against the faithless lot.’
segs.ur: ان کا قول صرف یہی تھا کہ خدایا ہمارے گناہوں کو بخش دے- ہمارے امور میں زیادتیوں کو معاف فرما- ہمارے قدموں کو ثبات عطا فرما اور کافروں کے مقابلہ میں ہماری مدد فرما

segs.note: 8. Reflection on creation (Aal-i-Imraan 3:191)
segs.ur: 8۔ تخلیق پر غور و فکر

segs.ar: الَّذِيْنَ يَذْكُرُوْنَ اللّٰهَ قِيٰمًا وَّقُعُوْدًا وَّعَلٰي جُنُوْبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُوْنَ فِيْ خَلْقِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِۚ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هٰذَا بَاطِلًاۚ سُبْحٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
segs.tr: Al-ladheena yadhkuroonallaaha qiyaamaw waqu`oodaw wa`alaa junoobihim wayatafakkaroona fee khalqis-samaawaati wal-ard, rabbanaa maa khalaqta haadhaa baatilaa, subhaanaka faqinaa `adhaaban-naar
segs.en: Those who remember Allah standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth [and say], ‘Our Lord, You have not created this in vain! Immaculate are You! Save us from the punishment of the Fire.
segs.ur: جو لوگ اٹھتے, بیٹھتے, لیٹتے خدا کو یاد کرتے ہیں اور آسمان و زمین کی تخلیق میں غوروفکر کرتے ہیں... کہ خدایا تو نے یہ سب بے کار نہیں پیدا کیا ہے- تو پاک و بے نیاز ہے ہمیں عذاب جہّنم سے محفوظ فرما

segs.note: 9. Forgiveness and dying with the righteous (Aal-i-Imraan 3:193)
segs.ur: 9۔ مغفرت اور نیکوں کے ساتھ موت

segs.ar: رَبَّنَآ اِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُّنَادِيْ لِلْاِيْمَانِ اَنْ اٰمِنُوْا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَاٰمَنَّاࣗۖ رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّاٰتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْاَبْرَارِۚ
segs.tr: Rabbanaa innanaa sami`naa munaadiyay yunaadee lil-eemaani an aaminoo birabbikum fa'aamannaa, rabbanaa faghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wakaffir `annaa sayyi'aatinaa watawaffanaa ma`al-abraar
segs.en: Our Lord, we have indeed heard a summoner calling to faith, declaring, ‘‘Have faith in your Lord!’’ So we believed. Our Lord, forgive us our sins and absolve us of our misdeeds, and make us die with the pious.
segs.ur: پروردگار ہم نے اس منادی کو صَنا جو ایمان کی آواز لگا رہا تھا کہ اپنے پروردگار پر ایمان لے آؤ تو ہم ایمان لے آئے- پروردگار اب ہمارے گناہوں کو معاف فرما اور ہماری برائیوں کی پردہ پوشی فرما اور ہمیں نیک بندوں کے ساتھ محشور فرما

segs.note: 10. Fulfilment of Your promise (Aal-i-Imraan 3:194)
segs.ur: 10۔ اپنے وعدے کی تکمیل

segs.ar: رَبَّنَا وَاٰتِنَا مَا وَعَدْتَّنَا عَلٰي رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِؕ اِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيْعَادَ
segs.tr: Rabbanaa wa'aatinaa maa wa`attanaa `alaa rusulika walaa tukhzinaa yawmal-qiyaamah, innaka laa tukhliful-mee`aad
segs.en: Our Lord, give us what You have promised us through Your apostles, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed You do not break Your promise.’
segs.ur: پروردگار جو تو نے اپنے رسولوں سے وعدہ کیا ہے اسے عطا فرما اور روزِ قیامت ہمیں رسوا نہ کرنا کہ تو وعدہ کے خلاف نہیں کرتا

segs.note: 11. Rescue from darkness (Al-An'aam 6:63)
segs.ur: 11۔ تاریکیوں سے نجات

segs.ar: قُلْ مَنْ يُّنَجِّيْكُمْ مِّنْ ظُلُمٰتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ تَدْعُوْنَهٗ تَضَرُّعًا وَّخُفْيَةًۚ لَىِٕنْ اَنْجٰىنَا مِنْ هٰذِهٖ لَنَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الشّٰكِرِيْنَ
segs.tr: Qul may yunajjeekum min zulumaatil-barri wal-bahri tad`oonahoo tadarru`aw wakhufyah, la'in anjaanaa min haadhihee lanakoonanna minash-shaakireen
segs.en: Say, ‘Who delivers you from the darkness of land and sea, [when] You invoke Him suppliantly and secretly: ‘‘If He delivers us from this, we will surely be among the grateful’’?’
segs.ur: ان سے کہئے کہ خشکی اور تری کی تاریکیوں سے کون نجات دیتا ہے جسے تم گڑگڑا کر اور خفیہ طریقہ سے آواز دیتے ہو کہ اگر اس مصیبت سے نجات دے دے گا تو ہم شکر گزار بن جائیں گے

segs.note: 12. Forgiveness for me and my brother (Al-A'raaf 7:151)
segs.ur: 12۔ میری اور میرے بھائی کی مغفرت

segs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ وَلِاَخِيْ وَاَدْخِلْنَا فِيْ رَحْمَتِكَؗۖ وَاَنْتَ اَرْحَمُ الرّٰحِمِيْنَࣖ
segs.tr: Qaala rabbighfir lee wali'akhee wa'adkhilnaa fee rahmatik, wa'anta arhamur-raahimeen
segs.en: He said, ‘My Lord, forgive me and my brother, and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful.
segs.ur: موسٰی علیھ السّلامنے کہا کہ پروردگار مجھے اور میرے بھائی کو معاف کردے اور ہمیں اپنی رحمت میں داخل کرلے کہ تو سب سے زیادہ رحم کرنے والاہے

segs.note: 13. Good in this world and the next (Al-A'raaf 7:156)
segs.ur: 13۔ دنیا اور آخرت میں بھلائی

segs.ar: وَاكْتُبْ لَنَا فِيْ هٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ اِنَّا هُدْنَآ اِلَيْكَؕ قَالَ عَذَابِيْٓ اُصِيْبُ بِهٖ مَنْ اَشَا࢜ءُۚ وَرَحْمَتِيْ وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍؕ فَسَاَكْتُبُهَا لِلَّذِيْنَ يَتَّقُوْنَ وَيُؤْتُوْنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَالَّذِيْنَ هُمْ بِاٰيٰتِنَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَۚ
segs.tr: Waktub lanaa fee haadhihid-dunyaa hasanataw wafil-aakhirati innaa hudnaa ilayk, qaala `adhaabee useebu bihee man ashaa', warahmatee wasi`at kulla shay', fasa'aktubuhaa lilladheena yattaqoona wayu'toonaz-zakaata wal-ladheena hum bi'aayaatinaa yu'minoon
segs.en: And appoint goodness for us in this world and the Hereafter, for indeed we have come back to You.’ Said He, ‘I visit My punishment on whomever I wish, but My mercy embraces all things. Soon I shall appoint it for those who are Godwary and give the zakat and those who believe in Our signs
segs.ur: اور ہمارے لئے اس دار دنیا اور آخرت میں نیکی لکھ دے -ہم تیری ہی طرف رجوع کررہے ہیں -ارشاد ہوا کہ میرا عذاب جسے میں چاہوں گا اس تک پہنچے گا اور میری رحمت ہر شے پر وسیع ہے جسے میں عنقریب ان لوگوں کے لئے لکھ دوں گا جو خوف خدا رکھنے والے -زکوِٰادا کرنے والے اور ہماری نشانیوں پر ایمان لانے والے ہیں

segs.note: 14. Allah is sufficient for me (At-Tawba 9:129)
segs.ur: 14۔ اللہ میرے لیے کافی ہے

segs.ar: فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللّٰهُؗࣗۖ لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِࣖ
segs.tr: Fa'in tawallaw faqul hasbiyallaahu laa ilaaha illaa huw, `alayhi tawakkaltu wahuwa rabbul-`arshil-`azeem
segs.en: But if they turn their backs [on you], say, ‘Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god except Him. In Him I have put my trust and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.’
segs.ur: اب اس کے بعد بھی يه لوگ منه پھير ليں تو کہديجئے کہ خدا میرے لیے کافی ہے، اس کے سوا کوئی خدا نہیں، میرا اعتماداسى پر ہے اور وہى عرش اعظم کا پروردگار ہے.

segs.note: 15. Protection from the oppressors (Yunus 10:85–86)
segs.ur: 15۔ ظالموں سے حفاظت

segs.ar: فَقَالُوْا عَلَي اللّٰهِ تَوَكَّلْنَاۚ رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِيْنَۙ
segs.tr: Faqaaloo `alallaahi tawakkalnaa, rabbanaa laa taj`alnaa fitnatal lil-qawmiz-zaalimeen
segs.en: Whereat they said, ‘In Allah we have put our trust.’ ‘Our Lord! Do not make us a [means of] test for the wrongdoing lot,
segs.ur: تو ان لوگوں نے کہا کہ بیشک ہم نے خدا پر بھروسہ کیا ہے. خدایا ہمیں ظالموں کے فتنوں اور آزمائشوں کا مرکز نہ قرار دینا

segs.tr: Wanajjinaa birahmatika minal-qawmil-kaafireen
segs.en: and deliver us by Your mercy from the faithless lot.’
segs.ur: اور اپنی رحمت کے ذریعہ کافر قوم کے شر سے محفوظ رکھنا

segs.note: 16. For one's family (Hud 11:45)
segs.ur: 16۔ اپنے اہل و عیال کے لیے

segs.ar: وَنَادٰي نُوْحٌ رَّبَّهٗ فَقَالَ رَبِّ اِنَّ ابْنِيْ مِنْ اَهْلِيْ وَاِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ وَاَنْتَ اَحْكَمُ الْحٰكِمِيْنَ
segs.tr: Wanaadaa noohur rabbahoo faqaala rabbi innabnee min ahlee, wa'inna wa`dakal-haqqu wa'anta ahkamul-haakimeen
segs.en: Noah called out to his Lord, and said, ‘My Lord! My son is indeed from my family. Your promise is indeed true, and You are the fairest of all judges.’
segs.ur: اور نوح نے اپنے پروردگار کو پکارا کہ پروردگار میرا فرزند میرے اہل میں سے ہے اور تیرا وعدہ اہل کو بچانے کا برحق ہے اور تو بہترین فیصلہ کرنے والا ہے

segs.note: 17. Patience and victory (Al-Baqara 2:250)
segs.ur: 17۔ صبر اور فتح

segs.ar: وَلَمَّا بَرَزُوْا لِجَالُوْتَ وَجُنُوْدِهٖ قَالُوْا رَبَّنَآ اَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَّثَبِّتْ اَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَي الْقَوْمِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَؕ
segs.tr: Walammaa barazoo lijaaloota wajunoodihee qaaloo rabbanaa afrigh `alaynaa sabraw wathabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa `alal-qawmil-kaafireen
segs.en: So when they marched out for [encounter with] Goliath and his troops, they said, ‘Our Lord, pour patience upon us, make our feet steady, and assist us against the faithless lot.’
segs.ur: اور یہ لوگ جب جالوت اور اس کے لشکروں کے مقابلے کے لئے نکلے تو انہوں نے کہا کہ خدایا ہمیں بے پناہ صبر عطا فرما ہمارے قدموں کو ثبات دے اور ہمیں کافروں کے مقابلہ میں نصرت عطا فرما

segs.note: 18. Do not burden us beyond our strength (Al-Baqara 2:286)
segs.ur: 18۔ ہم پر طاقت سے زیادہ بوجھ نہ ڈال

segs.ar: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللّٰهُ نَفْسًا اِلَّا وُسْعَهَاؕ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْؕ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ اِنْ نَّسِيْنَآ اَوْ اَخْطَاْنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ اِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهٗ عَلَي الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهٖۚ وَاعْفُ عَنَّاࣟ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَاࣟ وَارْحَمْنَاࣟ اَنْتَ مَوْلٰىنَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَي الْقَوْمِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَࣖ
segs.tr: Laa yukallifullaahu nafsan illaa wus`ahaa, lahaa maa kasabat wa`alayhaa maktasabat, rabbanaa laa tu'aakhidhnaa in naseenaa aw akhta'naa, rabbanaa walaa tahmil `alaynaa isran kamaa hamaltahoo `alal-ladheena min qablinaa, rabbanaa walaa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih, wa`fu `annaa, waghfir lanaa, warhamnaa, anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa `alal-qawmil-kaafireen
segs.en: Allah does not task any soul beyond its capacity. Whatever [good] it earns is to its own benefit, and whatever [evil] it incurs is to its own harm. ‘Our Lord! Take us not to task if we forget or make mistakes! Our Lord! Do not place upon us a burden as You placed on those who were before us! Our Lord! Do not lay upon us what we have no strength to bear! Excuse us, forgive us, and be merciful to us! You are our Master, so help us against the faithless lot!’
segs.ur: اللہ کس نفس کو اس کی وسعت سے زیادہ تکلیف نہیں دیتا . ہر نفس کے لئے اس کی حاصل کی ہوئی نیکیوں کا فائدہ بھی ہے اور اس کی کمائی ہوئی برائیوں کا مظلمہ بھی---- پروردگار! ہم جو کچھ بھول جائیں یا ہم سے غلطی ہوجائے اس کا ہم سے مواخذہ نہ کرنا . خدایا ہم پر ویسا بوجھ نہ ڈالنا جیسا پہلے والی امتوں پر ڈالا گیا ہے پروردگار ! ہم پر وہ بار نہ ڈالنا جس کی ہم میںطاقت نہ ہو . ہمیں معاف کردیناً ہمیں بخش دیناً ہم پر رحم کرنا توہمارا مولا اور مالک ہے اب کافروں کے مقابلہ میں ہماری مدد فرما

segs.note: 19. Forgiveness and protection from the Fire (Aal-i-Imraan 3:16)
segs.ur: 19۔ مغفرت اور آگ سے بچاؤ

segs.ar: اَلَّذِيْنَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَآ اِنَّنَآ اٰمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِۚ
segs.tr: Alladheena yaqooloona rabbanaa innanaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa waqinaa `adhaaban-naar
segs.en: Those who say, ‘Our Lord! Indeed, we have faith. So forgive us our sins, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.’
segs.ur: قابل تعریف ہیں وہ لوگ جو یہ کہتے ہیں کہ پروردگار ہم ایمان لے آئے- ہمارے گناہوں کو بخش دے اور ہمیں آتش جہّنم سے بچالے

segs.note: 20. Repentance of Adam (a.s.) (Al-A'raaf 7:23)
segs.ur: 20۔ حضرت آدمؑ کی توبہ

segs.ar: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ اَنْفُسَنَاࣝ وَاِنْ لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ
segs.tr: Qaalaa rabbanaa zalamnaa anfusanaa wa'il lam taghfir lanaa watarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal-khaasireen
segs.en: They said, ‘Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves! If You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.’
segs.ur: ان دونوں نے کہا کہ پروردگار ہم نے اپنے نفس پر ظلم کیا ہے اب اگر تو معاف نہ کرے گا اور رحم نہ کرے گا تو ہم خسارہ اٹھانے والوں میں ہوجائیں گے

segs.note: 21. Establishing prayer, for parents and believers (Ibrahim 14:40–41)
segs.ur: 21۔ نماز کا قیام، والدین اور مومنین کے لیے

segs.ar: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِيْ مُقِيْمَ الصَّلٰوةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِيْࣗۖ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَا࢜ءِ
segs.tr: Rabbij`alnee muqeemas-salaati wamin dhurriyyatee, rabbanaa wataqabbal du`aa'
segs.en: My Lord! Make me a maintainer of prayer, and my descendants [as well]. Our Lord, accept my supplication.
segs.ur: پروردگار مجھے اور میری ذریت میں نماز قائم کرنے والے قرار دے اور پروردگار میری دعا کو قبول کرلے

segs.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِيْ وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ يَوْمَ يَقُوْمُ الْحِسَابُࣖ
segs.tr: Rabbanaghfir lee waliwaalidayya walilmu'mineena yawma yaqoomul-hisaab
segs.en: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and all the faithful, on the day when the reckoning is held.’
segs.ur: پروردگار مجھے اور میرے والدین کو اور تمام مومنین کو اس دن بخش دینا جس دن حساب قائم ہوگا

segs.note: 22. Mercy for parents (Al-Israa 17:24)
segs.ur: 22۔ والدین پر رحمت

segs.ar: وَاخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ الذُّلِّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَقُلْ رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيٰنِيْ صَغِيْرًاؕ
segs.tr: Wakhfid lahumaa janaahadh-dhulli minar-rahmati waqur rabbirhamhumaa kamaa rabbayaanee sagheeraa
segs.en: Lower the wing of humility to them, mercifully, and say, ‘My Lord! Have mercy on them, just as they reared me when I was [a] small [child]!’
segs.ur: اور ان کے لئے خاکساری کے ساتھ اپنے کاندھوں کو جھکا دینا اور ان کے حق میں دعا کرتے رہنا کہ پروردگار اُن دونوں پر اسی طرح رحمت نازل فرما جس طرح کہ انہوں نے بچپنے میں مجھے پالا ہے

segs.note: 23. Increase in knowledge (Taa-Haa 20:114)
segs.ur: 23۔ علم میں اضافہ

segs.ar: فَتَعٰلَي اللّٰهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّۚ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِالْقُرْاٰنِ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يُّقْضٰٓي اِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهٗؗ وَقُلْ رَّبِّ زِدْنِيْ عِلْمًا
segs.tr: Fata`aalallaahul-malikul-haqq, walaa ta`jal bil-qur'aani min qabli ay yuqdaa ilayka wahyuh, waqur rabbi zidnee `ilmaa
segs.en: So exalted is Allah, the True Sovereign. Do not hasten with the Quran before its revelation is completed for you, and say, ‘My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.’
segs.ur: پس بلند و برتر ہے وہ خدا جو بادشاہ هبرحق ہے اور آپ وحی کے تمام ہونے سے پہلے قرآن کے بارے میں عجلت سے کام نہ لیا کریں اور یہ کہتے رہیں کہ پروردگار میرے علم میں اضافہ فرما

segs.note: 24. Dua of Prophet Yunus (a.s.) (Al-Anbiyaa 21:87)
segs.ur: 24۔ حضرت یونسؑ کی دعا

segs.ar: وَذَا النُّوْنِ اِذْ ذَّهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ اَنْ لَّنْ نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادٰي فِي الظُّلُمٰتِ اَنْ لَّآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّآ اَنْتَ سُبْحٰنَكَࣗۖ اِنِّيْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَۚۖ
segs.tr: Wadhan-nooni idh dhahaba mughaadiban fazanna al lan naqdira `alayhi fanaadaa fiz-zulumaati al laa ilaaha illaa anta subhaanaka innee kuntu minaz-zaalimeen
segs.en: And [remember] the Man of the Fish, when he left in a rage, thinking that We would not put him to hardship. Then he cried out in the darkness, ‘There is no god except You! You are immaculate! I have indeed been among the wrongdoers!’
segs.ur: اور یونس علیھ السّلامکو یاد کرو کہ جب وہ غصّہ میں آکر چلے اور یہ خیال کیا کہ ہم ان پر روزی تنگ نہ کریں گے اور پھر تاریکیوں میں جاکر آواز دی کہ پروردگار تیرے علاوہ کوئی خدا نہیں ہے تو پاک و بے نیاز ہے اور میں اپنے نفس پر ظلم کرنے والوں میں سے تھا

segs.note: 25. Forgiveness and mercy (Al-Muminoon 23:118)
segs.ur: 25۔ بخشش اور رحمت

segs.ar: وَقُلْ رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَاَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرّٰحِمِيْنَࣖ
segs.tr: Waqur rabbighfir warham wa'anta khayrur-raahimeen
segs.en: Say, ‘My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.’
segs.ur: اور پیغمبر علیھ السّلام آپ کہئے کہ پروردگار میری مغفرت فرما اور مجھ پر رحم کر کہ تو بہترین رحم کرنے والا ہے

segs.note: 26. Comfort in family and children (Al-Furqaan 25:74)
segs.ur: 26۔ اہل و اولاد سے آنکھوں کی ٹھنڈک

segs.ar: وَالَّذِيْنَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ اَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ اَعْيُنٍ وَّاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ اِمَامًا
segs.tr: Wal-ladheena yaqooloona rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wadhurriyyaatinaa qurrata a`yuniw waj`alnaa lil-muttaqeena imaamaa
segs.en: And those who say, ‘Our Lord! Give us joy and comfort in our spouses and offspring, and make us imams of the Godwary.’
segs.ur: اور وہ لوگ برابر دعا کرتے رہتے ہیں کہ خدایا ہمیں ہماری ازواج اور اولاد کی طرف سے خنکی چشم عطا فرما اور ہمیں صاحبان هتقویٰٰ کا پیشوا بنا دے

segs.note: 27. For the believers before us (Al-Hashr 59:10)
segs.ur: 27۔ گزشتہ مومنین کے لیے

segs.ar: وَالَّذِيْنَ جَا࢜ءُوْ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِاِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِيْنَ سَبَقُوْنَا بِالْاِيْمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِيْ قُلُوْبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا رَبَّنَآ اِنَّكَ رَءُوْفٌ رَّحِيْمٌࣖ
segs.tr: Wal-ladheena jaa'oo mim ba`dihim yaqooloona rabbanaghfir lanaa wali'ikhwaaninal-ladheena sabaqoonaa bil-eemaani walaa taj`al fee quloobinaa ghillal lilladheena aamanoo rabbanaa innaka ra'oofur raheem
segs.en: And [also for] those who came in after them, who say, ‘Our Lord, forgive us and our brethren who were our forerunners in the faith, and do not put any rancour in our hearts toward the faithful. Our Lord, You are indeed most kind and merciful.’
segs.ur: اور جو لوگ ان کے بعد آئے اور ان کا کہنا یہ ہے کہ خدایا ہمیں معاف کردے اور ہمارے ان بھائیوں کو بھی جنہوں نے ایمان میں ہم پر سبقت کی ہے اور ہمارے دلوں میں صاحبانِ ایمان کے لئے کسی طرح کا کینہ نہ قرار دینا کہ تو بڑا مہربان اور رحم کرنے والا ہے

segs.note: 28. Perfect our light (At-Tahrim 66:8)
segs.ur: 28۔ ہمارا نور مکمل فرما

segs.ar: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا تُوْبُوْٓا اِلَي اللّٰهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوْحًاؕ عَسٰي رَبُّكُمْ اَنْ يُّكَفِّرَ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّاٰتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُۙ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِي اللّٰهُ النَّبِيَّ وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهٗۚ نُوْرُهُمْ يَسْعٰي بَيْنَ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَبِاَيْمَانِهِمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَآ اَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُوْرَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَاۚ اِنَّكَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
segs.tr: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo tooboo ilallaahi tawbatan nasoohaa, `asaa rabbukum ay yukaffira `ankum sayyi'aatikum wayudkhilakum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru yawma laa yukhzillaahun-nabiyya wal-ladheena aamanoo ma`ah, nooruhum yas`aa bayna aydeehim wabi'aymaanihim yaqooloona rabbanaa atmim lanaa nooranaa waghfir lanaa, innaka `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
segs.en: O you who have faith! Repent to Allah with sincere repentance! Maybe your Lord will absolve you of your misdeeds and admit you into gardens with streams running in them, on the day when Allah will not let down the Prophet and the faithful who are with him. Their light will move swiftly before them and on their right. They will say, ‘Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Indeed You have power over all things.’
segs.ur: ایمان والو خلوص دل کے ساتھ توبہ کرو عنقریب تمہارا پروردگار تمہاری برائیوں کو مٹا دے گا اور تمہیں ان جنتوں میں داخل کردے گا جن کے نیچے نہریں جاری ہوں گی اس دن خدا اپنے نبی اور صاحبانِ ایمان کو رسوا نہیں ہونے دے گا ان کا نور ان کے آگے آگے اور داہنی طرف چل رہا ہوگا اور وہ کہیں گے کہ خدایا ہمارے لئے ہمارے نور کو مکمل کردے اور ہمیں بخش دے کہ تو یقینا ہر شے پر قدرت رکھنے والا ہے

segs.note: 29. Qunoot of Imam Husain (a.s.)
segs.ur: 29۔ قنوت امام حسینؑ

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ مَنْ اٰوٰی اِلٰی مَأْوًی فَأَنْتَ مَأْوَایَ
segs.ur: اے معبود اگر کوئی شخص کسی طرف مائل ہوا ہے تو میں تیری طرف مائل ہوں

segs.ar: وَمَنْ لَجَا اِلٰی مَلْجًا فَأَنْتَ مَلْجَایَ
segs.ur: اور اگر کوئی شخص کسی اور کی پناہ لے تو میں تیری پناہ لیتا ہوں

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.ur: اے معبود رحمت فرما محمد و آل محمدؐ پر
اور میری آواز سن اور میری دعا قبول فرما
میری بازگشت اور ٹھکانہ اپنے ہاں قرار دے
میری نگہبانی کر سخت آزمائشوں میں،
مشکل وقتوں اور شیطان کی دخل اندازیوں میں

segs.ar: بِعَظَمَتِكَ الَّتِیْ لَا یَشُوْبُہَا وَلَعُ نَفْسٍ بِتَفْتِیْنٍ
segs.ur: اپنی عظمت کے ذریعے جس میں نفس کی خواہش کا شائبہ نہیں

segs.ar: وَلَا وَارِدُ طَیْفٍ بِتَظْنِیْنٍ، وَلَا یَلُمُّ بِہَا فَرَحٌ
segs.ur: نہ بد گمانی کے کسی خیال کا گزر ہے اور نہ مدہوشی کا خطرہ
یہاں تک تو مجھے اپنی طرف پلٹائے اپنے ارادے سے

segs.ar: غَیْرَ ظَنِیْنٍ وَلَا مَظْنُوْنٍ وَلَا مُرَابٍ وَلَا مُرْتَاب
segs.ur: نہ بدگمانی اور نہ تہمت کے ساتھ نہ شک و شبہ کی حالت میں
یقیناً تو سب سے زیادہ رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

segs.note: 30. Qunoot of Namaz-e-Witr (Namaz-e-Shab)
segs.ur: 30۔ نماز وتر کا قنوت

segs.ar: اِلٰهِیْ كَیْفَ أَصْدُر عَنْ بَابِكَ بِخَیْبَةٍ مِنْكَ
segs.ur: اے معبود! کیونکر تیرے درسے نامراد ہوکر پلٹ جاؤں
جب کہ میں تجھ پر بھروسہ کر کے یہاں آیا تھا

segs.ar: اِلٰهِیْ كَیْفَ تُؤْیِسُنِیْ مِنْ عَطَائِكَ وَأَمَرْتَنِیْ بِدُعَاءِ
segs.ur: اے معبود ! تو کیونکر مجھے اپنی عطا سے مایوس کرے گا جب کہ تو نے مجھے دعا کا حکم دیا ہے
رحمت فرما محمدؐ وآلؑ محمدؐ پر
اور مجھ پر رحم کر جب میں بہت زاری کروں

segs.ar: وَحُظِرَ عَلَیَّ الْعَمَلُ، وَانْقَطَعَ مِنِّی الْاَمَل
segs.ur: معاملہ ہاتھ سے نکل جائے ، میری آس ٹوٹ گئی ہو

segs.ar: وَأَفْضَیْتُ اِلَی الْمَنُوْنِ، وَبَكَتْ عَلَیَّ الْعُیُوْن
segs.ur: موت کےدروازے تک پہنچ جاؤں، آنکھیں مجھ پر رو رہی ہوں

segs.ar: وَوَدَّعَنِی الْاَهْلُ وَالْاَحْبَابُ، وَحُثِیَ عَلَیَّ التُّرَابُ
segs.ur: میرے اہل خاندان اور احباب مجھے چھوڑ چکے ہوں، مجھ پر مٹی ڈال دی گئی ہو
میرا نام بھلا دیا گیا ہو، میرا جسم گل چکا ہو
میرا ذکر مٹ چکا ہو، میری قبر نامعلوم ہو گئی ہو

segs.ar: فَلَمْ یَزُرْنِیْ زَائِرٌ وَلَمْ یَذْكُرْنِیْ ذَاكِرٌ
segs.ur: کوئی اسے دیکھنے نہ آئے، نہ کوئی مجھے یاد کر

segs.ar: وَظَهَرَتْ مِنِّی الْمَاٰثِمُ، وَاسْتَوْلَتْ عَلَیَّ الْمَظَالِمُ
segs.ur: میرے گناہ عیاں ہو چکے ہوں، میری ناانصافیاں مجھے گھیرے ہوئے ہوں

segs.ar: وَطَالَتْ شِكَایَةُ الْخُصُوْمِ، وَأَتَّصَلَتْ دَعْوَةُ الْمَظْلُوْمِ
segs.ur: میرے خلاف شکایات طولانی ہوں، مظلوموں کے دعوے جاری ہوں۔

segs.ar: صَلِّ اَللّٰهُمَّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.ur: ایسے میں اے معبود! محمدؐ و آلؑ محمدؐ پر رحمت فرما
اور اپنے فضل و کرم سے میرے دعویداروں کو مجھ سے راضی کر دے
مجھے اپنی بخشش و خوشنودی عطا فرما

segs.ar: اِلٰهِیْ ذَهَبَتْ أَیَّام لَذَّاتِیْ وَبَقِیَتْ مَاٰثِمِیْ وَتَبِعَاتِیْ
segs.ur: میرے معبود! میری لذتوں کے دن گزر گئے، میرے گناہ اور ان کا انجام رہ گیا ہے۔

segs.ar: وَأَتَیْتُكَ مُنِیْبًا تَائِبًا، فَلَا تَرُدَّنِیْ مَحْرُوْمًا وَلَا خَائِبًا
segs.ur: اب میں توبہ کے ساتھ تیرے پاس آیا ہوں، پس مجھےمحرومی و ناکامی کے ساتھ واپس نہ پلٹا۔
اے معبود! میرے خوف کو امن میں بدل دے، خطائیں معاف فرما

segs.ar: وَتُبْ عَلَیَّ اِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِیْمُ
segs.ur: اور میری توبہ قبول کر، بے شک تو بڑا توبہ قبول کرنے والا مہربان ہے۔

segs.note: Dua when commencing the journey

segs.ar:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ، وَتَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ.
اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي وَاحْفَظْ مَعِي، وَبَلِّغْنِي وَبَلِّغْ مَعِي بِبَلَاغِكَ الْحُسْنِ.
بِاللَّهِ أَسْتَفْتِحُ وَبِاللَّهِ أَسْتَنْجِحُ وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَتَوَجَّهُ.
اللَّهُمَّ سَهِّلْ لِي كُلَّ حُزُونَةٍ، وَذَلِّلْ لِي كُلَّ صُعُوبَةٍ، وَأَعْطِنِي مِنْ خَيْرِ كُلِّهِ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا أَرْجُو، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي مِنَ الشَّرِّ مِمَّا أُحَذِّرُ فِي عَافِيَةٍ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segs.en: O Allah! Protect me and protect what is with me (my possessions), and deliver me (to my destination and delivery what is with me the best of your delivery. By Allah I commence (my journey) and by Allah I seek to accomplish (the purpose of my journey) and by Muhammad (s.a.w.) I have set out (towards my destination). O Allah make me overcome all (my grief); and make easy for me all difficulties; and give me more of goodness than I hope for; and keep away all evil of which I am apprehensive for my health. O the most Merciful.
segs.tr: Bismillahi,aamantu billahi, wa tawakkaltu allallahi, ma-sha-allah, la haula wala quawwata illa billah. Allahumma ahadhni wahfadh ma ma`ee wa ballighnee wa balligh ma ma ma`ee bi blalaghikalhusn, billahi astaftihu wa billahi astanjihu wa bi muhammadin sallallahu alaiyhi wa aalihi atawajjahu. Allahukka sahhil lee kulla huzoonatin wa dhallil lee kulla huzoonatin wa dhallil lee kulla su`oobatin wa a`tinee mina khairi kullih akhtar mimma arju wasirf annee minash-sharri mimma uhad-diru fee aafi;yatin, ya arhamarrahimeen.

segs.note: Dua to be recited when mounting or boarding the means of transport

segs.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ. الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ.
segs.en: In the name of Allah and there is no power save with Allah. Praise be to Allah who made this (the means of transport) subservient to us, and we (by ourselves) could never have accomplished it.
segs.tr: Bismillahi walaa Quwwata illa Billahi. Alhamdu lillahil-ladhee sakh-khara lana haadha wama kaunna lahu muqrineen .

segs.note: Dua to be recited when dismounted or disembarking.(23:29)

segs.ar: رَبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ
segs.en: O`My Lord! Cause me to disembark a blessed alighting and you are the Best of all who cause to alight.
segs.tr: Rabbee anzilnee manzilan mubarakan wa anta khairul-munzileen.

segs.note: The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.) in his journey use to praise Allah (s.w.t.) by saying 'SUBHAAN ALLAH' when dismounting and 'ALLAHU AKBER' when mounting.

Imam Ja‘ffer as-Sadiq (a.s.) has said: Whoever recites sura Tawheed ten times when leaving his house, he will remain in the protection of the Al-Mighty Allah and His angles until he returns to his house. Ref: (Makarimul Akhlaaq)

Some scholars also emphasize the recitation of Tasbeeh of Sayyidah Fatima (a.s.) daughter of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.). The Tasbeeh is recited in the following manner: 34 times Allahu Akber 33 times Alhumdu Lillah and 33 times Subhan Allah.
A Recitation For protection from any form of fear or problem during travel - Source Book khawasul Ayat by Author Aga taqi najafi isphahani
Draw a imaginary line around you
Recite Ayatul Kursi and Surahs Ikhlass , Falaq and Naas
Then this Ayat 9 :51

segs.ar: قُلْ لَّنْ يُّصِيْبَنَاۤ اِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللّٰهُ لَنَا ۚ هُوَ مَوْلٰٮنَا ‌ ۚ وَعَلَى اللّٰهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ‏
segs.en: Say, ‘Nothing will befall us except what Allah has ordained for us. He is our master, and in Allah let all the faithful put their trust.’
segs.tr: Qul lany-yuseebanaaa illaa maa katabal laahu lanaa Huwa mawlaanaa; wa 'alal laahi falyatawak kalimu 'minoon

segs.ar:
ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي هَدَانَا لِلْإِسْلَامِ وَعَلَّمَنَا ٱلْقُرْآنَ وَمَنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ.
سُبْحَانَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ.
وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ.
ٱللَّهُمَّ أَنتَ ٱلْحَامِلُ عَلَى ٱلظَّهْرِ وَٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَى ٱلْأَمْرِ.
وَأَنتَ ٱلصَّاحِبُ فِي ٱلسَّفَرِ وَٱلْخَلِيفَةُ فِي ٱلْأَهْلِ وَٱلْمَالِ وَٱلْوَلَدِ.
ٱللَّهُمَّ أَنتَ عَضُدِي وَنَاصِرِي.
segs.en: All praise is for Allah Who guided us in Islam and taught us the Quran and graced us with Muhammad (s.a.w.). Glory be to Allah Who made this (the means of transport) subservient to us, and we (by ourselves) could never have accomplished it. And surely to our Lord we shall return. All praise is for Allah, the Lord of the worlds. `O` Allah! You are the Facilitator of the journey and the helper in the affair and you are the Companion in the journey, and the Successor (incharge of my) family, property and son. `O` Allah! You are my supporter and my Helper to Victory.
segs.tr: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhee hadaana Lil-Islam wa allamanal Qu`ran wa manna alayna bi muhammadin sallallhu alayhi wa aalihi. Subhanal-ladhee sakh-khara lana haadha wama kunna lahu muqrineen, Wa inna illa rabbina lamuqaliboon. Walhamdu lillahi rabbil aalameen. Allahumma antal haamilu aladhdhahr walmusta`anu alal-amr. Wa antas-sahibu fis-sfar wal khaleefatu fil-ahli wal-maali wal-walad. Allahumma anta adhdee wa naasiree.

segs.note: Dua to be recited when entering a new town, city or village.

segs.ar:
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا.
اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْنَا إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهَا وَحَبِّبْ صَالِحِي أَهْلِهَا إِلَيْنَا.
segs.en: O Allah! I beseech from you its (town, city or village) goodness and seek refuge in you from its wickedness. O Allah! let its inhabitants love us and let us love its virtous inhabitants.
segs.tr: Allahumma innee as-aluka khairaha wa a`oodhu bika min sharriha. Allahumma habbibna ilaa ahliha wa habbib saalihi ahliha ilayna.

segs.note: Dua to be recited on a return journey

segs.ar:
آئِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ عَابِدُونَ رَاكِعُونَ سَاجِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ.
اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَىٰ حِفْظِكَ إِيَّايَ فِي سَفَرِي وَحَضَرِي.
اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أَوْبَتِي هَذِهِ مُبَارَكَةً مَيْمُونَةً مَقْرُونَةً بِتَوْبَةٍ نَصُوحٍ تُوجِبُ لِي بِهَا السَّعَادَةَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
segs.en: If Allah wills, we repent and seek pardon from Him; we worship Him and Him we bow and prostrate. Our Lord we praise. O` Allah! Make this return (journey) of mine a blessed one, a fruitful one, associated with a sincere repentance; one that will make prosperity incumbent for me. O the Most Merciful.
segs.tr: Aa-iboona taa-iboona insha Allah aabi doona raki`oona saajidoona lirabbina haamidoon. Allahumma lakal hamdu ala hifdhika iyyaya fee safaree wa hadharee. Allahummaj`al aubatee haadhihi mubarakatan maimoonatan maqroonatan be taubatin nasoohin toojablee bihas-sa`adah ya Arhamar-Rahimeen.

segs.note: Dua to be recited when travelling by ship

segs.ar:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الْمَلِكِ الْحَقِّ.
وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ بِيَمِينِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ.
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرَاهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ.
segs.en: In the name of Allah! The Master! The Truth! They esteemed not Allah with an esteem due to Him. The whole earth is under His hold on the day of resurrection and the heavens folded at His command.Az-Zumar (39:67) Glory be to him and the High above! He is beyond the attribution of any partner. In the name of Allah be its course (sailing) and its arrival (anchorage). Verily my Lord is All Forgiving, All Merciful.(11:41)
segs.tr: Bismillahil malikil Haq. Wama qadarullahahaqqa qadarihi wal ardhu jamee`an qabdhatuhu yaumall qiyamati was-sawamatu matwiyyatun biyameenihi subhaanahu wata`ala amma yshrikoon. Bismillahi majraha wa mursaha inna rabbee laghafoorun Raheemen.

segs.note: Duas before setting out (Baqiyat al-Salihat)

When you decide to go on a journey, you are advised to observe fasting on Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday, and to begin your journey on Saturday, Tuesday, or Thursday. Avoid traveling on Mondays, Wednesdays, and before noon on Fridays. Also, avoid traveling on the third, fifth, thirteenth, sixteenth,([1]) twenty-first, twenty-fourth, and twenty-fifth of each month. Avoid traveling when the moon wanes and when it is in Scorpion. When one has to travel on such days and conditions, it is necessary to say the supplicatory prayers of travel and to give alms. It is narrated that one of the companions of Imam al-Baqir (‘a) visited him to bid him farewell, for he would go on a journey. Advising him, the Imam (‘a) said, “When he would travel for settling his affairs, my father, ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn (‘a), used to buy his safety from Almighty Allah with any possible amount of alms. He used to give alms when he put his leg on the stirrup of his riding animal. When he returned from a journey peacefully, he would praise and thank Almighty Allah by means of giving alms.” Unfortunately, the man violated the advice of Imam al-Baqir (‘a); therefore, he died during the journey. When he was informed about this, Imam al-Baqir (‘a) said, “Had he accepted the advice, he would have been saved.”

Before beginning a journey, you are required to bathe yourself, gather your family members, offer a two unit prayer, pray Almighty Allah for your good, praise and thank Him, invoke His blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household, and say the following:

segs.en: O Allah, I, on this day, beseech You to accept as trusts my self,
segs.tr: allahumma inni astawdi`uka alyawma nafsi

segs.en: my family members, my property, my sons,
segs.tr: wa ahli wa mali wa wuldi

segs.en: and every one who is under my custody—
segs.tr: wa man kana minni bisabilin

segs.en: the present and the absent.
segs.tr: alshshahida minhum walgha'iba

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱحْفَظْنَا بِحِفْظِ ٱلإِيـمَانِ وَٱحْفَظْ عَلَيْنَا
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) protect us with the protection of faith and surround us with Your care.
segs.tr: allahumma ihfazna bihifzi al'imani wahfaz `alayna

segs.en: O Allah, (please do) include us with Your mercy
segs.tr: allahumma ij`alna fi rahmatika

segs.en: and do not divest us of Your favors,
segs.tr: wa la taslubna fadlaka

segs.en: for we do desire for You.
segs.tr: inna ilayka raghibuna

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ ٱلسَّفَرِ
segs.en: O Allah, we do seek Your safeguard against troubles of traveling,
segs.tr: allahumma inna na`udhu bika min wa`tha'i alssafari

segs.en: disappointing objectives,
segs.tr: wa ka'abati almunqalabi

segs.ar: وَسُوءِ ٱلْمَنْظَرِ فِي ٱلاهْلِ وَٱلْمَالِ وَٱلْوَلَدِ
segs.en: and bad result in my family members, property, and sons
segs.tr: wa su'i almanzari fi al-ahli walmali walwaladi

segs.en: in this world as well as the world to come.
segs.tr: fi alddunya wal-akhirati

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ هٰذَا ٱلتَّوَجُّهَ
segs.en: O Allah, I am turning my face towards You in this way
segs.tr: allahumma inni atawajjahu ilayka hadha alttawajjuha

segs.en: seeking Your pleasure and seeking nearness to You.
segs.tr: talaban limardatika wa taqarruban ilayka

segs.en: O Allah, (please) help me achieve my aim and attain my hope
segs.tr: allahumma faballighni ma u'ammiluhu wa arjuhu

segs.en: in You and in Your Saints.
segs.tr: fika wa fi awliya'ika

segs.en: O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
segs.tr: ya arhama alrrahimina

segs.note: You may then bid your family members farewell and stand up. At the door of your house, you may say the (famous) Tasbih al-Zahra' litany and recite Surah al-Fatihah and ªyah al-Kursi in front of you, on your right side, and on your left side. You may then say this supplicatory prayer:

segs.en: O Allah, to You am I turning my face
segs.tr: allahumma ilayka wajjahtu wajhi

segs.ar: وَعَلَيْكَ خَلَّفْتُ اهْلِي وَمَالِي وَمَا خَوَّلْتَنِي
segs.en: and with You do I keep my family members, my property, and everything with which You have allowed me to behave.
segs.tr: wa `alayka khallaftu ahli wa mali wa ma khawwaltani

segs.en: I have trusted in You; so, do not disappoint me.
segs.tr: wa qad wathiqtu bika fala tukhayyibni

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ لاََ يُخَيِّبُ مَنْ ارَادَهُ
segs.en: O He Who saves those who trust in Him from disappointment
segs.tr: ya man la yukhayyibu man aradahu

segs.en: and does not give up those whom He safeguards.
segs.tr: wa la yudayyi`u man hafizahu

segs.en: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa alihi

segs.en: watch over all that from which I am absent,
segs.tr: wahfazni fima ghibtu `anhu

segs.en: and do not refer my affairs to myself,
segs.tr: wa la takilni ila nafsi

segs.en: O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.([2])
segs.tr: ya arhama alrrahimina

segs.note: You may then recite Surah al-Tawhid eleven times, Surah al-Qadr, ªyah al-Kursi, Surah al-Falaq, and Surah al-Nas, and then pass your hand over your entire body, give alms as much as possible, and say the following:

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ٱِشْتَرَيْتُ بِهٰذِهِ ٱلصَّدَقَةِ سَلاَمَتِي
segs.en: O Allah, I am purchasing, with this alms, my safety
segs.tr: allahumma inni ishtaraytu bihadhihi alssadaqati salamati

segs.en: and the safety of my journey and my possessions.
segs.tr: wa salamata safari wa ma ma`i

segs.en: O Allah, (please do) safeguard me and whatever is with me,
segs.tr: allahumma ihfazni wahfaz ma ma`iya

segs.en: save me and whatever is with me,
segs.tr: wa sallimni wa sallim ma ma`iya

segs.en: and observe me and whatever is with me
segs.tr: wa ballighni wa balligh ma ma`iya

segs.en: with Your excellent, pleasant care.
segs.tr: bibalaghika alhasani aljamili

segs.note: You may also take with you an almond stick. The Holy Prophet (s) is reported to have said:

Whoever goes on a journey, takes with him an almond stick, and recites the following verses, Almighty Allah will secure him from all beasts, all thieves, and all diseases until he returns home. He will be also accompanied by seventy-seven successive angels asking Almighty Allah to forgive him. These verses are as follows:

([1]) According to some narrations, it is favorable to begin a journey on the twenty-first day of a month (according to the Muslim calendar) and to avoid traveling on the eighth and the twenty-third. The author of this book cites two poetic verses, in Farsi, in which the days on which it is discommended to travel are mentioned. According to these verses, it is ill-omened to travel on the following seven days: the third, fifth, thirteenth, sixteenth, twenty-first, twenty-fourth, and twenty-fifth of a month.
([2]) The completion of this supplicatory prayer, as is quoted from Mustadrak al-Wasa'il by al-Mirza al-Nuri 8:131, is as follows:

segs.en: O Allah, (please) help me attain that for which I am directing,
segs.tr: allahumma ballighni ma tawajjahtu lahu

segs.en: prepare for me the causes of the achievement of my intention,
segs.tr: wa sabbib liya almurada

segs.en: make helpful for me Your servants and Your lands,
segs.tr: wa sakhkhir li `ibadaka wa biladaka

segs.ar: وَٱرْزُقْنِي زِيَارَةَ نَبِيِّكَ وَوَلِيِّكَ امِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segs.en: facilitate for me visitations to Your Prophet, Your Saint the Commander of the Believers,
segs.tr: warzuqni ziyarata babiyyika wa waliyyika amiri almu'minina

segs.en: the Imams from his progeny,
segs.tr: wal-a'immati min wuldihi

segs.ar: وَجَمِيعِ اهْلِ بَيْتِهِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
segs.en: and all the members of his household—peace be upon him and them.
segs.tr: wa jami`i ahli baytihi `alayhi wa `layhim alssalamu

segs.en: (Please) supply me with aid under all conditions of mine,
segs.tr: wa muddani bilma`unati fi jami`i ahwali

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَىٰ نَفْسِي وَلاَ إِلَىٰ غَيْرِي
segs.en: never leave me to myself or to anyone else;
segs.tr: wa la takilni ila nafsi wa la ila ghayri

segs.en: lest, I will tire myself and I will suffer loss,
segs.tr: fa'akillu wa u`tabu

segs.en: (please) provide me with piety,
segs.tr: wa zawwidni alttaqwa

segs.en: and forgive me in the Next World and this world.
segs.tr: waghfir li fi al'akhirati wal'ula

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْنِي اوْجَهَ مَنْ تَوَجَّهَ إِِلَيْكَ
segs.en: O Allah, make me the most acceptable of all those who turn their faces to You.
segs.tr: allahumma ij`alni awjaha man tawajjaha ilayka

segs.note: It is also recommended that you, at journeys, put a turban and roll it to the lower jaw so as to escape stealth, drowning, and burning. You may also take an amount of the soil of Imam al-Husayn’s tomb (turbat al-husayn) with you, saying:

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ هٰذِهِ طِينَةُ قَبْرِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
segs.en: O Allah, this soil from the tomb of al-Husayn, peace be upon him,
segs.tr: allahumma hadhihi tinatu qabri alhusayni `alayhi alssalamu

segs.en: Your saint and the son of Your saint,
segs.tr: waliyyika wabni waliyyika

segs.ar: إِتَّخَذْتُهَا حِرْزاً لِمَا اخَافُ وَمَا لاََ اخَافُ
segs.en: I have taken with me as refuge against whatever I fear and whatever I do not fear.
segs.tr: ittakhadhtuha hirzan lima akhafu wa ma la akhafu

segs.note: Imam al-Sadiq (‘a) is reported as saying: If one recites Ayah al-Kursi every night during journey, he, as well as whatever is with him, will be in safety. One may add the following supplicatory prayer:

segs.en: O Allah, (please do) make me learn lessons while I am walking (in this journey),
segs.tr: allahumma ij`al masiri `ibaran

segs.en: ponder (over the creation of things) while I am silent,
segs.tr: wa samti tafakkuran

segs.en: and mention You while I am talking.
segs.tr: wa kalami dhikran

segs.note: Imam Zayn al-‘ªbidin (‘a) is reported to have said: When I say the following words, I do not care even if both men and jinn help each other against me:

segs.en: In the Name of Allah (I begin), in Allah (I trust),
segs.tr: bismi allahi wa billahi

segs.en: from Allah (I derive power), to Allah (I refer all my affairs),
segs.tr: wa min allahi wa ila allahi

segs.en: and on the way of Allah (I proceed).
segs.tr: wa fi sabili allahi

segs.en: O Allah, to You have I submitted myself,
segs.tr: allahumma ilayka aslamtu nafsi

segs.en: towards You have I turned to face,
segs.tr: wa ilayka wajjahtu wajhi

segs.en: and to You do I refer all my affairs;
segs.tr: wa ilayka fawwadtu amri

segs.en: so, (please do) safeguard me with the guard of faith
segs.tr: fahfazni bihifzi al'imani

segs.en: from my front, from my back,
segs.tr: min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi

segs.en: from my right side, from my left side,
segs.tr: wa `an yamini wa `an shimali

segs.en: from above, and from beneath me;
segs.tr: wa min fawqi wa min tahti

segs.en: and (please do) defend me with Your Might and Power,
segs.tr: wadfa` `anni bihawlika wa quwwatika

segs.ar: فَإِنَّهُ لاََ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
segs.en: for there is no might and no power save with Allah the All-high and All-great.
segs.tr: fa'innahu la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi

segs.note: travel

segs.en: In the Name of Allah is my leaving
segs.tr: bismillahi makhraje

segs.en: and by His permission I have left.
segs.tr: wa bi'dhnihe kharajtu

segs.ar: وَقَدْ عَلِمَ قَبْلَ انْ اخْرُجَ خُرُوجِي
segs.en: He has known about my leaving before I left
segs.tr: wa qad `alima qabla an akhruja khuruje

segs.ar: وَقَدْ احْصَىٰ عِلْمُهُ مَا فِي مَخْرَجِي وَمَرْجِعِي
segs.en: and His knowledge has encompassed what I will face in my departure and my return.
segs.tr: wa qad aha `ilmuhu ma fe makhraje wa marji`e

segs.en: I put my trust in the All-great God;
segs.tr: tawakkaltu `ala al-ilahi al-akbari

segs.en: a trust of one who delegates all of his affairs to Him,
segs.tr: tawakkula mufawwiin ilayhi amrahu

segs.en: who seeks His help in all of his affairs,
segs.tr: wa musta`enin bihe `ala sh'unihe

segs.en: who prays for more favors of Him,
segs.tr: mustazedin min falihe

segs.en: mubri'in nafsahu min kulli hawlin

segs.note: and who disavows that there may be any might

segs.en: or any power except with Him.
segs.tr: wa min kulli quwwatin illa bihe

segs.en: [I thus leave] the leaving of an injured one
segs.tr: khuruja arerin

segs.en: who has left, carrying his injury, towards the One Who can relieve it,
segs.tr: kharaja biurrihe ila man yakshifuhu

segs.en: the leaving of a poor one
segs.tr: wa khuruja faqerin

segs.en: who has left carrying his poverty to the One Who can fill it,
segs.tr: kharaja bifaqrihe ila man yasudduhu

segs.en: the leaving of a needy one
segs.tr: wa khuruja `a'ilin

segs.en: who has left carrying his neediness to the One Who can meet it,
segs.tr: kharaja bi`aylatihe ila man yughneha

segs.en: the leaving of one whose Lord is his grandest trustworthy,
segs.tr: wa khuruja man rabbuhu akbaru thiqatihe

segs.en: his greatest hoped,
segs.tr: wa a`amu raja'ihe

segs.en: and his most favorable grantor of wishes.
segs.tr: wa afalu a'umniyyatihe

segs.ar: اَللَّهُ ثِقَتِي فِي جَمِيعِ امُورِي كُلِّهَا
segs.en: Allah is my trust in all of my affairs
segs.tr: allahu thiqate fe jame`i umure kulliha

segs.en: in all of which I seek His help.
segs.tr: bihe feha jame`an asta`enu

segs.ar: وَلاَ شَيْءَ إِلاَّ مَا شَاءَ ٱللَّهُ فِي عِلْمِهِ
segs.en: Nothing can come to pass except what Allah has willed in His [eternal] knowledge.
segs.tr: wa la shay'a illa ma sha'a allahu fe `ilmihe

segs.en: I pray Allah for guiding to the best departure and the best return.
segs.tr: as'alu allaha khayra almakhraji walmadkhali

segs.ar: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
segs.en: There is no god save Him. To Him is the final return.
segs.tr: la ilaha illa huwa ilayhi almaeru

segs.note: Travel duas from the book "101 Duas"
Dua No. 13 When anyone loses way
According to Hazrat Ali (a.s.)
a person who loses one's way should give the following call:

segs.en: O Saleh! Render help unto me!
segs.tr: Yaa saaleho aghisnee

segs.note: for among the Momin jins there are those who are called Saleh who make the Almighty happy by living in the desert and on hearing anyone call of distress they will reply and show the way.
Reliable tradition from Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.) state
when one loses the way one should give the following call:

segs.ar: يَا صَالِحُ يَا اَبَا صَالِحٍ أَرْشِدُوْنَا إِلَى الطَّرِيْقِ رَحِمَكُمُ اللهُ
segs.en: O Saleh and Abaa Saleh may God show His mercy on you show us the right way.
segs.tr: Yaa saaleho yaa abaa saalehin arshedoona elat tareeqe rahemakomul laaho.

segs.note: Dua No. 14 At the time of visiting a dangerous place
According to Imam Jaï'far-e-Sadiq (a.s.)
if a person had to visit a place where he is afraid of something then he should recite the following ayat (verse):

segs.ar: رَبِّ اَدْخِلْنِىْ مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَّ اَخْرِجْنِىْ مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَّ اجْعَلْ لِّىْ مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ سُلْطَانًا نَصِيْرًا.
segs.en: ï'O My Lord! Cause me to enter a goodly entrance and cause me to go out (of) a goodly exit, and grant me from unto Thee an authority to assist (me)ï'
segs.tr: Rabbe adkhilnee mudkhala sidqiwn wa akhrijnee mukhraja sidqiwn waj-aï'l lee mil ladunka sultaanan naseeraa.

segs.note: and when that thing or person comes in front of him, he should recite the Ayatul Kursi.
Dua No. 15 At the time of arrival in new place
Another tradition states that
the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) asked Hazrat Ali (a.s.) to recite the following Dua when alighting on a destination that he may avail of all the benefits of the place and remain safe from its mischief.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ أَنْزِلْنِيْ مُنْزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَ أَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِيْنَ.
segs.en: O Allah make my arrival over here rewarding, for Thou art the best host and care-taker.
segs.tr: Allaahumma anzilnee munzalan mobaarakan wa anta khayrul munzeleen.

segs.note: Dua No. 16 For safety from robbers
According to Imam Moosa Kazim (a.s.)
a person who afraid of robbers and wild animals in a journey should write the following Dua on the back of the horse and by the order of the Almighty God he will be safe from their mischief.

segs.ar: لَا تَخَافُ دَرَكاً وَ لَا تَخْشٰى‏
segs.en: Not fearing to be overtaken, nor being afraid
segs.tr: Laa takhaafo darakan wa laa takhshaa.

segs.note: The reporter of this tradition states that once he was going with a group to Haj. A last a band of wild Arab surrounded the group and attacked them fiercely but he had written this ayat on the back of his horse and taking an oath on Almighty God. Who had made Muhammad (s.a.w.a.) His prophet and Hazrat Ali (a.s.) His Imam he reiterated that the Almighty God had made the robbers blind to his presence and they did not incur him with any loss.
Dua No. 17 Dua and prayer at the time of storm in the sea

The reporter of this tradition states that whenever there was a storm at sea he used to recite the following prayers shown by Imam Jaï'far-e-Sadiq (a.s.): it seemed that there was no storm at all, as the raging sea would suddenly and certainly go clamï'.

segs.ar: اَللهُ الَّذِىْ نَزَّلَ الْكِتَابَ، وَ هُوَ يَتَوَلَّى الصَّالِحِيْنَ.
segs.en: He is Allah who sent down the book (Quran) and He guardeth the virtuous one.[2]
segs.tr: Allaahul laze nazzalal ketaaba, wa howa yatawallas saaleheen.

segs.ar: وَ مَا قَدَرُوْا اللهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهٖ، وَ الْاَرْضُ جَمِيْعًا قَبْضَتُهٗ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَ السَّمٰوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌۢ بِيَمِيْنِهٖ، سُبْحَانَهٗ وَ تَعَالٰى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ.
segs.en: They have esteemed not Allah, as is His due: While the whole earth shall be in His grip on the day of Judgement and heavens rolled up (shall be) in the right hand: Hallowed is He and Exalted is He, high above what they associate (with Him).[3]
segs.tr: wa maa qadarul laaha haqqa qadrehi, wal-arzo jamee-aï'n qabzatohu yawmal qeyaamate was-samaawaato matwiyyaatum be-yameenehi, subhaanahu wa ta-aï'alaa aï'mmaa yushrekoon.

segs.note: Dua No. 18 For safety from drowning
Another tradition from Imam Jaï'far-e-Sadiq (a.s.) asked one to recite the following prayer if one is afraid of drowning:

segs.ar: اِنَّ وَلِىِّىَ اللهُ الَّذِىْ نَزَّلَ الْكِتَابَ، وَ هُوَ يَتَوَلَّى الصَّالِحِيْنَ.
segs.en: Verily my protector is God who sent down the Book (Qurï'an) and He gradeth the virtuous once.[4]
segs.tr: Inna waliyyeyal laahul lazee nazzalal ketaaba, wa howa yatawallas saaleheen.

segs.ar: وَ مَا قَدَرُوْا اللهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهٖ، وَ الْاَرْضُ جَمِيْعًا قَبْضَتُهٗ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَ السَّمٰوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌۢ بِيَمِيْنِهٖ، سُبْحَانَهٗ وَ تَعَالٰى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ.
segs.en: They have esteemed not God, as is His due: while the whole earth shall Be in His grip on the Day of judgement and heavens rolled up (shall be) in His right hand, Hallowed is He, and Exalted is He, high above what they associate (with Him)[5]
segs.tr: wa maa qadarul laaha haqqa qadrehi, wal-arzo jamee-aï'n qabzatohu yawmal qeyaamate was-samaawaato matwiyyaatum be-yameenehi, subhaanahu wa ta-aï'alaa aï'mmaa yushrekoon.

segs.ar:
بِسْمِ ٱللَّـهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ارِيدُ سَفَراً
segs.en: O Allah, I intend to travel;
segs.tr: allahumma inni uridu safaran

segs.en: so, choose for me the best in my journey,
segs.tr: fakhir li fihi
segs.ur: اے معبود میں نے سفر کا ارادہ کیا ہے اس میں بہتری پیدا کر

segs.ar: وَاوْضِحْ لِي فِيهِ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّايِ وَفَهِّمْنِيهِ
segs.en: make clear before me and inspire to me the right understanding of the most accurate attitude,
segs.tr: wa awdih li fihi sabila alrra'yi wa fahhimnihi
segs.ur: اس میں میرے لئے پختہ ارادے کی راہ کھول دے اور سمجھا دے

segs.en: release my determination by means of straightforwardness,
segs.tr: waftah li `azmi bilistiqamati
segs.ur: اس میں میرے لئے ثابت قدمی کا راستہ کھول

segs.en: include me with safety during my journey,
segs.tr: washmulni fi safari bilssalamati
segs.ur: مجھے اس سفر میں سلامتی سے بہرہ مند فرما

segs.en: furnish me with abundant fortune and honor,
segs.tr: wa afidni jazila alhazzi walkaramati
segs.ur: مجھے بہت زیادہ آمدنی اور عزت عطا فرما

segs.en: and preserve me with the excellent safeguard and watching.
segs.tr: wakla'ni bihusni alhifzi walhirasati
segs.ur: مجھے اپنی بہترین حفاظت اور نگرانی میں قرار دے

segs.en: O Allah, send away from me the inconvenience of journeys,
segs.tr: wa jannibni allahumma wa`tha'a al-asfari
segs.ur: اے معبود مجھے سفر کی تھکاوٹوں سے محفوظ فرما

segs.en: make easy for me the difficulty of roughness,
segs.tr: wa sahhil li huzunata al-aw`ari
segs.ur: بیابانوں کی سختیاں میرے لئے آسان کر دے

segs.en: unwrap before me the rug of covering the stations,
segs.tr: watwi li bisata almarahili
segs.ur: دور کی منزلوں کو میرے لئے لپیٹ دے

segs.en: bring nearer to me the remote watering places,
segs.tr: wa qarrib minni bu`da na'yi almanahili
segs.ur: پانی کے دور کے گھاٹ میرے لئے نزدیک کر دے

segs.ar: وَبَاعِدْ فِي ٱلْمَسِيرِ بَيْنَ خُطَىٰ ٱلرَّوَاحِلِ
segs.en: and make spaces to be longer between the steps of our riding animals,
segs.tr: wa ba`id fi almasiri bayna khuta alrrawahili
segs.ur: دوران سفر بارکشوں کے قدموں کو دراز فرما

segs.en: so that the remote distances will be nearby
segs.tr: hatta tuqarriba niyata alba`idi
segs.ur: تا آنکہ دور کے فاصلے قریب ہو جائیں

segs.en: and the rough roads will be smooth.
segs.tr: wa tusahhila wu`ura alshshadidi
segs.ur: اور بیابانوں کی سختیاں آسان ہو جائیں

segs.ar: وَلَقِّنِي ٱللَّهُمَّ فِي سَفَرِي نُجْحَ طَائِرِ ٱلْوَاقِيَةِ
segs.en: O Allah, make me find in this journey success over evil omens,
segs.tr: wa laqqini allahumma fi safari nujha ta'iri alwaqiyati
segs.ur: اور اے معبود اس سفر میں بابرکت پرندے کو میرے ہمراہ کر دے

segs.en: endue me with achievement of wellbeing,
segs.tr: wa habni fihi ghunma al`afiyati
segs.ur: اس میں سلامتی سے بہرہ مند فرما

segs.en: safeguard against failure,
segs.tr: wa khafira alistiqlali

segs.en: guidance to survive dangers,
segs.tr: wa dalila mujawazati al-ahwali
segs.ur: ثابت قدمی کو نگہبان بنا اور راستے کے خطروں کے لئے راہنما عطا کر

segs.en: incentives to gain adequacy,
segs.tr: wa ba`itha wufuri alkifayati

segs.en: and good opportunity to be protected against authorities.
segs.tr: wa saniha khafiri alwilayati
segs.ur: اور بہت زیادہ کفایت کا ذریعہ اورسر پرستی کرنے والا پاسدار عطا کر

segs.en: O Allah, cause my journey to be a reason for winning marvelous security
segs.tr: waj`alhu allahumma sababa `azimi alssilmi

segs.en: and obtaining profits.
segs.tr: hasila alghunmi
segs.ur: اے معبود میرے سفر کو سلامتی والا اور منافع بخش قرار دے

segs.ar: وَٱجْعَلِ ٱللَّيْلَ عَلَيَّ سِتْراً مِنَ ٱلآفَاتِ
segs.en: Make night cover me against banes
segs.tr: waj`al allayla `alayya sitran min al-afati
segs.ur: رات کو میرے لئے آفتوں سے بچاؤ کی اوٹ

segs.en: and daytime defend me against perishing things.
segs.tr: walnnahara mani`an min alhalakati
segs.ur: اور دن کو خطرات میں رکاوٹ کا ذریعہ بنا دے

segs.en: Out of Your omnipotence, (please) hold back the robbers from reaching me
segs.tr: waqta` `anni qita`a lususihi biqudratika
segs.ur: اپنی قدرت سے راہزنوں کی ٹولیوں کو مجھ سے ہٹائے رکھ

segs.en: and, out of Your power, guard me against the beasts
segs.tr: wahrusni min wuhushihi biquwwatika
segs.ur: اپنی طاقت سے مجھے درندوں سے بچائے رکھ

segs.en: so that safety will accompany me in my journey,
segs.tr: hatta takuna alssalamatu fihi musahibati
segs.ur: یہاں تک کہ اس میں سلامتی میری ہمدم رہے

segs.en: wellbeing will attend me,
segs.tr: wal`afiyatu fihi muqarinati

segs.en: good omen will be driven along with me,
segs.tr: walyumnu sa'iqi
segs.ur: اور حفاظت میرے ساتھ ساتھ، برکت میرے پیچھے

segs.en: easiness will embrace me,
segs.tr: walyusru mu`aniqi

segs.en: difficulty will depart me,
segs.tr: wal`usru mufariqi
segs.ur: آسانی میرے ہمراہ، تنگی مجھ سے دور

segs.en: triumph will agree with me,
segs.tr: walfawzu muwafiqi

segs.en: and security will associate with me.
segs.tr: wal-amnu murafiqi
segs.ur: کامیابی میرے ساتھ اور امن میرا ساتھی ہو

segs.en: Verily, You are the Lord of bestowals, conferrals,
segs.tr: innaka dhu alttawli walmanni

segs.en: power, and might,
segs.tr: walquwwati walhawli
segs.ur: بے شک تو بخشش و احسان کا مالک اور قوت و طاقت والا ہے

segs.en: wa anta `ala kulli shay'in qadirun

segs.note: and You have power over all things

segs.en: and You know and regard all of Your servants.
segs.tr: wa bi`ibadika basirun khabirun
segs.ur: تو ہی ہر چیز پر قدرت رکھتا ہےاور اپنے بندوں کو دیکھتا جانتا ہے۔

N_leaving-home.name: Duas when Leaving Home
N_leaving-home.nameUr: گھر سے نکلتے وقت کی دعائیں

segs.note: First: Imam al-Sadiq (`a) is reported to have said: say the following words 3 times just before leaving. If he does, he will be kept under the custody of Allah swt until He returns him to the place he has left:

segs.en: Allah is the Most Great.
segs.tr: allahu akbar

segs.note: Then, repeat the following statement three times:

segs.en: I leave (putting my trust) in Allah,
segs.tr: billahi akhruju

segs.en: I return (putting my trust) in Allah,
segs.tr: wa billahi adkhulu

segs.en: and on Allah do I depend.
segs.tr: wa `ala allahi atawakkalu
segs.ur: خدا کے ساتھ باہر نکلتا ہوں، خدا کے ساتھ اندر آتا ہوں اور خدا پر بھروسا رکھتا ہوں۔

segs.note: Then, say the following one time only:

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱفْتَحْ لِي فِي وَجْهِي هٰذَا بِخَيْرٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please) grant me easiness in the beginning of this affair of mine
segs.tr: allahumma iftah li fi wajhi hadha bikhayrin

segs.en: seal it for me with easiness,
segs.tr: wakhtim li bikhayrin
segs.ur: اے معبود میرے اس کام میں بھلائی کی راہ کھول دے اور اس کا انجام بہتر کر دے

segs.ar: وَقِنِي شَرَّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ انْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segs.en: and guard me against the evil of every living creature that You hold by its forelock.
segs.tr: wa qini sharra kulli dabbatin anta akhidun binasiyatiha
segs.ur: اور مجھے ہر حرکت کرنے والے کی شر سے بچا جس کی مہار تیرے ہاتھ میں ہے

segs.en: Surely, my Lord is on the right path.
segs.tr: inna rabbi `ala siratin mustaqimin
segs.ur: بے شک میرا رب سیدھے راستے پر ہے۔

segs.note: Second: Imam al-Sajjad (`a) is reported to have said: At the door of your house just before you leave it, you may say the following words:

segs.en: In the Name of Allah (I begin) and in Allah (I trust).
segs.tr: bismillahi wa billahi

segs.en: I put my trust in Allah.
segs.tr: tawkkaltu `ala allahi
segs.ur: خدا کے نام سے، میں خدا پر ایمان لایا اور خدا پر بھروسا کرتا ہوں۔

segs.note: Third: Imam al-Baqir (`a) is reported to have said: Whoever says the following statement when he leaves his house, Almighty Allah will save him from whatever of his this-worldly and otherworldly affairs that concern him:

segs.en: In the Name of Allah (I begin).
segs.tr: bismillahi

segs.en: Sufficient to me is Allah.
segs.tr: hasbiya allahu

segs.en: I put my trust in Allah.
segs.tr: wa tawakkaltu `ala allahi

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اسْالُكَ خَيْرَ امُورِي كُلِّهَا
segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You for success in all of my affairs
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka khayra umuri kulliha
segs.ur: اے معبود میں تجھ سے اپنے تمام امور میں خیر چاہتا ہوں

segs.ar: وَاعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ خِزْيِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ ٱلآخِرَةِ
segs.en: and I pray Your protection against disgrace in this world and chastisement in the Hereafter.
segs.tr: wa a`udhu bika min khizyi alddunya wa `adhabi al-akhirati
segs.ur: اور تیری پناہ لیتا ہوں دنیا کی رسوائی اور آخرت کے عذاب سے۔

segs.note: Fourth: Imam al-Sadiq (`a) is reported to have said: Whenever you leave your house, you are advised to say the following prayer:

segs.en: In the Name of Allah (I begin).
segs.tr: bismillahi

segs.en: In Allah I put my trust.
segs.tr: tawakkaltu `ala allahi
segs.ur: خدا کے نام سے، میں نے خدا پر بھروسا کیا

segs.ar: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
segs.en: There is neither might nor power except with Allah.
segs.tr: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
segs.ur: نہیں کوئی حرکت و قوت مگر جو خدا سے ہے

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اسْالُكَ خَيْرَ مَا خَرَجْتُ لَهُ
segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You for success in what I am leaving to do
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka khayra ma kharajtu lahu
segs.ur: اے معبود میں تجھ سے بہتری چاہتا ہوں جس کام لئے جا رہا ہوں

segs.ar: وَاعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَرَجْتُ لَهُ
segs.en: and pray Your protection against failure in what I am leaving to do.
segs.tr: wa a`udhu bika min sharri ma kharajtu lahu
segs.ur: تیری پناہ لیتا ہوں اس کے شر سے جس کام کے لئے نکلا ہوں

segs.en: O Allah, (please) expand Your favors to me,
segs.tr: allahumma awsi` `alayya min fadlika
segs.ur: اے معبود مجھ پر اپنے فضل میں اضافہ فرما

segs.en: make perfect Your graces to me,
segs.tr: wa atmim `alayya ni`mataka
segs.ur: اور مجھے تمام نعمتیں عطا فرما

segs.en: dedicate me to obedience to You,
segs.tr: wasta`milni fi ta`atika
segs.ur: مجھے اپنی فرمانبرداری میں لگا دے

segs.en: make me desire for what You have in possession,
segs.tr: waj`al raghbati fima `indaka
segs.ur: مجھے اس میں رغبت دلا جو کچھ تیرے ہاں ہے

segs.en: and cause me to die carrying the principles You have instructed and the principles of Your Messenger,
segs.tr: wa tawaffani `ala millatika wa millati rasulika

segs.en: ah bless him and his Househo
segs.tr: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segs.ur: اور مجھ کو اپنے دین اور اپنے رسول صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہ کے دین پر موت دینا۔

segs.note: Fifth: Imam al-Rida (`a) is reported to have said: My father (`a) used to say the following words whenever he would leave his house: Image

segs.en: In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
segs.tr: bismillahi alrrahman alrrahimi
segs.ur: خدا کے نام سے جو بڑا رحم والا مہربان ہے

segs.en: I am leaving by the might and power of Allah,
segs.tr: kharajtu bihawli allahi wa quwwatihi
segs.ur: میں نکل رہا ہوں خدا کی طاقت و قوت سے

segs.en: but not by my own might or power;
segs.tr: la bihawlin minni wa quwwati

segs.ar: بَلْ بِحَوْ لِكَ وَقُوَّتِكَ يَا رَبِّ
segs.en: rather, by the might and power of You, O Lord,
segs.tr: bal bihawlika wa quwwatika ya rabbi

segs.en: seeking Your sustenance.
segs.tr: muta`arridan lirizqika

segs.en: So, (please) provide me with it easily.
segs.tr: fa'tini bihi fi `afiyatin
segs.ur: اے میرے مالک تیرے رزق کے حصول کے لئے، پس وہ مجھے آسانی کے ساتھ عطا فرما۔

segs.note: Sixth: Imam al-Sadiq (`a) is reported to have said, “Whoever repeats Surah al-Tawhid ten times before he leaves his house, will be kept under the safeguard and protection of Almighty Allah until he returns home.”
Seventh:Imam Abul Hassan Musa (`a) is reported to have said: When you intend to travel, you may stop at the door of your house and recite

Surah al-Fatiah (No. 1) in front of you as well as to your right and left sides. You may also recite Surah-Tawhid, Surah al-Falaq (No. 113), and Sura al-Naas(No. 114). You may then say the following prayer

segs.en: O Allah, (please) safeguard me and safeguard whatever is with me,
segs.tr: allahumma ihfazni wahfaz ma ma`iya
segs.ur: اے معبود میری حفا ظت فرما اور جو کچھ میرے پاس ہے اس کی بھی

segs.en: keep me safe and keep safe whatever is with me,
segs.tr: wa sallimni wa sallim ma ma`iya
segs.ur: اور جو کچھ میرے پاس ہے اسے سالم رکھ

segs.ar: وَبَلِّغْنِي وَبَلِّغْ مَا مَعِيَ بَلاَغاً حَسَناً
segs.en: and make me and whatever is with me reach my destination in a perfect way.
segs.tr: wa ballighni wa balligh ma ma`iya balaghan hasanan
segs.ur: اور مجھے جو کچھ میرے ہمراہ ہے اسے اچھی طرح اپنی منزل پر پہنچا دے۔

segs.note: Eighth: Imam Musa al-Kazim (`a) is also reported to have said: Whenever you leave your house, whether going on a journey or going to a certain place in your city, you may say the following words:

segs.en: In the Name of Allah (I begin),
segs.tr: bismillahi

segs.en: in Allah do I believe,
segs.tr: amantu billahi

segs.en: and in Allah do I put my trust.
segs.tr: wa tawakkaltu `ala allahi
segs.ur: خدا کے نام سے میں خدا پر ایمان لایا اور خدا پر بھروسا کیا

segs.en: Only what Allah wills (shall come to pass).
segs.tr: ma sha'a allahu

segs.ar: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
segs.en: There is neither might nor power except with Allah.
segs.tr: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
segs.ur: آگے جو اللہ چاہے، نہیں کوئی طاقت و قوت مگر جو اللہ سے ہے۔

segs.note: DUA'A 442 Imam Ali ibn abi Talib (as) advised the believers to say the following dua'a at the time of entering the house & then recite surah al Ikhlas inside the house.

segs.en: Peace be on us from our Lord.
segs.tr: Assalaamu A'laynaa Min Rabbinaa

segs.note: Allah has the Most Beautiful Names, so call Him by them. (Quran 7:180)
segs.ur: اور اللہ کے اچھے اچھے نام ہیں، پس اسے انہی ناموں سے پکارو۔ (الاعراف ۱۸۰)

segs.tr: Allah
segs.en: Allah — the One God
segs.ur: اللہ — معبودِ حقیقی

segs.note: Recite it in the morning and late afternoon and the last 1/3rd part of the night 66 times without 'Yaa' (O'). It would enable you to achieve your aim.

segs.tr: Ar-Rahman
segs.en: 1. The Most Beneficent
segs.ur: بے حد مہربان

segs.tr: Ar-Raheem
segs.en: 2. The Most Merciful
segs.ur: نہایت رحم کرنے والا

segs.tr: Al-Malik
segs.en: 3. The King, the Sovereign
segs.ur: بادشاہِ حقیقی

segs.note: Recite it 64 times; its specialty is continuation of power of one who is regular in it.

segs.tr: Al-Quddus
segs.en: 4. The Most Holy
segs.ur: ہر عیب سے پاک

segs.note: Its specialty is that if it is recited in assembly/company 170 times, the inner self will be purified of impurities.

segs.tr: As-Salam
segs.en: 5. The Source of Peace
segs.ur: سلامتی دینے والا

segs.note: In it is cure of diseases and safety from calamities and if recited on the sick 100 times, he will be cured.

segs.tr: Al-Mu'min
segs.en: 6. The Giver of Security
segs.ur: امن دینے والا

segs.note: If it is recited 136 times it will give protection from the Satans among Jinn or men.

segs.tr: Al-Muhaymin
segs.en: 7. The Guardian, the Overseer
segs.ur: نگہبان

segs.note: Its mention 125 times will earn purity of the soul and he will be informed of realities.

segs.tr: Al-Aziz
segs.en: 8. The Almighty
segs.ur: غالب، زبردست

segs.note: Its mention 94 times after the Morning Prayer everyday would reveal the secrets of Ilme Simia[2] and Alchemy and one who recites it for 40 days, everyday 40 times, will not be needful of anyone.

segs.tr: Al-Jabbar
segs.en: 9. The Compeller
segs.ur: ٹوٹے کو جوڑنے والا، زبردست

segs.note: One who recites it 21 times everyday will be safe from all oppressions.

segs.tr: Al-Mutakabbir
segs.en: 10. The Supreme in Greatness
segs.ur: بڑائی والا

segs.note: One who mentions it in the presence of an oppressor will be able to humble him.

segs.tr: Al-Khaliq
segs.en: 11. The Creator
segs.ur: پیدا کرنے والا

segs.note: Allah will illuminate the heart of one who recites this in excess.

segs.tr: Al-Bari'
segs.en: 12. The Maker, the Originator
segs.ur: ٹھیک ٹھیک بنانے والا

segs.note: One who recites it much will not be punished in the grave till wetness remains in it.

segs.tr: Al-Musawwir
segs.en: 13. The Fashioner of Forms
segs.ur: صورت گر

segs.note: If a barren woman recites it thirteen times and writes it in a bowl and drinks its water, she will be blessed with a righteous male child.

segs.tr: Al-Ghaffar
segs.en: 14. The Ever-Forgiving
segs.ur: بہت بخشنے والا

segs.note: One who recites this at the time of Friday Prayer 100 times saying: 'O Allah forgive me O forgiving one', Allah would forgive him.

segs.tr: Al-Qahhar
segs.en: 15. The Subduer
segs.ur: سب پر غالب

segs.note: Allah would remove from his heart the love of the world. One who recites at the last part of a moonlit night:

segs.tr: Al-Wahhab
segs.en: 16. The Bestower
segs.ur: بہت عطا کرنے والا

segs.note: One who recites it in prostration 14 times, Allah would make him self-sufficient and one who performs it at the end of the night with a bare head and raised hands 100 times, Allah would remove his poverty and fulfill his need and one who mentions frequently:

segs.tr: Ar-Razzaq
segs.en: 17. The Provider
segs.ur: رزق دینے والا

segs.note: One who recites it, would be given a lot of sustenance.

segs.tr: Al-Fattah
segs.en: 18. The Opener, the Judge
segs.ur: کھولنے والا، فیصلہ کرنے والا

segs.note: One who recites it 70 times after the Morning Prayer keeping his hands on his chest; Allah would remove the veil from his heart and from its specialty is that Allah would open divine recognition on the heart of one who recites it.

segs.tr: Al-Aleem
segs.en: 19. The All-Knowing
segs.ur: سب کچھ جاننے والا

segs.tr: Al-Qabid
segs.en: 20. The Withholder
segs.ur: روکنے والا، تنگی دینے والا

segs.note: One who writes it 40 times on 40 morsels (of bread) for 40 days and eats them, Allah would secure him against hunger and prolong his life.

segs.tr: Al-Basit
segs.en: 21. The Expander
segs.ur: کشادگی دینے والا
