segs.en: O most Merciful of all those who show mercy;
segs.tr: O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
segs.ur: اور اپنی مہربانی سے مجھ پر رحمت فرما، ایسب سے زیادہ رحم کرنے والے

segs.en: and by Your might; O All-generous.
segs.ur: واسطہ ہے تیری عزت کا اے کریم

segs.en: I will insistently ask for that which is with You,
persist on You,
segs.ur: کہ میں وہ طلب کرتا ہوں جو تیرے پاس ہے، اور بار بار مانگتا ہوں

segs.en: and extend my hand towards You,
although it has committed offenses against You.
O my Lord, whose protection should I seek
and whose refuge should I take?
None can stand for me save You.
segs.ur: پھر کس کی پناہ لوں اور کس سے عرض کروں، سوائے تیرے میرا کوئی نہیں

segs.en: Will You reject me while You are my one and only confidence
and upon You alone do I rely?
segs.ur: کیا تو مجھے ہنکا دے گا جب کہ تو ہی میرا تکیہ ہے اور تجھی پر میرا بھروسہ ہے

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ وَضَعْتَهٗ عَلَى السَّمَاءِ فَاسْتَقَلَّتْ
segs.en: I thus beseech You in the name of Your Name that when You put it on the heavens, they raised,
segs.ur: میں تیرے اس نام کے ذریعے سوال کرتا ہوں جسے تو نے آسمانوں پر رکھا تو وہ مستقل ہو گئے

segs.en: when You put it on the earth, it settled down,
when You put it on the mountains, they became firm,
segs.ur: اور زمین پر رکھا تو قائم ہو گئی اور پہاڑوں پر رکھا تو وہ اپنی جگہ جم گئے

segs.en: when You put it on the night, it darkled,
and when You put it on the daylight, it lit up,
segs.ur: اور رات پر رکھا تو وہ کالی ہو گئی اور دن پر رکھا تو وہ چمک اٹھا

segs.ar: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: [I beseech You] to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.ur: ہاں تو محمدؐ وآل محمدؐ پر رحمت نازل فرما

segs.en: satisfy all my wants,
segs.ur: اور میری تمام حاجتیں پوری کر دے

segs.en: forgive all my sins,
the trivial and the significant,
segs.ur: اور میرے سبھی گناہ معاف فرما دے چھوٹے بھی اور بڑے بھی

segs.en: and expand my sustenance

segs.ar: مَا تُبَلِّغُنِيْ بِهٖ شَرَفَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
segs.en: to the scope that I can attain the honor of this world and the Hereafter.
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
segs.tr: O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
segs.ur: دنیا اور آخرت میں عزت، اے سب سے زیادہ رحم کرنے والے

segs.en: My Master, Your help do I seek;
segs.ur: میرے مولا میں تجھی سے مدد مانگتا ہوں

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَعِنِّيْ
segs.en: so, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and help me!
Your protection do I seek; so, (please) protect me.
segs.ur: اور میری مدد کر، میں تیری پناہ لیتا ہوں، پس مجھے پناہ دے

segs.en: Through my obedience to You, (please) suffice me from obedience to Your servants.
segs.ur: اور اپنی اطاعت کے ذریعے مجھے اپنے بندوں کی اطاعت سے بے نیاز کر دے

segs.en: Through my entreaty to You; (please) suffice me from beseeching Your creatures.
segs.ur: اپنا سوالی بنا کر لوگوں کا سوالی بننے سے بچا لے

segs.ar: وَانْقُلْنِيْ مِنْ ذُلِّ الْفَقْرِ اِلٰى عِزِّ الْغِنٰى
segs.en: Transfer me from the humiliation of poverty to the honor of richness
segs.ur: اور فقر کی ذلت سے نکال کر بے نیازی کی عزت دے

segs.ar: وَمِنْ ذُلِّ الْمَعَاصِي اِلٰى عِزِّ الطَّاعَةِ
segs.en: and from the humiliation of acts of disobedience to You to the honor of obedience to You.
segs.ur: اور نافرمانی کی ذلت کے بجائے فرمانبرداری کی عزت دے

segs.ar: فَقَدْ فَضَّلْتَنِيْ عَلٰى كَثِيْرٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.en: You have really given me preference over many of Your creatures
segs.ur: تو نے مجھے اپنے کثیر بندوں پر جو بڑائی دی ہے

segs.en: out of Your magnanimity and generosity,
although I do not deserve it.
segs.ur: وہ محض تیرا فضل و کرم ہے نہ یہ کہ میں اس کا حقدار ہوں

segs.ar: اِلٰهِي فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلٰى ذٰلِكَ كُلِّهٖ
segs.en: My God, all praise be to You for all that.
segs.ur: اے معبود تیرے ہی لیے حمد ہے کہ تو نے یہ مہربانیاں فرمائیں

segs.en: (Please) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.ur: محمدؐ و آل محمدؑ پر رحمت نازل فرما

segs.en: and include me with those who are thankful for Your bounties
segs.ur: اور مجھے قرار دے اپنی نعمتوں کے شکرگذاروں

segs.en: and those who permanently mention Your graces.
segs.ur: اور اپنے احسانوں کو یاد کرنے والوں میں

segs.note: You should then prostrate yourself and say the following:
segs.ur: پھر آپ کو چاہیے کہ سجدہ کریں اور درج ذیل کہیں:

segs.en: My lowly face is humbly prostrating
before Your All-majestic and Almighty Face.
segs.ur: میرے کمتر چہرے نے تیری ذات عزیز و جلیل کو سجدہ کیا

segs.en: My rotten, mortal face is prostrating
before Your Everlasting, Eternal Face.
segs.ur: میرے فانی و پست چہرے نے تیری ہمیشہ قائم رہنے والی ذات کو سجدہ کیا

segs.en: My poor face is prostrating
before Your All-dependent and All-great Face.
segs.ur: میرے محتاج چہرے نے تیری بے نیاز و بلند ذات کو سجدہ کیا

segs.en: Prostrating are my face, my hearing, my sight,
segs.ur: سجدہ کیا میرے چہرے، کان، آنکھ نے

segs.en: my flesh, my blood, my skin,
my bones, and whatever part of me that is carried by the earth
before Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
segs.ur: اور میرا جو کچھ روئے زمین پر ہے اس نے عالمین کے رب کو (سجدہ کیا)

segs.en: O Allah, return upon my ignorance with Your indulgence,
segs.ur: خدایا میری جہالت کو بردباری سے ڈھانپ لے

segs.en: upon my neediness with Your self-sufficiency,
segs.ur: میری محتاجی پر اپنی دولت برسا دے

segs.en: upon my humiliation with Your Almightiness and Authority,
segs.ur: میری پستی کو اپنی بلندی و اختیار سے دور فرما

segs.en: upon my powerlessness with Your omnipotence,
segs.ur: اور میری کمزوری کو اپنی قوت سے دور کر دے

segs.en: upon my fearfulness with Your security,
segs.ur: اور میرے خوف کو اپنے امن سے مٹا دے

segs.en: and upon my sins and offenses with Your pardon and mercy.
segs.ur: اور میری خطاؤں اور گناہوں کو اپنی رحمت سے بخش دے

segs.en: O All-beneficent! O All-merciful!
segs.ur: اے رحم والے اے مہربان

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَدْرَاُ بِكَ فِي نَحْرِ
segs.en: O Allah, I seek You to protect me against…
segs.ur: اے اللہ میں تیری پناہ لیتا ہوں فلاں بن فلاں کے حملوں سے

segs.note: Mention the name of your enemy. Then say:
segs.ur: اپنے دشمن کا نام لیں۔ پھر کہیں:

segs.en: I seek Your protection against his evils;
segs.ur: اور اس کے شر سے تیری پناہ چاہتا ہوں

segs.en: so, (please) save me from him just as You have saved Your Prophets,
segs.ur: پس اس سے میری کفایت کر جیسے کفایت فرمائی اپنے انبیاء کی

segs.en: Your intimate servants among Your creatures, and Your righteous servants
segs.ur: اور اولیاء کی، اپنی مخلوق سے اپنے نیک بندوں کی

segs.en: against the tyrants amongst Your creatures,
and the oppressors amongst Your enemies
segs.ur: اپنی مخلوق میں سے سرکشوں اور شریروں سے جو تیرے دشمن تھے

segs.en: and against the evil of all Your creatures.
[I ask You] in the name of Your mercy; O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
segs.ur: اور ساری مخلوق کے شر سے، اپنی رحمت کے ساتھ اے سب سے زیادہ رحم کرنے والے

segs.en: Verily, You have power over all things.
segs.ur: بے شک تو ہر چیز پر قادر ہے

segs.en: Sufficient unto us is Allah; He is the best protector.
segs.ur: اور اللہ ہمارے لیے کا فی ہے جو بہترین کارساز ہے

N_noor.name: Dua e Noor

segs.note: Recite regularly, each morning and evening:
segs.ur: ہر صبح و شام پابندی سے پڑھیں:

segs.en: In the Name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.
segs.tr: BISMIL LAAHIR RAHMAANIR RAHEEM
segs.ur: خدا کے نام سے شروع جو بڑا مہربان اور نہایت رحم والا ہے

segs.en: In the Name of Allah, the Light (Nur).
segs.tr: BISMIL LAAHIN NOOR
segs.ur: خداوند نور کے نام کے واسطے سے

segs.en: In the Name of Allah, the Light of the Light.
segs.tr: BISMIL LAAHIN NOORIN NOOR
segs.ur: اس خدا کے نام کے واسطے سے جو نور کا نور ہے

segs.en: In the Name of Allah, Light upon Light.
segs.tr: BISMIL LAAHIN NOORE A’LAA NOORIN
segs.ur: اس خدا کے نام کے واسطے سے جو نور پر نور ہے

segs.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِيْ هُوَ مُدَبِّرُ الْاُمُوْرِ
segs.en: In the Name of Allah, Who is the Controller of all Affairs.
segs.tr: BISMIL LAAHIL LAZEE HOWA MODABBERUL OMOORE
segs.ur: اس خدا کے نام کے واسطے سے جو کاموں کو سنوارنے والا ہے

segs.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ خَلَقَ النُّوْرَ مِنَ النُّوْرِ
segs.en: In the Name of Allah, Who created the Light from the Light.
segs.tr: BISMIL LAAHE KHAALEQIN NOORE MENAN NOOR
segs.ur: اس خدا کے نام کے واسطے سے جس نے نور کو نور سے پیدا کیا

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ النُّوْرَ مِنَ النُّوْرِ
segs.en: Praise be to Allah, Who created the Light from the Light,
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE KHALAQAN NOORA MENAN NOORE
segs.ur: حمد اسی خدا کیلئے ہے جس نے نور کو نور سے پیدا کیا

segs.en: and sent down the Light upon [Mount] Tur (Sinai),
segs.tr: WA ANZALAN NOORA A’LAT TOORE
segs.ur: اور نور کو کوہ طور پر نازل کیا

segs.en: in a written book,
segs.tr: FEE KETAABIM MASTOORIN

segs.en: on an open scroll,
segs.tr: FEE RAQQIM MANSHOORIN
segs.ur: ایک لکھی ہوئی کتاب میں، ایک پھیلے ہوئے ورق میں

segs.en: with a measured decree,
segs.tr: BE-QADARIM MAQDOORIN

segs.en: upon a Prophet who is honored.
segs.tr: A’LAA NABIYYIM MAHBOORIN
segs.ur: اندازے کے مطابق، ایک دانشمند پیغمبرؐ پر

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ هُوَ بِالْعِزِّ مَذْكُوْرٌ
segs.en: Praise be to Allah, Who is mentioned with Glory,
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE HOWA BIL 'IZZIM MAZKOORUN
segs.ur: حمد اسی خدا کے لیے ہے جو عزت کے ساتھ یاد کیا جاتا ہے

segs.en: and known with Honor,
segs.tr: WA BIL-FAKHRE MASHHOORUN
segs.ur: فخر کے ساتھ مشہور ہے

segs.en: and thanked both in ease and in hardship.
segs.tr: WA A’LAS SARRAAAE WAZ ZARRAAAE MASHKOORUN
segs.ur: اور جس کا تنگی و فراخی میں شکر کیا جاتا ہے

segs.en: And may Allah bless our Master Muhammad
segs.tr: WA SALLAL LAAHO A’LAA SAYYEDENAA MOHAMMADINW

segs.en: and his pure progeny.
segs.tr: WA AALEHIT TAAHEREENA.
segs.ur: ہمارے آقا محمدؐ پر اور ان کی آلؑ پرخدا کی رحمت ہو

N_noor.merits: In Muhaj al-Da’awat, Sayyid Ibn Tawus has mentioned a narration quoting Salman as saying, “Lady Fatimah al-Zahra’(a.s.) conveyed to me some words that she had learnt from the Holy Messenger (s.a.w.a.) and she used to repeat them each morning and evening. Moreover, she said that if you would like not to be afflicted by the harm of fever as long as you live in this world, you may say this supplicatory prayer regularly. Salman then added, “As I learnt by heart these words, I conveyed them to more than one thousand persons in al-Madinah and Makkah who had been infected with fever and they all were healed by the will of Almighty Allah.

segs.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
segs.tr: BISMILLAAHIR RAHMAANIR RAHEEM

segs.en: Glory be to Allah, the Supreme! Praise be to He!
segs.tr: SUBHAANALLAAHIL A’ZEEME WA BE HAMDEHI.

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) Divinity! How omnipotent He is!
segs.tr: SUBHAANAHU MIN ELAAHIM MAA-A’QDARAHU.

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) omnipotence! How powerful He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN QADEERIM MA-AKHZAMAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) power! How mighty He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN A’ZEEMIN MAA-AJALLAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) might! How eminent He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAU MIN JALEELIM MAA AMJADAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) eminence! How compassionate He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MAAJEDIM MAA AR-AFAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) compassion! How powerful He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN RA-OOFIM MAA A-A’ZZAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) power! How majestic He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAU MIN A’ZEEZIM MAA AKBARAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (his) majesty! How eternal He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN KABEERIM MAA-AQDAMAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) eternity! How high He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN QADEEMIN MAA-A-A’LAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) highness! How sublime He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN A’LIYYIM MAA ASNAAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) sublimity! How beautiful! He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN SANIYYIM MAA ABHAAHO

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) beauty! How resplendent He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN BAHIHIM MAA AWWARAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) splendour! How manifest He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MONEERIM MAA AZHARAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) manifestation! How secret He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN ZAAHERIM MAA AKHFAAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) secrecy! How intelligent He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN KHAFIYIM MAA A-A’LAMAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (his intelligence! How aware He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN A’LIMIM MAA AKHBARAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) awareness! How generous He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN KHABEERIM MAA AKRAMAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) generosity! How kind He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN KAREEMIM MAA ALTAFAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) kindness! How sagacious He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN LATEEFIM MAA ABSARAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) sagaciousness! How attentive He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN BASEERIM MAA ASMA-A’HU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) hearing! How watchful He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN SAMEE-I’M MAA AHFAZAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) watchfulness! How rich He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN HAFEEZIM MAA AMLAAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) richness! How faithful He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MALIYYIM MAA AWFAAHO

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) faithfulness! How self-sufficient He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN WAFIYYIM MAA AGHNAAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) sufficiency! How liberal He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN GHANIYYIM MAA A-A’TAAHO

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) liberality! How bountiful He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MO’TIM MAA AWSA-A’HU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) bountifulness! How plenteous He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN WAASE-I’M MAA AJWADAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) plenteousness! How superb He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN JAWAADIM MAA AFZALAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) superbness! How charitable He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MOFAZZELIM MAA AN-A’MAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) charitableness! How masterful He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MAN-A’ MIMMAA ASYADAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) masterdom! How Merciful He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN SAYYEDIM MAA ARHAMAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) mercifulness! How severe He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN RAHEEMIM MAA ASHADDOHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) severity! How strong He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN SHADEEDIM MAA AQWAAHO

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) strength! How praiseworthy He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN QAWIYYIM MAA AHMADAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) praiseworthiness, How wise He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN HAMEEDIM MAA AHKAMAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) wisdom! How mighty in His grip He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN HAKEEMIM MAA ABTASHAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) grip! How self-subsisting He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN BAATESHIM MAA AQWAMAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) self-subsistence! How everlasting He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN QAYYOOMIM MAA ADWAMAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) everlastingness! How perpetual He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN DAAA-EMIM MAA ABQAAHO

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) perpetuality! How unique He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN BAAQIM MAA AFRADAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) uniqueness! How singular He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN FARDIM MAA AW-HADAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) singularity! How independent He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN WAAHEDIM MAA ASMADAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) independence! How sovereign He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN SAMADIM MAA AMLAKAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) sovereignty! How authoritative He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MOLEKIM MAA AWLAAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) authority! How great He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN WALIYYIM MAA A-A’ZAMAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) greatness! How perfect He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN A’ZEEMIM MAA AKMALAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) perfectness! How thorough He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN KAAMELIM MAA ATAMMAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (his) thoroughness! How marvellous He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN TAAAM-MIM MAA A’J-MAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) marvelousness! How proud He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN A’JEEBIM MAA AFKHARAHU

segs.en: Glory be to hew in (His) pride! How remote He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN FAAKHERIM MAA AB-A’DAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He is remoteness! How near He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN BA-E’EDIM MAA AQRABAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) nearness! How inaccessible He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN KAREEBIM MAA AMNA-AHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) inaccessibility! How victorious He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MAAA-NE-I’M MAA AGHLABAHU

segs.en: Glory be to (His) victoriousness! How tolerant He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN GHAALEBIM MAA A-A’KAAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) toleration! How indulgent He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN AKUWWIM MAA AHSANAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) indulgence! How adorable He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MOHSENIM MAA AJMALAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) adorableness! How obliging He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN JAMEELIN MAA AQBALAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) obligingness! How thankworthy He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN QAABELIM MAA ASHKARAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in His thank worthiness! How Oft-forgiving He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN SHAKOORIM MAA AGHFARAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) oft-forgiveness! How patient He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN GHAFOORIM MAA ASBARAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) patience! How effective He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN SABOORIM MAA AJBARAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) effectiveness! How judicious He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN JABBAARIM MAA ADYANAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) judiciousness! How decisive He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN DAYYAANIM MAA A’KZAAHO

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) decisiveness! How alert He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN KAAZIM MAA AMZAAHO

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) alertness! How executive He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MAAZIM MAA ANFAZAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) execution! How gentle He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN NAAFEZIM MAA AHLAMAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) gentleness! How refined He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN HALEEMIM MAA AKHLAQAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) refinement! How sustaining He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN KHAALEKIM MAA ARZAQAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) sustainment! How forceful He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN RAAZEKIM MAA AQHARAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) forcibleness! How creative He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN QAAHERIM MAA ANSHAAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) creativeness! How kingly He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MUNSHE-IM MAA AMLAKAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) kingdom! How lordly He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MAALEKIM MAA AWLAAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) lordliness! How lofty He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN WAALIM MAA AR-FA-A’HU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) loftiness! How dominant He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN RAFEE-I’M MAA ASHRAFAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) dominancy! How extensive He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN SHAREEFIM MAA ABSATAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) extensiveness! How appropriative He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN BAASETIM MAA A’KBAZAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) appropriativenes! How originative He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN QAABEZIM MAA AB-DAAHO

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) origination! How holy He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN BAADIM MAA A’KDASAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) holiness! How pure He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN QUDDOOSIM MAA AZHARAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) purity! How pious He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN TAAHERIM MAA AZKAAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) piety! How guiding He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN ZAKIYYIM MAA AHDAAHO

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) guidance! How truthful He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN HAADIM MAA ASDAKAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) truthfulness! How timeless He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN SAADEKIM MAA A-A’WADAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) timelessness! How intentive He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN AWWAADIM MAA AFTARAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) inventiveness! How protecting He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN FAATERIM MAA AR-A’AHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) protectorship! How supporting He!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN RAA-I’M MAA A-A’WANAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) supportment! How benevolent He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MO-E’ENIM MAA AWHABAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) benevolence! How accommodative He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN WAHHAABIM MAA ATWABAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) accommodativeness! How munificent He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN TAWWAABIM MAA ASKHAAHO

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) munificence! How helpful He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN SAKHIYYIM MAA ANSARAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) helpfulness! How peaceable He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN NASEERIM MAA ASLAMAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) peaceableness! How able He as a healer!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN SALAAMIM MAA ASHFAAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) ability to heal! How able He is as a deliver!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN SHAAFIM MAA ANJAAHO

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) ability to deliver! How benign He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MUNJIM MAA ABARRAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) benignity! How persistent a seeker He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN BAARRIM MAA ATLABAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) demand! How perceptive He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN TAALEBIM MAA ADRAKAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) perceptiveness! How reasonable He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MUDREKIM MAA ARSHADAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) reasonableness! How affectionate He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN RASHEEDIM MAA A-A’TAFAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) affectionateness! How prudent He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MOTA-A’TTEFIM MAA A-A’DALAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) prudence! How perfect He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN A’DLIM MAA ATQANAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) perfection! How wise He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN MUTQOMIN MAA AHKAMAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) wisdom! How able He is to stand security!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN HAKEEMIM MAAA-AKFALAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) ability to stand security! How witnessing He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN KAFEELIM MAAA ASH-HADAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He in (His) witnessing! How praiseworthy He is!
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU MIN SHAHEEDIM MAAA AHMADAHU

segs.en: Glory be to He! He is Allah the Supreme and (all) praise be to Him.
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAHU HOWAL LAAHUL A’ZEEMO WA BE HAMDEHI

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَلَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ وَلِلّٰهِ الْحَمْدُ
segs.en: And (all) praise be to Allah. There is no god except Allah, and Allah is Great and for Allah is Praise.
segs.tr: WAL HAMDO LILLAAHE WA LAA ELAAHA ILLALLAAHO WALLAAHO AKBAR, WA LILLAAHIL HAMDO

segs.ar: وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّۃَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِیِّ الْعَظِیْمِ
segs.en: There is no power, and no might, except (with) Allah, the Highest High.
segs.tr: WA LAA HAWLA WALAA QUWWATA ILLAA BILLAAHIL A’LIYYIL A’ZEEM,

segs.en: Disperser of all calamities.
segs.tr: DAAFE-A’ KULLE BALIYYATIN

segs.en: Sufficient is He, and the Best Supporter.
segs.tr: WA HOWA HASBEE WA NE-A’MAL WAKEEL.

segs.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
segs.tr: BISMIL LAAHIR RAHMAANIR RAHEEM

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O  Allah! Send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN.

segs.en: And Curse the two idols of Quraish, and their two magicians, and their two tyrants,
segs.tr: WAL A’N SANAMAY QURAISHIN WA JIBTAYHAA WA TAAGHOOTAYHAA

segs.en: and their two accusers of falsehood, and their two daughters,
segs.tr: WA IFQAYHAA WAB NATAYHEMAL

segs.en: that opposed Your order, and denied Your revelation
segs.tr: LAZAYNE KHAALAFAA AMRAKA WA ANKARAA WAHYAKA

segs.en: and rejected Your graces, and disobeyed Your Messenger,
segs.tr: WA JAHADAA INA’AMAKA WA A’SAYAA RASOOLAKA

segs.en: and destroyed Your religion, and distorted Your Book,
segs.tr: WA QALLABAA DEENAKA WA HARRAFAA KETAABAKA

segs.en: and loved Your enemies, and negated Your Graciousness,
segs.tr: WA AHABBA A-A’DAA-AKA WA JAHADAA AALAAA-AKA

segs.en: and obstructed Your laws, and revocated Your obligations,
segs.tr: WA A’TTALAA AHKAAMAKA WA ABTALAA FARAAA-EZAKA

segs.en: and disbelieved in Your Signs, and antagonized Your Allies,
segs.tr: WA ALHADAA FEE AAYAATEKA WA A’AADAYAA AWLEYAAA-AKA

segs.en: and befriended Your enemies, and ruined Your cities,
segs.tr: WA WAALAYAA A’ADAAA-AKA WA KHARRABAA BELAADAKA

segs.en: and corrupted Your servants.
segs.tr: WA AFSADAA E’BAADAKA

segs.en: O Allah! Curse them both and their followers and their friends
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAL A’NHOMAA WA ATBAA-A’HOMAA WA AWLEYAAA-AHOMAA

segs.en: and their followers and their lovers
segs.tr: WA ASHYAA-A’HOMAA WA HOHIBBEEHEMAA

segs.en: for they have ruined the house of Prophethood
segs.tr: FAQAD AKHRABAA BAYTAN NOBUWWATE

segs.en: and closed its door, and broken its roof,
segs.tr: WA RADAMAA BAABAHU WA NAQAZAA SAQFAHU

segs.en: and brought down its elevated ceiling to its ground, and its height to a lower status,
segs.tr: WA ALHAQAA SAMAAA-AHU BE-ARZEHI WA A’ALEYAHU BE-SAAFELEHI

segs.en: and its exterior to its interior, and destroyed its inhabitants,
segs.tr: WA ZAAHERAHU BE-BAATENEHI WAS TAASALAA AHLAHU

segs.en: and exiled their helpers, and killed their children,
segs.tr: WA ABADAA ANSAARAHU WA QATALAA ATFAALAHU

segs.ar: وَاَخْلَیَا مِنْبَرَهٗ مِنْ وَصِیِّهٖ وَوَارِثِ عِلْمِهٖ
segs.en: and confiscated their pulpit from its successor and inheritor,
segs.tr: WA AKHLAYAA MINBARAHU MIN WASIYYEHI WA WAARESE I’LMEHI

segs.en: and negated the righteous leadership (Imamat) and ascribed a partner to their Lord,
segs.tr: WA JAHADAA EMAAMATAHU WA ASHRAKAA BERABBEHEMAA

segs.en: so maximize their sins and make them abide forever in the bottom of Hell,
segs.tr: FA-A’ZZIM ZAMBAHOMAA WA KHALLIDHOMAA FEE SAQARA

segs.ar: وَمَا اَدْرَاكَ مَا سَقَرَ لَا تُبْقِیْ وَلَا تَذَرْ
segs.en: And what will make you realize what the bottom of hell is? It leaves nothing nor spares anything. (The Holy Qur’an, 74:27-28)
segs.tr: WA MAA ADRAAKA MAA SAQARA LAA TUBQEE WA LAA TAZAR

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ الْعَنْهُمْ بِعَدَدِ كُلِّ مُنْكَرٍ اَتَوْهُ
segs.en: O Allah! Curse them by the number of each evil they have brought,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAL A’NHUM BE-A’DADE KULLE MUNKARIN ATAWHO

segs.en: and every truth they concealed, and every pulpit they ascended,
segs.tr: WA HAQQIN AKHFAWHO WA MINBARIN A’LAWHO

segs.en: and every believer they hurt, and every hypocrite they befriended,
segs.tr: WA MOAMENIN ARZAWHO WA MONAAFEQIN WALLAWHO

segs.en: and every friend they harmed, and every outcast they sheltered,
segs.tr: WA WALIYYIN AAZAWHO WA TAREEDIN AAWAWHO

segs.en: And every truthful person they exiled, and every disbeliever they supported,
segs.tr: WA SAADEQIN TARADOOHO WA KAAFERIN NASAROOHO

segs.en: and every Imam they overpowered, and every obligatory law they altered,
segs.tr: WA EMAAMIN QAHAROOHO WA FARZIN GHAYYAROOHO

segs.en: and every tradition they denied, and every evil they authorized,
segs.tr: WA ASARIN ANKAROOHO WA SHARRIN AASAROOHO

segs.en: and every blood they shed, and every report they altered,
segs.tr: WA DAMIN ARAQOOHO WA KHABARIN BADDALOOHO

segs.en: and every disbelief they established, and every inheritance they usurped,
segs.tr: WA KUFRIN NASABOOHO WA IRSIN GHASABOOHO

segs.en: and every portion of booty they seized, and every illicit gain they consumed,
segs.tr: WA FAY-ENIQ TATA-O’OHO WA SOHTIN AKALOOHO

segs.en: and every Khums they made lawful for themselves, and every falsehood they established,
segs.tr: WA KHUMSENIS TAHALLOOHO WA BAATELIN ASSASOOHO

segs.en: and every oppression they spread, and every hypocrisy they hid,
segs.tr: WA JAWRIN BASATOOHO WA NEFAAQIN ASARROOHO

segs.en: and every treachery they concealed, and every falsehood they spread,
segs.tr: WA GHADARIN AZAMAROOHO WA ZILLIN NASHAROOHO

segs.en: and promises they have dishonoured, and trust they betrayed,
segs.tr: WA WA’DIN AKHLAFOOHO WA AMAANIN KHAANOOHO

segs.en: and every covenant they broke, and every lawful thing they forbade,
segs.tr: WA A’HDIN NAQAZOOHO WA HALAALIN HARRAMOOHO

segs.en: and every forbidden thing they made lawful, and every abdomen they rupture,
segs.tr: WA HARAAMIN HALLALOOHO WA BATNIN FATAQOOHO

segs.en: and every foetus they aborted, and every rib they crushed,
segs.tr: WA JANEENIN ASQATOOHO WA ZIL-I’N DAQQOOHO

segs.en: and every document they shredded, and every gathering they dispersed,
segs.tr: WA SAKKIN MAZZAQOOHO WA SHAMLIN BADDADOOHO

segs.en: and every honoured one they degraded, and every degraded one they honoured,
segs.tr: WA A’ZEEZIN AZALLOOHO WA ZALEELIN A-A’ZZOOHO

segs.en: and every right they denied, and every lie they fabricated,
segs.tr: WA HAQQIN MANA-O’OHO WA KAZEBIN DALLASOOHO

segs.en: and every ruling they altered.
segs.tr: WA HUKMIN QALLABOOHO

segs.en: O Allah! Curse them both for each (Quranic) verse they have distorted,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAL A’NHOMAA BEKULLE AAYATIN HARRAFOOHO

segs.en: and obligation they abandoned, and tradition they altered.
segs.tr: WA FAREEZATIN TARAKOOHAA WA SUNNATIN GHAYYAROOHAA

segs.en: and tradition they have distorted, and (Divine) laws they forbade,
segs.tr: WA ROSOOMIN MANA-O’OHAA WA AHKAAMIN A’TTALOOHAA

segs.en: and the allegiance they have violated, and call they have invalidated,
segs.tr: WA BAY-A’TIN NAKASOOHAA WA DA’WAA ABTALOOHAA

segs.en: and evidence they have denied, and crime they have committed,
segs.tr: WA BAYYENATIN ANKAROOHAA WA HILYATIN AHDASOOHAA

segs.en: and betrayal they have performed, and the hill they have climbed,
segs.tr: WA KHEYAANATIN AWRADOOHAA WA A’QABATIN IRTAQOOHAA

segs.en: and fixed rules they have changed, and the defects they have promoted,
segs.tr: WA DEBAABIN DAH-RAJOOHAA WA AZYAAFIN LAZAMOOHAA

segs.en: and testimonies they have concealed, and advice they have made useless.
segs.tr: WA SHA-HAADATIN KATAMOOHAA WA WASIYYATIN ZAYYA-O’OHAA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ الْعَنْهُمَا فِیْ مَكْنُوْنِ السِّرِّ وَظَاهِرِ الْعَلَانِیَۃِ
segs.en: O Allah! Curse those two secretly as well as openly,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAL A’NHOMAA FEE MAKNOONIS SIRRE WA ZAAHERIL A’LAANEYATE

segs.ar: لَعْنًا كَثِیْرًا اَبَدًا دَآئِمًا دَآئِبًا سَرْمَدًا
segs.en: a curse that is great in number, everlasting, abiding, persistent, eternal,
segs.tr: LA’NAN KASEERAN ABADAN DAAA-EMAN DAAA-EBAN SARMADAN

segs.ar: لَا انْقِطَاعَ لِاَمَدِهٖ وَلَا نَفَادَ لِعَدَدِهٖ
segs.en: for a limitless duration, for unlimited number of times and without any bounds.
segs.tr: LAN QETAA-A’ LE-AMADEHI WA LAA NAFAADA LE-A’DADEHI

segs.ar: لَعْنًا یَغْدُوْا اَوَّلُهٗ وَلَا يَرُوْحُ اٰخِرُهٗ لَهُمْ
segs.en: A curse that commences from the first one (of them) and continues after the last one of them
segs.tr: LA’NAN YAGHDOO AWWALOHU WA LAA YAROOHO AAKHEROHU LAHUM

segs.en: and for their helpers, and their associates,
segs.tr: WA LE-AA’WAANEHIM WA ANSAAREHIM

segs.en: and their lovers, and their friends,
segs.tr: WA MOHIBBEEHIM WA MOWAALEEHIM

segs.en: and their submitters and those who are inclined towards them,
segs.tr: WAL MUSLEMEENA LAHUM WAL MAA-ELEENA ELAYHIM

segs.en: and those stand with them in their protests and those who follow their words
segs.tr: WAN NAAHEZEENA BE-EHTEJAAJEHIM WAL-MUQTADEENA BE-KALAAMEHIM

segs.en: and those who approve their actions.
segs.tr: WAL MOSADDEQEENA BE-AHKAAMEHIM.

segs.note: Then say four times:
segs.ur: پھر چار مرتبہ کہیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ عَذِّبْهُمْ عَذَابًا يَسْتَغِيْثُ مِنْهُ اَهْلُ النَّارِ
segs.en: O Allah! Punish them a punishment that the people of Hell seek refuge from,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA A’ZZIBHUM A’ZAABAN YASTAGHEESO MINHO AHLUN NAARE

segs.en: So be it, Lord of the Worlds.
segs.tr: AAMEENA RABBAL A’ALAMEENA.

N_muqatil.name: Dua e Muqatil bin Sulaiman

segs.note: For an urgent response to your need, recite:
segs.ur: اپنی حاجت کی فوری قبولیت کے لیے پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ كَيْفَ اَدْعُوْكَ وَاَنَا اَنَا وَكَيْفَ اَقْطَعُ رَجَاۤئِيْ مِنْكَ وَاَنْتَ اَنْتَ
segs.en: O my God, how can I pray to You while I am what I am? And how can I give up hope in You while You are what You are?
segs.tr: ILAAHEE KAYFA AD-U'KA WA ANAA ANAA WA KAYFA AQTA-U' RAJAAA-EE MINKA WA ANTA ANT
segs.ur: میرے معبود میں تجھے کیسے پکاروں اور میں تو میں ہوں اور کیونکر تجھ سے اپنی امید توڑوں جبکہ تو تو ہی ہے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْۤ اِذَا لَمْ اَسْاَلْكَ فَتُعْطِيَنِيْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْۤ اَسْاَلُهُ فَيُعْطِيْنِيْ اِلٰهِيْۤ اِذَا لَمْ اَدْعُكَ فَتَسْتَجِيْبَ لِيْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْۤ اَدْعُوْهُ فَيَسْتَجِيْبُ لِيْ
segs.en: O my God, if I do not beg You so that You give me, then whom else will I beg to give me? O my God, if I do not supplicate to You so that You respond to me, whom else will I supplicate to respond to me?
segs.tr: ILAAHEE IZAA LAM AS-ALKA FA-TU'TIYANEE FA-MAN ZAL LAZEE AS-ALUHU FA-YU'TEENEE, ILAAHEE IZAA LAM AD-U'KA FA-TASTAJEEBA LEE FA-MAN ZAL LAZEE AD-O'OHU FA-YASTAJEEBU LEE
segs.ur: میرے معبود جب میں تجھ سے نہ مانگوں کہ تو مجھے عطا کرتا ہے اور کون ہے جس سے مانگوں تو وہ مجھے دے گا میرے معبود جب میں تجھ سے دعا نہ کروں تو میری دعا قبول فرماتا ہے اور کون ہے جس سے دعا کروں تو وہ میری دعا قبول کرے گا

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْۤ اِذَا لَمْ اَتَضَرَّعْ اِلَيْكَ فَتَرْحَمُنِيْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْۤ اَتَضَرَّعُ اِلَيْهِ فَيَرْحَمُنِيْ
segs.en: O my God, if I do not implore You earnestly so that You have mercy upon me, whom else will I implore to have mercy upon me?
segs.tr: ILAAHEE IZAA LAM ATADARRA-A' ILAYKA FA-TARHAMANEE FA-MAN ZAL LAZEE ATADARRA-U' ILAYHI FA-YARHAMUNEE
segs.ur: میرے معبود جب میں تیرے حضور زاری نہ کروں تب بھی تو مجھ پر رحم کرتا ہے اور کون ہے جس کے آگے زاری کروں تو وہ مجھ پر رحم کرے گا

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ فَكَمَا فَلَقْتَ الْبَحْرَ لِمُوْسٰى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَنَجَّيْتَهٗ اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِهِ وَاَنْ تُنَجِّيَنِيْ مِمَّاۤ اَنَا فِيْهِ وَتُفَرِّجَ عَنِّيْ فَرَجًا عَاجِلًا غَيْرَ اٰجِلٍ بِفَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ يَاۤ اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
segs.en: O my God, just as You split the sea asunder for Moses, peace be upon him, and saved him — I ask You to bless Muhammad and his Household, save me from what I am suffering, and relieve me immediately without delay, by Your grace and Your mercy, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
segs.tr: ILAAHEE FAKAMAA FALAQTAL BAHRA LI-MOOSAA A'LAYHIS SALAAMU WA NAJJAYTAHU AS-ALUKA AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIHI WA AN TUNAJJIYANEE MIMMAA ANAA FEEHI WA TUFARRIJA A'NNEE FARAJAN A'AJILAN GHAYRA AAJILIM BI-FADLIKA WA RAHMATIKA YAA ARHAMAR RAAHIMEEN
segs.ur: میرے معبود جیسے تو نے دریا کو شگافتہ کیا موسٰیؑ کیلیے اور انہیں نجات دی تھی تو میں بھی تجھ سے سوال کرتا ہوں کہ محمدؐ وآلؑ محمد پر رحمت نازل فرما اور مجھے نجات دے اس مشکل سے جس میں گرفتار ہوں اور مجھے کشادگی عطا فرماجلد تر کہ اس میں دیر نہ ہو اپنے فضل سے اور اپنی رحمت سے اے سب سے زیادہ رحم کرنے والے

N_muqatil.merits: Imam Zayn al-'Abidin's supplicatory prayer for urgent response: mentioning a supplication reported from Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn Zayn al-'Abidin (a), Shaykh al-Kaf'ami, in al-Balad al-Amin, has added that Muqatil ibn Sulayman, reporting this supplication, said, "If one says this supplication one hundred times and still his need is not settled, one may then curse Muqatil."

N_ashura-husain.name: Dua of Imam Husain (a.s.) on Ashura
N_ashura-husain.nameUr: روز عاشور امام حسینؑ کی دعا

segs.note: Dua Bi-Haqqi Ya-Sin
segs.ur: دعا بحق یٰسین

segs.note: In urgent need, intense grief, hardship, and difficulty, recite:
segs.ur: سخت ضرورت، شدید غم، تنگی اور مشکل میں پڑھیں:

segs.ar: بِحَقِّ يٰسٓ وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْحَكِيْمِ وَبِحَقِّ طٰهٰ وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْعَظِيْمِ
segs.en: By the right of Ya-Sin and the Wise Qur'an, and by the right of Ta-Ha and the Great Qur'an,
segs.tr: BI-HAQQI YAASEEN WAL QUR-AANIL HAKEEM WA BI-HAQQI TAA-HAA WAL QUR-AANIL A'ZEEM

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ يَقْدِرُ عَلٰى حَوَاۤئِجِ السَّاۤئِلِيْنَ يَا مَنْ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى الضَّمِيْرِ
segs.en: O He Who has power over the needs of those who ask, O He Who knows what is in the innermost heart,
segs.tr: YAA MAY YAQDIRU A'LAA HAWAAA-IJIS SAAA-ILEENA YAA MAY YA'LAMU MAA FID DAMEER

segs.ar: يَا مُنَفِّسًا عَنِ الْمَكْرُوْبِيْنَ يَا مُفَرِّجًا عَنِ الْمَغْمُوْمِيْنَ
segs.en: O He Who relieves the distressed, O He Who removes the grief of the grieved,
segs.tr: YAA MUNAFFISAN A'NIL MAKROOBEENA YAA MUFARRIJAN A'NIL MAGHMOOMEEN

segs.ar: يَا رَاحِمَ الشَّيْخِ الْكَبِيْرِ يَا رَازِقَ الطِّفْلِ الصَّغِيْرِ
segs.en: O He Who has mercy on the elderly, O He Who sustains the young child,
segs.tr: YAA RAAHIMASH SHAYKHIL KABEERI YAA RAAZIQAT TIFLIS SAGHEER

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ لَايَحْتَاجُ اِلَى التَّفْسِيْرِ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O He Who needs no explanation, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: YAA MAL LAA YAHTAAJU ILAT TAFSEER SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: and do with me such-and-such (mention your need).
segs.tr: WAF-A'L BEE KAZAA WA KAZAA

segs.note: Then submit your requests.
segs.ur: پھر اپنی حاجتیں مانگیں۔

segs.note: Do Not Entrust Me to Myself
segs.ur: مجھے میرے نفس کے حوالے نہ کر

segs.note: Raise your hands towards the sky and recite:
segs.ur: آسمان کی طرف اپنے ہاتھ بلند کریں اور پڑھیں:

segs.ar: رَبِّ لَاتَكِلْنِىْۤ اِلٰى نَفْسِىْ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ اَبَدًا لَا اَقَلَّ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا اَكْثَرَ
segs.en: My Lord, do not entrust me to myself even for the blink of an eye, ever — neither less than that nor more.
segs.tr: RABBI LAA TAKILNEE ILAA NAFSEE TARFATA A'YNIN ABADAL LAA AQALLA MIN ZAALIKA WA LAA AKTHAR

segs.note: Mercy Beyond My Strength
segs.ur: میری طاقت سے بڑھ کر رحمت

segs.ar: اِرْحَمْنِىْ مِمَّا لَاطَاقَةَ لِىْ بِهِ وَلَاصَبْرَ لِىْ عَلَيْهِ
segs.en: Have mercy on me from that which I have no strength to bear and no patience for.
segs.tr: IRHAMNEE MIMMAA LAA TAAQATA LEE BIHI WA LAA SABRA LEE A'LAYH

segs.note: By Your Majesty and Beauty
segs.ur: تیری عظمت اور جمال کے واسطے سے

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنّىْۤ اَسْئَلُكَ بِجَلَالِكَ وَجَمَالِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ اَنْ تَفْعَلَ بِىْ كَذَا وَكَذَا
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by Your majesty, Your beauty, and Your generosity, to do with me such-and-such.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALUKA BI-JALAALIKA WA JAMAALIKA WA KARAMIKA AN TAF-A'LA BEE KAZAA WA KAZAA

segs.note: Then submit your requests.
segs.ur: پھر اپنی حاجتیں مانگیں۔

segs.note: Faith That Is Not Lent
segs.ur: ایسا ایمان جو عاریتی نہ ہو

segs.note: Repeat this supplication frequently:
segs.ur: اس دعا کو کثرت سے دہرائیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْنِىْ مِنَ الْمُعَارِيْنَ وَلَا تُخْرِجْنِىْ مِنَ التَّقْصِيْرِ
segs.en: O Allah, do not count me among those whose faith is only lent, and do not exempt me from feeling my shortcoming.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAA TAJ-A'LNEE MINAL MU-A'AREENA WA LAA TUKHRIJNEE MINAT TAQSEER

segs.note: If You Punish Me, I Deserve It
segs.ur: اگر آپ مجھے عذاب دیں تو میں اس کا مستحق ہوں

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ تُعَذِّبْنِىْ فَاَهْلٌ لِذٰلِكَ اَنَا وَاِنْ تَغْفِرْلِىْ فَاَهْلٌ لِذٰلِكَ اَنْتَ
segs.en: O Allah, if You punish me, I deserve it; and if You forgive me, You are worthy of that.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA IN TU-A'ZZIBNEE FA-AHLUL LI-ZAALIKA ANAA WA IN TAGHFIRLEE FA-AHLUL LI-ZAALIKA ANT

segs.note: Asking by the Five Persons
segs.ur: پنجتن کے واسطے سے مانگنا

segs.note: Whenever you press your request in prayer, ask Almighty Allah in the name of the Five Persons: the Holy Prophet, Imam Ali, Lady Fatimah, Imam al-Hasan, and Imam al-Husayn, peace be upon them.
segs.ur: جب بھی آپ دعا میں اپنی درخواست پر اصرار کریں تو پنجتن پاک کے واسطے سے اللہ تعالیٰ سے مانگیں: نبی اکرم (ص)، امام علی (ع)، حضرت فاطمہ (س)، امام حسن (ع) اور امام حسین (ع)، ان پر سلام ہو۔

segs.note: Truthfulness, Trusts & Prayers
segs.ur: سچائی، امانتیں اور دعائیں

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْهُمْ صِدْقَ الْحَدِيْثِ وَاٰدَاۤءَ الْاَمَانَةِ وَالْمُحَافَظَةَ عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ
segs.en: O Allah, grant them truthfulness in speech, the fulfilling of trusts, and the safeguarding of their prayers,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAR ZUQHUM SIDQAL HADEETHI WA ADAAA-AL AMAANATI WAL MUHAAFAZATA A'LAS SALAWAAT

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّهُمْ اَحَقُّ خَلْقِكَ اَنْ تَفْعَلَهُ بِهِمْ اَللّٰهُمَّ افْعَلْهُ بِهِمْ
segs.en: O Allah, they are the most deserving of Your creatures for You to do this for; O Allah, do it for them.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNAHUM AHAQQU KHALQIKA AN TAF-A'LAHU BIHIM ALLAAHUMMAF-A'LHU BIHIM

segs.note: Reliance upon Allah
segs.ur: اللہ پر توکل

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ مُنَّ عَلَىَّ بِالتَّوَكُّلِ عَلَيْكَ وَالتَّفْوِيْضِ اِلَيْكَ وَالرِّضَا بِقَدَرِكَ وَالتَّسْلِيْمِ لِاَمْرِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, favor me with reliance upon You, entrusting my affairs to You, contentment with Your decree, and submission to Your command,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA MUNNA A'LAYYA BIT TAWAKKULI A'LAYKA WAT TAFWEEDI ILAYKA WAR RIDAA BI-QADARIKA WAT TASLEEMI LI-AMRIK

segs.ar: حَتّٰى لَاۤ اُحِبَّ تَعْجِيْلَ مَاۤ اَخَّرْتَ وَلَاتَاْخِيْرَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
segs.en: so that I do not wish to hasten what You have delayed, nor to delay what You have hastened, O Lord of the worlds.
segs.tr: HATTAA LAA UHIBBA TA'JEELA MAA AKHKHARTA WA LAA TA-KHEERA MAA A'JJALTA YAA RABBAL A'ALAMEEN

segs.note: Praise Taught by Gabriel
segs.ur: جبرئیل کا سکھایا ہوا حمد

segs.note: Raise your hands towards Allah and recite:
segs.ur: اللہ کی طرف اپنے ہاتھ بلند کریں اور پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا خَالِدًا مَعَ خُلُوْدِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, to You is praise, everlasting praise along with Your everlastingness,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAN KHAALIDAM MA-A' KHULOODIK

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا لَا مُنْتَهٰى لَهُ دُوْنَ عِلْمِكَ
segs.en: and to You is praise, praise with no limit short of Your knowledge,
segs.tr: WA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAL LAA MUNTAHAA LAHU DOONA I'LMIK

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا لَاۤ اَمَدَ لَهُ دُوْنَ مَشِيَّتِكَ
segs.en: and to You is praise, praise with no bound short of Your will,
segs.tr: WA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAL LAA AMADA LAHU DOONA MASHEE-ATIK

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا لَاجَزَاۤءَ لِقَاۤئِلِهِ اِلَّا رِضَاكَ
segs.en: and to You is praise, praise whose speaker's only reward is Your good pleasure.
segs.tr: WA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAL LAA JAZAAA-A LI-QAAA-ILIHI ILLAA RIDAAK

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كُلُّهُ وَلَكَ الْمَنُّ كُلُّهُ وَلَكَ الْفَخْرُ كُلُّهُ
segs.en: O Allah, to You belongs all praise, to You belongs all favor, to You belongs all pride,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU KULLUHU WA LAKAL MANNU KULLUHU WA LAKAL FAKHRU KULLUH

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الْبَهَاۤءُ كُلُّهُ وَلَكَ النُّوْرُ كُلُّهُ وَلَكَ الْعِزَّةُ كُلُّهَا
segs.en: to You belongs all splendor, to You belongs all light, to You belongs all might,
segs.tr: WA LAKAL BAHAAA-O KULLUHU WA LAKAN NOORU KULLUHU WA LAKAL I'ZZATU KULLUHAA

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الْجَبَرُوْتُ كُلُّهَا وَلَكَ الْعَظَمَةُ كُلُّهَا
segs.en: to You belongs all sovereignty, to You belongs all greatness,
segs.tr: WA LAKAL JABAROOTU KULLUHAA WA LAKAL A'ZAMATU KULLUHAA

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الدُّنْيَا كُلُّهَا وَلَكَ الْاٰخِرَةُ كُلُّهَا
segs.en: to You belongs all of this world, to You belongs all of the Hereafter,
segs.tr: WA LAKAD DUNYAA KULLUHAA WA LAKAL AAKHIRATU KULLUHAA

segs.ar: وَلَكَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ كُلُّهُ وَلَكَ الْخَلْقُ كُلُّهُ
segs.en: to You belongs the night and the day in their entirety, to You belongs all creation,
segs.tr: WA LAKAL LAYLU WAN NAHAARU KULLUHU WA LAKAL KHALQU KULLUH

segs.ar: وَبِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ وَاِلَيْكَ يَرْجِعُ الْاَمْرُ كُلُّهُ عَلَانِيَتُهُ وَسِرُّهُ
segs.en: and in Your hand is all good; and to You all affairs return, their open and their hidden.
segs.tr: WA BI-YADIKAL KHAYRU KULLUHU WA ILAYKA YARJI-U'L AMRU KULLUHU A'LAANIYATUHU WA SIRRUH

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا اَبَدًا اَنْتَ حَسَنُ الْبَلَاۤءِ جَلِيْلُ الثَّنَاۤءِ
segs.en: O Allah, to You is praise, everlasting praise; You are beautiful in trial, glorious in acclaim,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAN ABADAN ANTA HASANUL BALAAA-I JALEELUTH THANAAA-I

segs.ar: سَابِغُ النَّعْمَاۤءِ عَدْلُ الْقَضَاۤءِ جَزِيْلُ الْعَطَاۤءِ حَسَنُ الْاٰلَاۤءِ
segs.en: abundant in favor, just in decree, generous in giving, beautiful in bestowals,
segs.tr: SAABIGHUN NA'MAAA-I A'DLUL QADAAA-I JAZEELUL A'TAAA-I HASANUL AALAAA-I

segs.ar: اِلٰهٌ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَاِلٰهٌ فِى السَّمَاۤءِ
segs.en: God in the earth and God in the heaven.
segs.tr: ILAAHUN FIL ARDI WA ILAAHUN FIS SAMAAA-I

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِى السَّبْعِ الشِّدَادِ وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِى الْاَرْضِ الْمِهَادِ
segs.en: O Allah, to You is praise in the seven firm heavens, and to You is praise in the outspread earth,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU FIS SAB-I'SH SHIDAADI WA LAKAL HAMDU FIL ARDIL MIHAAD

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ طَاقَةَ الْعِبَادِ وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ سَعَةَ الْبِلَادِ
segs.en: and to You is praise to the utmost of Your servants' capacity, and to You is praise as vast as the lands,
segs.tr: WA LAKAL HAMDU TAAQATAL I'BAADI WA LAKAL HAMDU SA-A'TAL BILAAD

segs.en: and to You is praise amid the mountains, the pegs of the earth,
segs.tr: WA LAKAL HAMDU FIL JIBAALIL AWTAAD

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِى اللَّيْلِ اِذَا يَغْشٰى وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِى النَّهَارِ اِذَا تَجَلّٰى
segs.en: to You is praise in the night when it covers, and to You is praise in the day when it shines forth,
segs.tr: WA LAKAL HAMDU FIL LAYLI IZAA YAGHSHAA WA LAKAL HAMDU FIN NAHAARI IZAA TAJALLAA

segs.en: and to You is praise in the Last Life and the First,
segs.tr: WA LAKAL HAMDU FIL AAKHIRATI WAL OOLAA

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِى الْمَثَانِىْ وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْعَظِيْمِ
segs.en: and to You is praise in the oft-repeated verses and the Great Qur'an,
segs.tr: WA LAKAL HAMDU FIL MATHAANEE WAL QUR-AANIL A'ZEEM

segs.ar: وَسُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ وَالْاَرْضُ جَمِيْعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ وَالسَّمٰوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ بِيَمِيْنِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالٰى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ
segs.en: And glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him — the whole earth shall be in His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens shall be folded in His right hand; glory be to Him, exalted above what they associate with Him,
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAL LAAHI WA BI-HAMDIHI WAL ARDU JAMEE-A'N QABDATUHU YAWMAL QIYAAMATI WAS SAMAAWAATU MATWIYYAATUM BI-YAMEENIHI SUBHAANAHU WA TA-A'ALAA A'MMAA YUSHRIKOON

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ كُلُّ شَيْئٍ هَالِكٌ اِلَّا وَجْهَهُ
segs.en: glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him — everything is perishing except His Countenance,
segs.tr: SUBHAANAL LAAHI WA BI-HAMDIHI KULLU SHAY-IN HAALIKUN ILLAA WAJHAH

segs.en: glory be to You, our Lord; exalted, blessed, and holy are You.
segs.tr: SUBHAANAKA RABBANAA WA TA-A'ALAYTA WA TABAARAKTA WA TAQADDAST

segs.ar: خَلَقْتَ كُلَّ شَيْئٍ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَقَهَرْتَ كُلَّ شَيْئٍ بِعِزَّتِكَ
segs.en: You created everything by Your power, and You subdued everything by Your might,
segs.tr: KHALAQTA KULLA SHAY-IM BI-QUDRATIKA WA QAHARTA KULLA SHAY-IM BI-I'ZZATIK

segs.ar: وَعَلَوْتَ فَوْقَ كُلِّ شَيْئٍ بِارْتِفَاعِكَ وَغَلَبْتَ كُلَّ شَيْئٍ بِقُوَّتِكَ
segs.en: and You rose above everything in Your loftiness, and You overpowered everything by Your strength,
segs.tr: WA A'LAWTA FAWQA KULLI SHAY-IM BI-IRTIFAA-I'KA WA GHALABTA KULLA SHAY-IM BI-QUWWATIK

segs.en: and You originated everything by Your wisdom and knowledge,
segs.tr: WABTADA'TA KULLA SHAY-IM BI-HIKMATIKA WA I'LMIK

segs.ar: وَبَعَثْتَ الرُّسُلَ بِكُتُبِكَ وَهَدَيْتَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ بِاِذْنِكَ
segs.en: and You sent the messengers with Your books, and You guided the righteous by Your permission,
segs.tr: WA BA-A'THTAR RUSULA BI-KUTUBIKA WA HADAYTAS SAALIHEENA BI-IZNIK

segs.ar: وَاَيَّدْتَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ بِنَصْرِكَ وَقَهَرْتَ الْخَلْقَ بِسُلْطَانِكَ
segs.en: and You strengthened the believers with Your aid, and You subdued creation by Your dominion.
segs.tr: WA AYYADTAL MU'MINEENA BI-NASRIKA WA QAHARTAL KHALQA BI-SULTAANIK

segs.ar: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ
segs.en: There is no god but You, alone, with no partner unto You;
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA WAHDAKA LAA SHAREEKA LAK

segs.ar: لَا نَعْبُدُ غَيْرَكَ وَلَانَسْئَلُ اِلَّاۤ اِيَّاكَ وَلَانَرْغَبُ اِلَّاۤ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: we worship none but You, we ask none but You, and we desire none but You;
segs.tr: LAA NA'BUDU GHAYRAKA WA LAA NAS-ALU ILLAA IYYAAKA WA LAA NARGHABU ILLAA ILAYK

segs.ar: اَنْتَ مَوْضِعُ شَكْوَانَا وَمُنْتَهٰى رَغْبَتِنَا وَاِلٰهُنَا وَمَلِيْكُنَا
segs.en: You are the place of our complaint, the utmost of our desire, our God, and our King.
segs.tr: ANTA MAWDI-U' SHAKWAANAA WA MUNTAHAA RAGHBATINAA WA ILAAHUNAA WA MALEEKUNAA

segs.note: (The record of this supplication in this app's history ends here; it is traditionally reported to continue at greater length.)
segs.ur: (اس ایپ کی تاریخ میں اس دعا کا ریکارڈ یہاں ختم ہو جاتا ہے؛ روایتی طور پر نقل ہوا ہے کہ یہ مزید تفصیل کے ساتھ جاری رہتی ہے۔)

N_ashura-husain.merits:
Dua Bi-Haqqi Ya-Sin: This is the supplicatory prayer the Holy Prophet (s) said on the days of the Battle of Badr and the Battle of the Allies (al-Ahzab). Imam al-Husayn (a), chief of the martyrs, also said this same supplication at Karbala on the day of Ashura. Two further supplications were said by Imam al-Husayn (a) that day; the first is the one he taught his son Imam Zayn al-Abidin (a) as he embraced him to his chest while blood poured from his wounds, for use in urgent need, intense grief, hardship, and difficulty.

Do Not Entrust Me to Myself: Imam al-Sadiq (a) is reported to have raised his hands towards the sky and recited this.

Mercy Beyond My Strength: Imam al-Sadiq (a) is also reported to have advised reciting this.

By Your Majesty and Beauty: Imam al-Sadiq (a) is also reported to have advised reciting this.

Faith That Is Not Lent: Fazl ibn Yunus reports that Imam al-Kazim (a) advised him to repeat this supplication frequently. The first statement asks not to be counted among those whose faith is as unsettled as a loan, not firmly fixed in the heart, or among those left entirely to themselves with no reliance on Allah. The second asks not to be counted among those who feel they have discharged their duty to their Lord perfectly — one should always feel one's efforts fall short of that duty, however much is exerted.

If You Punish Me, I Deserve It: Imam al-Baqir (a) said that Almighty Allah forgave a Bedouin for two words he said in his supplication.

Asking by the Five Persons: Dawud al-Raqqi said that whenever he pressed his request in prayer, Imam al-Sadiq (a) would ask Almighty Allah in the name of the Five Persons: the Holy Prophet, Imam Ali, Lady Fatimah, Imam al-Hasan, and Imam al-Husayn, peace be upon them.

Truthfulness, Trusts & Prayers: Yazid al-Sa'igh said: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a) to pray for our good, so he said this.

Reliance upon Allah: This is the supplication which Imam Ali, Amir al-Mu'minin (a), used to say.

Praise Taught by Gabriel: It is reported that the Angel Gabriel came to the Holy Prophet (s) with this message from Almighty Allah: if you want to worship Me a whole night and day perfectly, raise your hands towards Me and say this.

N_aminullah.name: Ziyarat e Aminullah

segs.note: Recite near the grave of Imam Ali (a.s.), or near the shrine of any of the other Holy Imams (a.s.):
segs.ur: امام علی (ع) کی قبر کے پاس، یا دوسرے ائمۂ طاہرین (ع) میں سے کسی کے روضے کے پاس پڑھیں:

segs.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
segs.ur: خدا کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربان نہایت رحم والا ہے
segs.tr: BISMILLAAHIR RAHMAANIR RAHEEM

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا اَمِیْنَ اللّٰهِ فِیْ اَرْضِهٖ
segs.en: Peace be on You, O the trustee of Allah on His earth,
segs.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے خدا کی زمین میں اس کے امین
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA AMEENALLAAHE FEE ARZEHI

segs.en: and His Proof over His servants.
segs.ur: اور اس کے بندوں پر اس کی حجت
segs.tr: WA HUJJATAHU A’LAA E’BAADEHI

segs.en: Peace be on you, O Ameerul Mu’mineen.
segs.ur: سلام ہو آپ پر اے مومنوں کے سردار
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA AMEERAL MOMINEENA

segs.ar: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ جَاهَدْتَ فِی اللّٰهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهٖ
segs.en: I bear witness that, you strived in the way of Allah what is due,
segs.ur: میں گواہی دیتا ہوں کہ آپ نے خدا کی راہ میں جہاد کیا جیسا جہاد کا حق تھا
segs.tr: ASH-HADO ANNAKA JAAHADTA FILLAAHE HAQQA JEHAADEHI

segs.en: and you acted upon His Book, and followed the ways of His Prophet,
segs.ur: اس کی کتاب پر عمل کیا اور اس کے نبی (ص) کی سنتوں کی پیروی کی
segs.tr: WA A’MILTA BEKETAABEHI WAT TABA’-TA SONANA NABIYYEHI

segs.en: blessings of Allah be on him and his family,
segs.ur: خدا رحمت کرے ان پر اور ان کی آل (ع) پر
segs.tr: SALLALLAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI

segs.en: until Allah called You to His side.
segs.ur: پھر خدا نے آپ کو اپنے پاس بلا لیا
segs.tr: HATTAA DA-A’AKALLAAHO ELAA JEWAAREHI

segs.en: So He took you to Him by His choice, and made incumbent upon your enemies
segs.ur: اپنے اختیار سے آپ کی جان قبض کر لی اور آپ کے دشمنوں پر قائم کی
segs.tr: FAQABAZAKA ELAYHE BE-IKHTEYAAREHI WA ALZAMA AA’-DAAA-EKAL

segs.ar: الْحُجَّۃَ مَعَ مَا لَكَ مِنَ الْحُجَجِ الْبَالِغَةِ
segs.en: the proof, with what you have of the considerable proofs,
segs.ur: حجت، جبکہ آپ کے وجود میں بہت سی کامل حجتیں ہیں
segs.tr: HUJJATA MA-A’ MAALAKA MENAL HOJAJIL BAALEGHATE

segs.en: over all of His creation.
segs.ur: تمام مخلوق کے لئے
segs.tr: A’LAA JAMEE-E’ KHALQEHI

segs.en: O Allah, then make my soul, satisfied with Your decree,
segs.ur: اے اللہ میرے نفس کو ایسا بنا کہ تیری تقدیر پر مطمئن ہو
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA FAJ-A’L NAFSEE MUTMA-INNATAN BEQADAREKA

segs.en: pleased with what You have destined for me,
segs.ur: تیرے فیصلے پر راضی و خوش رہے
segs.tr: RAAZEYATAN BEQAZAAA-EKA

segs.en: fond of Your remembrance and supplications,
segs.ur: تیرے ذکر اور دعاؤں کا مشتاق رہوں
segs.tr: MOOLA-A’TAN BEZIKREKA WA DO-A’AAA-EKA

segs.en: loving Your chosen friends.
segs.ur: تیرے برگزیدہ دوستوں سے محبت کرنے والا
segs.tr: MOHIBBATAN LESAFWATE AWLEYAAA-EKA

segs.en: (Let me be) well liked on Your earth and in Your heavens,
segs.ur: تیرے زمین و آسمان میں محبوب و منظور ہو
segs.tr: MAHBOOBATAN FEE ARZEKA WA SAMAAA-EKA

segs.en: patient when You send down afflictions,
segs.ur: صبر کرنے والا ہو تیری طرف سے مصائب کی آمد پر
segs.tr: SAABERATAN A’LAA NOZOOLE BALAAA-EKA

segs.en: grateful for Your gracious blessings,
segs.ur: شکر کرنے والا ہو تیری بہترین نعمتوں پر
segs.tr: SHAAKERATAN LEFAWAAZELE NAA’-MAAA-EKA

segs.en: remembering Your abundant bounties,
segs.ur: تیری کثیر مہربانیوں کو یاد کرنے والا ہو
segs.tr: ZAAKERATAN LESAWAABEGHE AALAAA-EKA

segs.en: yearning for the happiness of meeting with You,
segs.ur: تیری ملاقات کی خوشی کا خواہاں
segs.tr: MUSHTAAQATAN ELAA FARHATE LEQAAA-EKA

segs.en: equipped with piety for the day of Your reward,
segs.ur: یوم جزا کے لئے تقویٰ کو زاد راہ بنانے والا ہو
segs.tr: MOTAZAWWEDATAN LIT-TAQWAA LEYAWME JAZAAA-EKA

segs.en: following the manners of Your friends,
segs.ur: تیرے دوستوں کے نقش قدم پر چلنے والا
segs.tr: MUSTANNATAN BESONANE AWLEYAAA-EKA

segs.en: avoiding the manners of Your enemies,
segs.ur: تیرے دشمنوں کے طور طریقوں سے متنفر و دور
segs.tr: MOFAAREQATAN LE-AKHLAAQE AA’-DAAA-EKA

segs.en: diverted from the (love of) world by Your remembrance and Your praise.
segs.ur: اور دنیا سے بچ بچا کر تیری حمد و ثنا میں مشغول رہنے والا ہو
segs.tr: MASHGHOOLATAN A’NID DUNYAA BEHAMDEKA WA SANAAA-EKA

segs.note: Recite this part resting your cheek on the grave of Imam Ali (a.s.), as the fourth Imam (a.s.) did:
segs.ur: یہ حصہ امام علی (ع) کی قبر پر اپنا رخسار رکھ کر پڑھیں، جیسا کہ چوتھے امام (ع) نے کیا تھا:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ قُلُوْبَ الْمُخْبِتِیْنَ اِلَیْكَ وَالِهَۃٌ
segs.en: O Allah, the hearts of those who humble themselves before You, are full of amazement.
segs.ur: اے معبود! بے شک ڈرنے والوں کے قلوب تیرے لئے بے تاب
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNA QOLOOBAL MUKHBETEENA ELAYKA WAALEHATUN

segs.en: the paths of those who desire You are fixed.
segs.ur: اور تیرا شوق رکھنے والوں کے لئے راستے کھلے ہوئے ہوں
segs.tr: WA SOBOLAR RAAGHEBEENA ELAYKA SHAARE-A’TUN

segs.en: The signs for those who seek You are clear.
segs.ur: تیرا قصد کرنے والوں کی نشانیاں واضح ہیں
segs.tr: WA AA’-LAAMAL QAASEDEENA ELAYKA WAAZEHATUN

segs.en: The hearts of those who know You, are empty of other than You.
segs.ur: معرفت رکھنے والوں کے دل تجھ سے کانپتے ہیں
segs.tr: WA AF-EDATAL A’AREFEENA MINKA FAAZE-A’TUN

segs.en: The sounds of those who call You rise to You,
segs.ur: تیری بارگاہ میں دعا کرنے والوں کی آوازیں بلند ہیں
segs.tr: WA ASWAATAD DAA-E’EENA ELAYKA SAA-E’DATUN

segs.en: and the gates of answers are open for them.
segs.ur: اور ان کے لئے دعا کی قبولیت کے دروازے کھلے ہیں
segs.tr: WA ABWAABAL EJAABATE LAHUM MOFATTAHATUN

segs.en: The prayer of the one who whispers to you is answered.
segs.ur: تجھ سے راز و نیاز کرنے والوں کی دعا قبول ہے
segs.tr: WA DAA’-WATA MAN NAAJAAKA MUSTAJAABATUN

segs.en: The repentance of the one who turns to You is accepted.
segs.ur: جو تیری طرف پلٹ آئے اس کی توبہ منظور و مقبول ہے
segs.tr: WA TAWBATA MAN ANAABA ELAYKA MAQBOOLATUN

segs.ar: وَعَبْرَۃَ مَنْ بَکٰی مِنْ خَوْفِكَ مَرْحُوْمَۃٌ
segs.en: The tears of the one who weeps in Your fear are dealt with mercifully.
segs.ur: تیرے خوف میں رونے والے کے آنسوؤں پر رحمت ہوتی ہے
segs.tr: WA A’BRATA MAN BAKAA MIN KHAWFEKA MARHOOMATUN

segs.en: Help is available for one who cry for help from You,
segs.ur: جو تجھ سے فریاد کرے اس کے لئے داد رسی موجود ہے
segs.tr: WAL EGHAASATA LEMANIS-TAGHAASA BEKA MAWJOODATUN

segs.en: and assistance is given generously to the one who seeks it.
segs.ur: جو تجھ سے مدد طلب کرے اس کو مدد ملتی ہے
segs.tr: WAL E-A’ANATA LEMANIS-TA-A’ANA BEKA MABZOOLATUN

segs.en: Your promises for Your servants are fulfilled.
segs.ur: اپنے بندوں سے کیے گئے تیرے وعدے پورے ہوتے ہیں
segs.tr: WA E’DAATEKA LE-E’BAADEKA MUNJAZATUN

segs.en: The errors of the one who seeks to reduce them, are reduced.
segs.ur: تیرے یہاں عذر خواہوں کی خطائیں معاف ہوتی ہیں
segs.tr: WA ZALALA MANIS-TAQAALAKA MOQAALATUN

segs.en: The actions of the doers (of good deeds), are preserved with You,
segs.ur: اور عمل کرنے والوں کے اعمال محفوظ ہوتے ہیں
segs.tr: WA AA’-MAALAL AA’-MELEENA LADAYKA MAHFOOZATUN

segs.en: and the provision for Your creatures comes down.
segs.ur: مخلوقات کے لئے رزق و روزی تیری جانب سے ہی آتی ہے
segs.tr: WA ARZAAQAKA ELAL KHALAAA-EQE MIN LADUNKA NAAZELATUN

segs.en: The promises of increase (in provision) reach them,
segs.ur: اور ان کو مزید عطائیں حاصل ہوتی ہیں
segs.tr: WA A’WAAA-EDAL MAZEEDE ELAYHIM WAASELATUN

segs.en: The sins of those who seek forgiveness are forgiven.
segs.ur: طالبان بخشش کے گناہ بخش دیے جاتے ہیں
segs.tr: WA ZONOOBAL MUSTAGHFEREENA MAGHFOORATUN

segs.en: The needs of Your creatures are fulfilled.
segs.ur: ساری مخلوق کی حاجتیں تجھ سے پوری ہوتی ہیں
segs.tr: WA HAWAAA-EJA KHALQEKA I’NDAKA MAQZIYYATUN

segs.en: The rewards of the beseechers are available in plenty, with You.
segs.ur: تجھ سے سوال کرنے والوں کو بہت زیادہ ملتا ہے
segs.tr: WA JAWAAA-EZAS SAA-ELEENA I’NDAKA MOWAFFARATUN

segs.en: The promises of increase are continous.
segs.ur: اور تیرے ہاں پے در پے مسلسل عطائیں ہوتی ہیں
segs.tr: WA A’WAA-EDAL MAZEEDE MOTAWAATERATUN

segs.en: Wholesome food is prepared for the hungry,
segs.ur: کھانے والوں کیلئے دستر خوان تیار ہے
segs.tr: WA MAWAAA-EDAL MUSTAT-E’MEENA MO-A’DDATUN

segs.en: and drinks are filled for the thirsty.
segs.ur: اور تیرے ہاں پیاسوں کی خاطر چشمے بھرے ہوئے ہیں
segs.tr: WA MANAAHELAZ ZEMAA-E MUTRA-A’TUN

segs.en: O Allah, so answer my prayer, and accept my praise.
segs.ur: اے معبود! میری دعائیں قبول کر لے اور اس ثنا کو پسند فرما
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA FAS-TAJIB DO-A’AA-EE WAQBAL SANAA-EE

segs.en: Unite me with my friends,
segs.ur: مجھے میرے اولیاؤں کے ساتھ جمع کر دے
segs.tr: WAJ-MA’-BAYNEE WA BAYNA AWLEYAAA-EE

segs.en: for the sake of Mohammad, and Ali, and Fatimah,
segs.ur: کہ واسطہ دیتا ہوں محمد (ص) اور علی (ع) کا اور فاطمہ (س) کا
segs.tr: BEHAQQE MOHAMMADINW WA A’LIYYIN WA FAATEMATA

segs.en: Hasan and Husayn (a.s). Surely You are, the Master of my bounties,
segs.ur: اور حسن (ع) کا اور حسین (ع) کا، بے شک تو ہی مجھے نعمتیں دینے کا ذریعہ ہے
segs.tr: WAL HASANE WAL HUSAYNE INNAKA WALIYYO NA’-MAAA-EE

segs.en: the object of my desires, the goal of my hopes,
segs.ur: میری آرزوؤں کی انتہا اور میری امیدوں کا مرکز
segs.tr: WA MUNTAHAA MUNAAYA WA GHAAYATO RAJAAA-EE

segs.en: in my ultimate end and my stable abode.
segs.ur: دنیا و آخرت میں
segs.tr: FEE MUNQALABEE WA MASWAAYA

segs.note: Conclude with:
segs.ur: آخر میں یہ پڑھیں:

segs.en: (O Allah), You are my God, my Lord, and my Master.
segs.ur: تو میرا معبود میرا آقا اور میرا مالک ہے
segs.tr: ANTA ELAAHEE WA SAYYEDEE WA MAWLAAYA

segs.en: Forgive (the sins of ) our guardians, keep away our enemies from us,
segs.ur: ہمارے دوستوں کو معاف فرما اور دشمنوں کو ہم سے دور کر
segs.tr: IGHFIR LI-AWLEYAAA-ENAA WA KUFFA A’NNAA AA’-DAAA-ANAA

segs.en: and divert them from troubling us.
segs.ur: ان کو ہمیں ایذا دینے سے باز رکھ
segs.tr: WASHGHALHUM A’N AZAANAA

segs.en: Let the word of Truth become manifest
segs.ur: کلمہ حق کا ظہور فرما
segs.tr: WA AZHIR KALEMATAL HAQQE

segs.en: and make it supreme, and let the word of falsehood be refuted
segs.ur: اور اسے بلند قرار دے اور کلمہ باطل کو دبا دے
segs.tr: WAJ-A’LHAL U’LYAA WA ADHIZ KALEMATAL BAATELE

segs.en: and make it low,
segs.ur: اور اس کو پست قرار دے
segs.tr: WAJ-A’LHAS SUFLAA

segs.en: Surely You have power over all things.
segs.ur: کہ بے شک تو ہر چیز پر قدرت رکھتا ہے
segs.tr: INNAKA A’LAA KULLE SHAY-IN QADEERUN

N_aminullah.merits:
Jabir ibne Abdullah Ansari (r.a.), the famous companion of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) reported that Imam Zainul Abedin (a.s.) and Imam Mohammed Baqir (a.s.) recited this Ziyarat in a state of lamentation and mourning near the grave of Imam Ali (a.s.). 

They also said: For those amongst our Shias who recite this Dua and Ziyarat near the grave of Ameerul Momeneen – Imam Ali (a.s.) , Allah (s.w.t.) will write this action in their scroll of deeds with Noor (light) and this will be further adorned  by the seal of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.). He will then be placed in the protection of Hazrat-e-Qaem-e-Aal-e-Mohammed (a.t.f.s.) who will welcome him with honour and respect and give him glad tidings. (Ref: Mafateeh-ul-Jinaan) 

The sentences of this Ziyarat seek acceptance of one’s desires, increase in sustenance, distancing from the enemies of Ahlebait (a.s.), contentment and protection from one’s enemies. Truly the benefits of reciting this Ziyarat are manifold.
